verses.psalms 1:1: Psalms 1:1 Blessed is the man Who walks not in the counsel of the ungodly, Nor stands in the path of sinners,  Nor sits in the seat of the scornful;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 1:2: Psalms 1:2 But his delight is in the law of the LORD,  And in His law he meditates day and night.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 1:3: Psalms 1:3 He shall be like a tree  Planted by the rivers of water, That brings forth its fruit in its season, Whose leaf also shall not wither; And whatever he does shall prosper.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 1:4: Psalms 1:4 The ungodly are not so, But are like the chaff which the wind drives away.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 1:5: Psalms 1:5 Therefore the ungodly shall not stand in the judgment, Nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 1:6: Psalms 1:6 For the LORD knows the way of the righteous, But the way of the ungodly shall perish.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 2:1: Psalms 2:1 Why do the nations rage, And the people plot a vain thing?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 2:2: Psalms 2:2 The kings of the earth set themselves, And the rulers take counsel together, Against the LORD and against His Anointed, saying,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 2:3: Psalms 2:3 "Let us break Their bonds in pieces And cast away Their cords from us."(NKJV)
verses.psalms 2:4: Psalms 2:4 He who sits in the heavens shall laugh; The Lord shall hold them in derision.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 2:5: Psalms 2:5 Then He shall speak to them in His wrath, And distress them in His deep displeasure:(NKJV)
verses.psalms 2:6: Psalms 2:6 "Yet I have set My King On My holy hill of Zion."(NKJV)
verses.psalms 2:7: Psalms 2:7 "I will declare the decree: The LORD has said to Me,  "˜You are My Son, Today I have begotten You.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 2:8: Psalms 2:8 Ask of Me, and I will give You The nations for Your inheritance, And the ends of the earth for Your possession.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 2:9: Psalms 2:9 You shall break them with a rod of iron; You shall dash them to pieces like a potter's vessel.' "(NKJV)
verses.psalms 2:10: Psalms 2:10 Now therefore, be wise, O kings; Be instructed, you judges of the earth.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 2:11: Psalms 2:11 Serve the LORD with fear, And rejoice with trembling.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 2:12: Psalms 2:12 Kiss the Son, lest He be angry, And you perish in the way, When His wrath is kindled but a little.  Blessed are all those who put their trust in Him.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 3:1: Psalms 3:1 A Psalm of David when he fled from Absalom his son.   LORD, how they have increased who trouble me! Many are they who rise up against me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 3:2: Psalms 3:2 Many are they who say of me, "There is no help for him in God."  Selah(NKJV)
verses.psalms 3:3: Psalms 3:3 But You, O LORD, are a shield for me, My glory and the One who lifts up my head.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 3:4: Psalms 3:4 I cried to the LORD with my voice, And He heard me from His holy hill.  Selah(NKJV)
verses.psalms 3:5: Psalms 3:5 I lay down and slept; I awoke, for the LORD sustained me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 3:6: Psalms 3:6 I will not be afraid of ten thousands of people Who have set themselves against me all around.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 3:7: Psalms 3:7 Arise, O LORD; Save me, O my God!  For You have struck all my enemies on the cheekbone; You have broken the teeth of the ungodly.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 3:8: Psalms 3:8 Salvation belongs to the LORD. Your blessing is upon Your people.  Selah(NKJV)
verses.psalms 4:1: Psalms 4:1 To the Chief Musician. With stringed instruments. A Psalm of David.   Hear me when I call, O God of my righteousness! You have relieved me in my distress; Have mercy on me, and hear my prayer.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 4:2: Psalms 4:2 How long, O you sons of men, Will you turn my glory to shame? How long will you love worthlessness And seek falsehood?  Selah(NKJV)
verses.psalms 4:3: Psalms 4:3 But know that the LORD has set apart for Himself him who is godly; The LORD will hear when I call to Him.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 4:4: Psalms 4:4 Be angry, and do not sin.  Meditate within your heart on your bed, and be still.  Selah(NKJV)
verses.psalms 4:5: Psalms 4:5 Offer the sacrifices of righteousness, And put your trust in the LORD.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 4:6: Psalms 4:6 There are many who say, "Who will show us any good?"  LORD, lift up the light of Your countenance upon us.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 4:7: Psalms 4:7 You have put gladness in my heart, More than in the season that their grain and wine increased.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 4:8: Psalms 4:8 I will both lie down in peace, and sleep;  For You alone, O LORD, make me dwell in safety.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 5:1: Psalms 5:1 To the Chief Musician. With flutes. A Psalm of David.   Give ear to my words, O LORD, Consider my meditation.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 5:2: Psalms 5:2 Give heed to the voice of my cry, My King and my God, For to You I will pray.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 5:3: Psalms 5:3 My voice You shall hear in the morning, O LORD;  In the morning I will direct it to You, And I will look up.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 5:4: Psalms 5:4 For You are not a God who takes pleasure in wickedness, Nor shall evil dwell with You.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 5:5: Psalms 5:5 The boastful shall not stand in Your sight; You hate all workers of iniquity.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 5:6: Psalms 5:6 You shall destroy those who speak falsehood; The LORD abhors the bloodthirsty and deceitful man.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 5:7: Psalms 5:7 But as for me, I will come into Your house in the multitude of Your mercy; In fear of You I will worship toward Your holy temple.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 5:8: Psalms 5:8 Lead me, O LORD, in Your righteousness because of my enemies; Make Your way straight before my face.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 5:9: Psalms 5:9 For there is no faithfulness in their mouth; Their inward part is destruction;  Their throat is an open tomb; They flatter with their tongue.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 5:10: Psalms 5:10 Pronounce them guilty, O God! Let them fall by their own counsels; Cast them out in the multitude of their transgressions, For they have rebelled against You.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 5:11: Psalms 5:11 But let all those rejoice who put their trust in You; Let them ever shout for joy, because You defend them; Let those also who love Your name Be joyful in You.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 5:12: Psalms 5:12 For You, O LORD, will bless the righteous; With favor You will surround him as with a shield.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 6:1: Psalms 6:1 To the Chief Musician. With stringed instruments. On an eight-stringed harp. A Psalm of David.   O LORD, do not rebuke me in Your anger, Nor chasten me in Your hot displeasure.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 6:2: Psalms 6:2 Have mercy on me, O LORD, for I am weak; O LORD, heal me, for my bones are troubled.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 6:3: Psalms 6:3 My soul also is greatly troubled; But You, O LORD"”how long?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 6:4: Psalms 6:4 Return, O LORD, deliver me! Oh, save me for Your mercies' sake!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 6:5: Psalms 6:5 For in death there is no remembrance of You; In the grave who will give You thanks?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 6:6: Psalms 6:6 I am weary with my groaning; All night I make my bed swim; I drench my couch with my tears.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 6:7: Psalms 6:7 My eye wastes away because of grief; It grows old because of all my enemies.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 6:8: Psalms 6:8 Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity; For the LORD has heard the voice of my weeping.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 6:9: Psalms 6:9 The LORD has heard my supplication; The LORD will receive my prayer.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 6:10: Psalms 6:10 Let all my enemies be ashamed and greatly troubled; Let them turn back and be ashamed suddenly.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 7:1: Psalms 7:1 A Meditation of David, which he sang to the LORD concerning the words of Cush, a Benjamite.   O LORD my God, in You I put my trust;  Save me from all those who persecute me; And deliver me,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 7:2: Psalms 7:2 Lest they tear me like a lion,  Rending me in pieces, while there is none to deliver.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 7:3: Psalms 7:3 O LORD my God, if I have done this: If there is iniquity in my hands,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 7:4: Psalms 7:4 If I have repaid evil to him who was at peace with me, Or have plundered my enemy without cause,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 7:5: Psalms 7:5 Let the enemy pursue me and overtake me; Yes, let him trample my life to the earth, And lay my honor in the dust.  Selah(NKJV)
verses.psalms 7:6: Psalms 7:6 Arise, O LORD, in Your anger;  Lift Yourself up because of the rage of my enemies;  Rise up for me to the judgment You have commanded!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 7:7: Psalms 7:7 So the congregation of the peoples shall surround You; For their sakes, therefore, return on high.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 7:8: Psalms 7:8 The LORD shall judge the peoples;  Judge me, O LORD, according to my righteousness, And according to my integrity within me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 7:9: Psalms 7:9 Oh, let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end, But establish the just;  For the righteous God tests the hearts and minds.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 7:10: Psalms 7:10 My defense is of God, Who saves the upright in heart.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 7:11: Psalms 7:11 God is a just judge, And God is angry with the wicked every day.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 7:12: Psalms 7:12 If he does not turn back, He will sharpen His sword; He bends His bow and makes it ready.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 7:13: Psalms 7:13 He also prepares for Himself instruments of death; He makes His arrows into fiery shafts.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 7:14: Psalms 7:14 Behold, the wicked brings forth iniquity; Yes, he conceives trouble and brings forth falsehood.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 7:15: Psalms 7:15 He made a pit and dug it out,  And has fallen into the ditch which he made.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 7:16: Psalms 7:16 His trouble shall return upon his own head, And his violent dealing shall come down on his own crown.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 7:17: Psalms 7:17 I will praise the LORD according to His righteousness, And will sing praise to the name of the LORD Most High.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 8:1: Psalms 8:1 To the Chief Musician. On the instrument of Gath. A Psalm of David.   O LORD, our Lord, How excellent is Your name in all the earth, Who have set Your glory above the heavens!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 8:2: Psalms 8:2 Out of the mouth of babes and nursing infants You have ordained strength, Because of Your enemies, That You may silence the enemy and the avenger.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 8:3: Psalms 8:3 When I consider Your heavens, the work of Your fingers, The moon and the stars, which You have ordained,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 8:4: Psalms 8:4 What is man that You are mindful of him, And the son of man that You visit him?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 8:5: Psalms 8:5 For You have made him a little lower than the angels, And You have crowned him with glory and honor.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 8:6: Psalms 8:6 You have made him to have dominion over the works of Your hands;  You have put all things under his feet,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 8:7: Psalms 8:7 All sheep and oxen"” Even the beasts of the field,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 8:8: Psalms 8:8 The birds of the air, And the fish of the sea That pass through the paths of the seas.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 8:9: Psalms 8:9 O LORD, our Lord, How excellent is Your name in all the earth!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 9:1: Psalms 9:1 To the Chief Musician. To the tune of "Death of the Son." A Psalm of David.   I will praise You, O LORD, with my whole heart; I will tell of all Your marvelous works.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 9:2: Psalms 9:2 I will be glad and rejoice in You; I will sing praise to Your name, O Most High.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 9:3: Psalms 9:3 When my enemies turn back, They shall fall and perish at Your presence.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 9:4: Psalms 9:4 For You have maintained my right and my cause; You sat on the throne judging in righteousness.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 9:5: Psalms 9:5 You have rebuked the nations, You have destroyed the wicked; You have blotted out their name forever and ever.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 9:6: Psalms 9:6 O enemy, destructions are finished forever! And you have destroyed cities; Even their memory has perished.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 9:7: Psalms 9:7 But the LORD shall endure forever; He has prepared His throne for judgment.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 9:8: Psalms 9:8 He shall judge the world in righteousness, And He shall administer judgment for the peoples in uprightness.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 9:9: Psalms 9:9 The LORD also will be a refuge for the oppressed, A refuge in times of trouble.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 9:10: Psalms 9:10 And those who know Your name will put their trust in You; For You, LORD, have not forsaken those who seek You.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 9:11: Psalms 9:11 Sing praises to the LORD, who dwells in Zion!  Declare His deeds among the people.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 9:12: Psalms 9:12 When He avenges blood, He remembers them; He does not forget the cry of the humble.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 9:13: Psalms 9:13 Have mercy on me, O LORD! Consider my trouble from those who hate me, You who lift me up from the gates of death,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 9:14: Psalms 9:14 That I may tell of all Your praise In the gates of the daughter of Zion. I will rejoice in Your salvation.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 9:15: Psalms 9:15 The nations have sunk down in the pit which they made; In the net which they hid, their own foot is caught.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 9:16: Psalms 9:16 The LORD is known by the judgment He executes; The wicked is snared in the work of his own hands.   Meditation. Selah(NKJV)
verses.psalms 9:17: Psalms 9:17 The wicked shall be turned into hell, And all the nations that forget God.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 9:18: Psalms 9:18 For the needy shall not always be forgotten;  The expectation of the poor shall not perish forever.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 9:19: Psalms 9:19 Arise, O LORD, Do not let man prevail; Let the nations be judged in Your sight.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 9:20: Psalms 9:20 Put them in fear, O LORD, That the nations may know themselves to be but men.  Selah(NKJV)
verses.psalms 10:1: Psalms 10:1 Why do You stand afar off, O LORD? Why do You hide in times of trouble?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 10:2: Psalms 10:2 The wicked in his pride persecutes the poor;  Let them be caught in the plots which they have devised.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 10:3: Psalms 10:3 For the wicked boasts of his heart's desire; He blesses the greedy and renounces the LORD.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 10:4: Psalms 10:4 The wicked in his proud countenance does not seek God; God is in none of his thoughts.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 10:5: Psalms 10:5 His ways are always prospering; Your judgments are far above, out of his sight; As for all his enemies, he sneers at them.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 10:6: Psalms 10:6 He has said in his heart, "I shall not be moved;  I shall never be in adversity."(NKJV)
verses.psalms 10:7: Psalms 10:7 His mouth is full of cursing and deceit and oppression; Under his tongue is trouble and iniquity.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 10:8: Psalms 10:8 He sits in the lurking places of the villages; In the secret places he murders the innocent; His eyes are secretly fixed on the helpless.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 10:9: Psalms 10:9 He lies in wait secretly, as a lion in his den; He lies in wait to catch the poor; He catches the poor when he draws him into his net.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 10:10: Psalms 10:10 So he crouches, he lies low, That the helpless may fall by his strength.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 10:11: Psalms 10:11 He has said in his heart, "God has forgotten; He hides His face; He will never see."(NKJV)
verses.psalms 10:12: Psalms 10:12 Arise, O LORD! O God, lift up Your hand! Do not forget the humble.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 10:13: Psalms 10:13 Why do the wicked renounce God? He has said in his heart, "You will not require an account."(NKJV)
verses.psalms 10:14: Psalms 10:14 But You have seen, for You observe trouble and grief, To repay it by Your hand. The helpless commits himself to You;  You are the helper of the fatherless.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 10:15: Psalms 10:15 Break the arm of the wicked and the evil man; Seek out his wickedness until You find none.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 10:16: Psalms 10:16 The LORD is King forever and ever; The nations have perished out of His land.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 10:17: Psalms 10:17 LORD, You have heard the desire of the humble; You will prepare their heart; You will cause Your ear to hear,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 10:18: Psalms 10:18 To do justice to the fatherless and the oppressed, That the man of the earth may oppress no more.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 11:1: Psalms 11:1 To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David.   In the LORD I put my trust; How can you say to my soul, "Flee as a bird to your mountain"?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 11:2: Psalms 11:2 For look! The wicked bend their bow, They make ready their arrow on the string, That they may shoot secretly at the upright in heart.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 11:3: Psalms 11:3 If the foundations are destroyed, What can the righteous do?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 11:4: Psalms 11:4 The LORD is in His holy temple, The LORD's throne is in heaven;  His eyes behold, His eyelids test the sons of men.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 11:5: Psalms 11:5 The LORD tests the righteous, But the wicked and the one who loves violence His soul hates.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 11:6: Psalms 11:6 Upon the wicked He will rain coals; Fire and brimstone and a burning wind  Shall be the portion of their cup.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 11:7: Psalms 11:7 For the LORD is righteous, He loves righteousness; His countenance beholds the upright.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 12:1: Psalms 12:1 To the Chief Musician. On an eight-stringed harp. A Psalm of David.   Help, LORD, for the godly man ceases! For the faithful disappear from among the sons of men.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 12:2: Psalms 12:2 They speak idly everyone with his neighbor; With flattering lips and a double heart they speak.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 12:3: Psalms 12:3 May the LORD cut off all flattering lips, And the tongue that speaks proud things,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 12:4: Psalms 12:4 Who have said, "With our tongue we will prevail; Our lips are our own; Who is lord over us?"(NKJV)
verses.psalms 12:5: Psalms 12:5 "For the oppression of the poor, for the sighing of the needy, Now I will arise," says the LORD; "I will set him in the safety for which he yearns."(NKJV)
verses.psalms 12:6: Psalms 12:6 The words of the LORD are pure words, Like silver tried in a furnace of earth, Purified seven times.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 12:7: Psalms 12:7 You shall keep them, O LORD, You shall preserve them from this generation forever.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 12:8: Psalms 12:8 The wicked prowl on every side, When vileness is exalted among the sons of men.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 13:1: Psalms 13:1 To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David.   How long, O LORD? Will You forget me forever?  How long will You hide Your face from me?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 13:2: Psalms 13:2 How long shall I take counsel in my soul, Having sorrow in my heart daily? How long will my enemy be exalted over me?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 13:3: Psalms 13:3 Consider and hear me, O LORD my God;  Enlighten my eyes,  Lest I sleep the sleep of death;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 13:4: Psalms 13:4 Lest my enemy say, "I have prevailed against him"; Lest those who trouble me rejoice when I am moved.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 13:5: Psalms 13:5 But I have trusted in Your mercy; My heart shall rejoice in Your salvation.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 13:6: Psalms 13:6 I will sing to the LORD, Because He has dealt bountifully with me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 14:1: Psalms 14:1 To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David.   The fool has said in his heart, "There is no God." They are corrupt, They have done abominable works, There is none who does good.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 14:2: Psalms 14:2 The LORD looks down from heaven upon the children of men, To see if there are any who understand, who seek God.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 14:3: Psalms 14:3 They have all turned aside, They have together become corrupt; There is none who does good, No, not one.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 14:4: Psalms 14:4 Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge, Who eat up my people as they eat bread, And do not call on the LORD?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 14:5: Psalms 14:5 There they are in great fear, For God is with the generation of the righteous.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 14:6: Psalms 14:6 You shame the counsel of the poor, But the LORD is his refuge.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 14:7: Psalms 14:7 Oh, that the salvation of Israel would come out of Zion!  When the LORD brings back the captivity of His people, Let Jacob rejoice and Israel be glad.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 15:1: Psalms 15:1 A Psalm of David.   LORD, who may abide in Your tabernacle? Who may dwell in Your holy hill?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 15:2: Psalms 15:2 He who walks uprightly, And works righteousness, And speaks the truth in his heart;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 15:3: Psalms 15:3 He who does not backbite with his tongue, Nor does evil to his neighbor,  Nor does he take up a reproach against his friend;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 15:4: Psalms 15:4 In whose eyes a vile person is despised, But he honors those who fear the LORD; He who swears to his own hurt and does not change;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 15:5: Psalms 15:5 He who does not put out his money at usury, Nor does he take a bribe against the innocent. He who does these things shall never be moved.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 16:1: Psalms 16:1 A Michtam of David.   Preserve me, O God, for in You I put my trust.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 16:2: Psalms 16:2 O my soul, you have said to the LORD, "You are my Lord,  My goodness is nothing apart from You."(NKJV)
verses.psalms 16:3: Psalms 16:3 As for the saints who are on the earth, "They are the excellent ones, in whom is all my delight."(NKJV)
verses.psalms 16:4: Psalms 16:4 Their sorrows shall be multiplied who hasten after another god; Their drink offerings of blood I will not offer,  Nor take up their names on my lips.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 16:5: Psalms 16:5 O LORD, You are the portion of my inheritance and my cup; You maintain my lot.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 16:6: Psalms 16:6 The lines have fallen to me in pleasant places; Yes, I have a good inheritance.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 16:7: Psalms 16:7 I will bless the LORD who has given me counsel; My heart also instructs me in the night seasons.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 16:8: Psalms 16:8 I have set the LORD always before me; Because He is at my right hand I shall not be moved.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 16:9: Psalms 16:9 Therefore my heart is glad, and my glory rejoices; My flesh also will rest in hope.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 16:10: Psalms 16:10 For You will not leave my soul in Sheol, Nor will You allow Your Holy One to see corruption.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 16:11: Psalms 16:11 You will show me the path of life; In Your presence is fullness of joy; At Your right hand are pleasures forevermore.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 17:1: Psalms 17:1 A Prayer of David.   Hear a just cause, O LORD, Attend to my cry; Give ear to my prayer which is not from deceitful lips.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 17:2: Psalms 17:2 Let my vindication come from Your presence; Let Your eyes look on the things that are upright.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 17:3: Psalms 17:3 You have tested my heart; You have visited me in the night;  You have tried me and have found nothing; I have purposed that my mouth shall not transgress.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 17:4: Psalms 17:4 Concerning the works of men, By the word of Your lips, I have kept away from the paths of the destroyer.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 17:5: Psalms 17:5 Uphold my steps in Your paths, That my footsteps may not slip.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 17:6: Psalms 17:6 I have called upon You, for You will hear me, O God; Incline Your ear to me, and hear my speech.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 17:7: Psalms 17:7 Show Your marvelous lovingkindness by Your right hand, O You who save those who trust in You From those who rise up against them.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 17:8: Psalms 17:8 Keep me as the apple of Your eye; Hide me under the shadow of Your wings,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 17:9: Psalms 17:9 From the wicked who oppress me, From my deadly enemies who surround me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 17:10: Psalms 17:10 They have closed up their fat hearts; With their mouths they speak proudly.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 17:11: Psalms 17:11 They have now surrounded us in our steps; They have set their eyes, crouching down to the earth,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 17:12: Psalms 17:12 As a lion is eager to tear his prey, And like a young lion lurking in secret places.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 17:13: Psalms 17:13 Arise, O LORD, Confront him, cast him down; Deliver my life from the wicked with Your sword,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 17:14: Psalms 17:14 With Your hand from men, O LORD, From men of the world who have their portion in this life, And whose belly You fill with Your hidden treasure. They are satisfied with children, And leave the rest of their possession for their babes.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 17:15: Psalms 17:15 As for me, I will see Your face in righteousness;  I shall be satisfied when I awake in Your likeness.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 18:1: Psalms 18:1 To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David the servant of the LORD, who spoke to the LORD the words of this song on the day that the LORD delivered him from the hand of all his enemies and from the hand of Saul. And he said:   I will love You, O LORD, my strength.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 18:2: Psalms 18:2 The LORD is my rock and my fortress and my deliverer; My God, my strength, in whom I will trust; My shield and the horn of my salvation, my stronghold.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 18:3: Psalms 18:3 I will call upon the LORD, who is worthy to be praised; So shall I be saved from my enemies.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 18:4: Psalms 18:4 The pangs of death surrounded me, And the floods of ungodliness made me afraid.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 18:5: Psalms 18:5 The sorrows of Sheol surrounded me; The snares of death confronted me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 18:6: Psalms 18:6 In my distress I called upon the LORD, And cried out to my God; He heard my voice from His temple, And my cry came before Him, even to His ears.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 18:7: Psalms 18:7 Then the earth shook and trembled; The foundations of the hills also quaked and were shaken, Because He was angry.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 18:8: Psalms 18:8 Smoke went up from His nostrils, And devouring fire from His mouth; Coals were kindled by it.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 18:9: Psalms 18:9 He bowed the heavens also, and came down With darkness under His feet.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 18:10: Psalms 18:10 And He rode upon a cherub, and flew;  He flew upon the wings of the wind.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 18:11: Psalms 18:11 He made darkness His secret place;  His canopy around Him was dark waters And thick clouds of the skies.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 18:12: Psalms 18:12 From the brightness before Him, His thick clouds passed with hailstones and coals of fire.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 18:13: Psalms 18:13 The LORD thundered from heaven, And the Most High uttered His voice, Hailstones and coals of fire.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 18:14: Psalms 18:14 He sent out His arrows and scattered the foe, Lightnings in abundance, and He vanquished them.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 18:15: Psalms 18:15 Then the channels of the sea were seen, The foundations of the world were uncovered At Your rebuke, O LORD, At the blast of the breath of Your nostrils.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 18:16: Psalms 18:16 He sent from above, He took me; He drew me out of many waters.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 18:17: Psalms 18:17 He delivered me from my strong enemy, From those who hated me, For they were too strong for me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 18:18: Psalms 18:18 They confronted me in the day of my calamity, But the LORD was my support.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 18:19: Psalms 18:19 He also brought me out into a broad place; He delivered me because He delighted in me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 18:20: Psalms 18:20 The LORD rewarded me according to my righteousness; According to the cleanness of my hands He has recompensed me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 18:21: Psalms 18:21 For I have kept the ways of the LORD, And have not wickedly departed from my God.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 18:22: Psalms 18:22 For all His judgments were before me, And I did not put away His statutes from me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 18:23: Psalms 18:23 I was also blameless before Him, And I kept myself from my iniquity.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 18:24: Psalms 18:24 Therefore the LORD has recompensed me according to my righteousness, According to the cleanness of my hands in His sight.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 18:25: Psalms 18:25 With the merciful You will show Yourself merciful; With a blameless man You will show Yourself blameless;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 18:26: Psalms 18:26 With the pure You will show Yourself pure; And with the devious You will show Yourself shrewd.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 18:27: Psalms 18:27 For You will save the humble people, But will bring down haughty looks.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 18:28: Psalms 18:28 For You will light my lamp; The LORD my God will enlighten my darkness.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 18:29: Psalms 18:29 For by You I can run against a troop, By my God I can leap over a wall.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 18:30: Psalms 18:30 As for God, His way is perfect;  The word of the LORD is proven; He is a shield to all who trust in Him.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 18:31: Psalms 18:31 For who is God, except the LORD? And who is a rock, except our God?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 18:32: Psalms 18:32 It is God who arms me with strength, And makes my way perfect.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 18:33: Psalms 18:33 He makes my feet like the feet of deer, And sets me on my high places.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 18:34: Psalms 18:34 He teaches my hands to make war, So that my arms can bend a bow of bronze.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 18:35: Psalms 18:35 You have also given me the shield of Your salvation; Your right hand has held me up, Your gentleness has made me great.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 18:36: Psalms 18:36 You enlarged my path under me,  So my feet did not slip.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 18:37: Psalms 18:37 I have pursued my enemies and overtaken them; Neither did I turn back again till they were destroyed.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 18:38: Psalms 18:38 I have wounded them, So that they could not rise; They have fallen under my feet.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 18:39: Psalms 18:39 For You have armed me with strength for the battle; You have subdued under me those who rose up against me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 18:40: Psalms 18:40 You have also given me the necks of my enemies, So that I destroyed those who hated me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 18:41: Psalms 18:41 They cried out, but there was none to save;  Even to the LORD, but He did not answer them.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 18:42: Psalms 18:42 Then I beat them as fine as the dust before the wind; I cast them out like dirt in the streets.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 18:43: Psalms 18:43 You have delivered me from the strivings of the people;  You have made me the head of the nations;  A people I have not known shall serve me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 18:44: Psalms 18:44 As soon as they hear of me they obey me; The foreigners submit to me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 18:45: Psalms 18:45 The foreigners fade away, And come frightened from their hideouts.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 18:46: Psalms 18:46 The LORD lives! Blessed be my Rock! Let the God of my salvation be exalted.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 18:47: Psalms 18:47 It is God who avenges me,  And subdues the peoples under me;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 18:48: Psalms 18:48 He delivers me from my enemies.  You also lift me up above those who rise against me; You have delivered me from the violent man.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 18:49: Psalms 18:49 Therefore I will give thanks to You, O LORD, among the Gentiles, And sing praises to Your name.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 18:50: Psalms 18:50 Great deliverance He gives to His king, And shows mercy to His anointed, To David and his descendants forevermore.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 19:1: Psalms 19:1 To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David.   The heavens declare the glory of God; And the firmament shows His handiwork.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 19:2: Psalms 19:2 Day unto day utters speech, And night unto night reveals knowledge.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 19:3: Psalms 19:3 There is no speech nor language Where their voice is not heard.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 19:4: Psalms 19:4 Their line has gone out through all the earth, And their words to the end of the world. In them He has set a tabernacle for the sun,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 19:5: Psalms 19:5 Which is like a bridegroom coming out of his chamber,  And rejoices like a strong man to run its race.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 19:6: Psalms 19:6 Its rising is from one end of heaven, And its circuit to the other end; And there is nothing hidden from its heat.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 19:7: Psalms 19:7 The law of the LORD is perfect, converting the soul; The testimony of the LORD is sure, making wise the simple;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 19:8: Psalms 19:8 The statutes of the LORD are right, rejoicing the heart; The commandment of the LORD is pure, enlightening the eyes;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 19:9: Psalms 19:9 The fear of the LORD is clean, enduring forever; The judgments of the LORD are true and righteous altogether.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 19:10: Psalms 19:10 More to be desired are they than gold, Yea, than much fine gold; Sweeter also than honey and the honeycomb.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 19:11: Psalms 19:11 Moreover by them Your servant is warned, And in keeping them there is great reward.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 19:12: Psalms 19:12 Who can understand his errors?  Cleanse me from secret faults.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 19:13: Psalms 19:13 Keep back Your servant also from presumptuous sins; Let them not have dominion over me. Then I shall be blameless, And I shall be innocent of great transgression.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 19:14: Psalms 19:14 Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart Be acceptable in Your sight, O LORD, my strength and my Redeemer.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 20:1: Psalms 20:1 To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David.   May the LORD answer you in the day of trouble; May the name of the God of Jacob defend you;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 20:2: Psalms 20:2 May He send you help from the sanctuary, And strengthen you out of Zion;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 20:3: Psalms 20:3 May He remember all your offerings, And accept your burnt sacrifice.  Selah(NKJV)
verses.psalms 20:4: Psalms 20:4 May He grant you according to your heart's desire, And fulfill all your purpose.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 20:5: Psalms 20:5 We will rejoice in your salvation, And in the name of our God we will set up our banners! May the LORD fulfill all your petitions.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 20:6: Psalms 20:6 Now I know that the LORD saves His anointed; He will answer him from His holy heaven With the saving strength of His right hand.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 20:7: Psalms 20:7 Some trust in chariots, and some in horses; But we will remember the name of the LORD our God.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 20:8: Psalms 20:8 They have bowed down and fallen; But we have risen and stand upright.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 20:9: Psalms 20:9 Save, LORD! May the King answer us when we call.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 21:1: Psalms 21:1 To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David.   The king shall have joy in Your strength, O LORD; And in Your salvation how greatly shall he rejoice!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 21:2: Psalms 21:2 You have given him his heart's desire, And have not withheld the request of his lips.  Selah(NKJV)
verses.psalms 21:3: Psalms 21:3 For You meet him with the blessings of goodness; You set a crown of pure gold upon his head.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 21:4: Psalms 21:4 He asked life from You, and You gave it to him"” Length of days forever and ever.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 21:5: Psalms 21:5 His glory is great in Your salvation; Honor and majesty You have placed upon him.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 21:6: Psalms 21:6 For You have made him most blessed forever;  You have made him exceedingly glad with Your presence.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 21:7: Psalms 21:7 For the king trusts in the LORD, And through the mercy of the Most High he shall not be moved.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 21:8: Psalms 21:8 Your hand will find all Your enemies; Your right hand will find those who hate You.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 21:9: Psalms 21:9 You shall make them as a fiery oven in the time of Your anger; The LORD shall swallow them up in His wrath, And the fire shall devour them.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 21:10: Psalms 21:10 Their offspring You shall destroy from the earth, And their descendants from among the sons of men.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 21:11: Psalms 21:11 For they intended evil against You; They devised a plot which they are not able to perform.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 21:12: Psalms 21:12 Therefore You will make them turn their back; You will make ready Your arrows on Your string toward their faces.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 21:13: Psalms 21:13 Be exalted, O LORD, in Your own strength! We will sing and praise Your power.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 22:1: Psalms 22:1 To the Chief Musician. Set to "The Deer of the Dawn." A Psalm of David.   My God, My God, why have You forsaken Me? Why are You so far from helping Me, And from the words of My groaning?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 22:2: Psalms 22:2 O My God, I cry in the daytime, but You do not hear; And in the night season, and am not silent.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 22:3: Psalms 22:3 But You are holy, Enthroned in the praises of Israel.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 22:4: Psalms 22:4 Our fathers trusted in You; They trusted, and You delivered them.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 22:5: Psalms 22:5 They cried to You, and were delivered;  They trusted in You, and were not ashamed.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 22:6: Psalms 22:6 But I am a worm, and no man;  A reproach of men, and despised by the people.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 22:7: Psalms 22:7 All those who see Me ridicule Me; They shoot out the lip, they shake the head, saying,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 22:8: Psalms 22:8 "He  trusted in the LORD, let Him rescue Him;  Let Him deliver Him, since He delights in Him!"(NKJV)
verses.psalms 22:9: Psalms 22:9 But You are He who took Me out of the womb; You made Me trust while on My mother's breasts.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 22:10: Psalms 22:10 I was cast upon You from birth. From My mother's womb  You have been My God.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 22:11: Psalms 22:11 Be not far from Me, For trouble is near; For there is none to help.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 22:12: Psalms 22:12 Many bulls have surrounded Me; Strong bulls of Bashan have encircled Me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 22:13: Psalms 22:13 They gape at Me with their mouths, Like a raging and roaring lion.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 22:14: Psalms 22:14 I am poured out like water,  And all My bones are out of joint; My heart is like wax; It has melted within Me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 22:15: Psalms 22:15 My strength is dried up like a potsherd, And My tongue clings to My jaws; You have brought Me to the dust of death.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 22:16: Psalms 22:16 For dogs have surrounded Me; The congregation of the wicked has enclosed Me.  They pierced My hands and My feet;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 22:17: Psalms 22:17 I can count all My bones.  They look and stare at Me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 22:18: Psalms 22:18 They divide My garments among them, And for My clothing they cast lots.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 22:19: Psalms 22:19 But You, O LORD, do not be far from Me; O My Strength, hasten to help Me!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 22:20: Psalms 22:20 Deliver Me from the sword,  My precious life from the power of the dog.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 22:21: Psalms 22:21 Save Me from the lion's mouth And from the horns of the wild oxen!  You have answered Me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 22:22: Psalms 22:22 I will declare Your name to My brethren; In the midst of the assembly I will praise You.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 22:23: Psalms 22:23 You who fear the LORD, praise Him! All you descendants of Jacob, glorify Him, And fear Him, all you offspring of Israel!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 22:24: Psalms 22:24 For He has not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted; Nor has He hidden His face from Him; But when He cried to Him, He heard.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 22:25: Psalms 22:25 My praise shall be of You in the great assembly;  I will pay My vows before those who fear Him.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 22:26: Psalms 22:26 The poor shall eat and be satisfied; Those who seek Him will praise the LORD. Let your heart live forever!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 22:27: Psalms 22:27 All the ends of the world Shall remember and turn to the LORD, And all the families of the nations Shall worship before You.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 22:28: Psalms 22:28 For the kingdom is the LORD's, And He rules over the nations.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 22:29: Psalms 22:29 All the prosperous of the earth Shall eat and worship;  All those who go down to the dust Shall bow before Him, Even he who cannot keep himself alive.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 22:30: Psalms 22:30 A posterity shall serve Him. It will be recounted of the Lord to the next generation,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 22:31: Psalms 22:31 They will come and declare His righteousness to a people who will be born, That He has done this.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 23:1: Psalms 23:1 A Psalm of David.   The LORD is my shepherd;  I shall not want.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 23:2: Psalms 23:2 He makes me to lie down in green pastures;  He leads me beside the still waters.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 23:3: Psalms 23:3 He restores my soul;  He leads me in the paths of righteousness For His name's sake.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 23:4: Psalms 23:4 Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death,  I will fear no evil;  For You are with me; Your rod and Your staff, they comfort me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 23:5: Psalms 23:5 You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies; You anoint my head with oil; My cup runs over.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 23:6: Psalms 23:6 Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me All the days of my life; And I will dwell in the house of the LORD Forever.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 24:1: Psalms 24:1 A Psalm of David.   The earth is the LORD's, and all its fullness, The world and those who dwell therein.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 24:2: Psalms 24:2 For He has founded it upon the seas, And established it upon the waters.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 24:3: Psalms 24:3 Who may ascend into the hill of the LORD? Or who may stand in His holy place?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 24:4: Psalms 24:4 He who has clean hands and a pure heart, Who has not lifted up his soul to an idol, Nor sworn deceitfully.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 24:5: Psalms 24:5 He shall receive blessing from the LORD, And righteousness from the God of his salvation.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 24:6: Psalms 24:6 This is Jacob, the generation of those who seek Him, Who seek Your face.  Selah(NKJV)
verses.psalms 24:7: Psalms 24:7 Lift up your heads, O you gates! And be lifted up, you everlasting doors!  And the King of glory shall come in.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 24:8: Psalms 24:8 Who is this King of glory? The LORD strong and mighty, The LORD mighty in battle.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 24:9: Psalms 24:9 Lift up your heads, O you gates! Lift up, you everlasting doors! And the King of glory shall come in.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 24:10: Psalms 24:10 Who is this King of glory? The LORD of hosts, He is the King of glory.  Selah(NKJV)
verses.psalms 25:1: Psalms 25:1 A Psalm of David.   To You, O LORD, I lift up my soul.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 25:2: Psalms 25:2 O my God, I trust in You; Let me not be ashamed;  Let not my enemies triumph over me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 25:3: Psalms 25:3 Indeed, let no one who waits on You be ashamed; Let those be ashamed who deal treacherously without cause.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 25:4: Psalms 25:4 Show me Your ways, O LORD; Teach me Your paths.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 25:5: Psalms 25:5 Lead me in Your truth and teach me, For You are the God of my salvation; On You I wait all the day.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 25:6: Psalms 25:6 Remember, O LORD, Your tender mercies and Your lovingkindnesses, For they are from of old.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 25:7: Psalms 25:7 Do not remember the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions;  According to Your mercy remember me, For Your goodness' sake, O LORD.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 25:8: Psalms 25:8 Good and upright is the LORD; Therefore He teaches sinners in the way.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 25:9: Psalms 25:9 The humble He guides in justice, And the humble He teaches His way.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 25:10: Psalms 25:10 All the paths of the LORD are mercy and truth, To such as keep His covenant and His testimonies.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 25:11: Psalms 25:11 For Your name's sake, O LORD, Pardon my iniquity, for it is great.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 25:12: Psalms 25:12 Who is the man that fears the LORD?  Him shall He teach in the way He chooses.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 25:13: Psalms 25:13 He himself shall dwell in prosperity, And his descendants shall inherit the earth.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 25:14: Psalms 25:14 The secret of the LORD is with those who fear Him, And He will show them His covenant.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 25:15: Psalms 25:15 My eyes are ever toward the LORD, For He shall pluck my feet out of the net.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 25:16: Psalms 25:16 Turn Yourself to me, and have mercy on me, For I am desolate and afflicted.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 25:17: Psalms 25:17 The troubles of my heart have enlarged; Bring me out of my distresses!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 25:18: Psalms 25:18 Look on my affliction and my pain, And forgive all my sins.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 25:19: Psalms 25:19 Consider my enemies, for they are many; And they hate me with cruel hatred.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 25:20: Psalms 25:20 Keep my soul, and deliver me; Let me not be ashamed, for I put my trust in You.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 25:21: Psalms 25:21 Let integrity and uprightness preserve me, For I wait for You.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 25:22: Psalms 25:22 Redeem Israel, O God, Out of all their troubles!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 26:1: Psalms 26:1 A Psalm of David.   Vindicate me, O LORD, For I have walked in my integrity.  I have also trusted in the LORD; I shall not slip.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 26:2: Psalms 26:2 Examine me, O LORD, and prove me; Try my mind and my heart.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 26:3: Psalms 26:3 For Your lovingkindness is before my eyes, And I have walked in Your truth.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 26:4: Psalms 26:4 I have not sat with idolatrous mortals, Nor will I go in with hypocrites.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 26:5: Psalms 26:5 I have hated the assembly of evildoers, And will not sit with the wicked.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 26:6: Psalms 26:6 I will wash my hands in innocence; So I will go about Your altar, O LORD,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 26:7: Psalms 26:7 That I may proclaim with the voice of thanksgiving, And tell of all Your wondrous works.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 26:8: Psalms 26:8 LORD, I have loved the habitation of Your house, And the place where Your glory dwells.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 26:9: Psalms 26:9 Do not gather my soul with sinners, Nor my life with bloodthirsty men,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 26:10: Psalms 26:10 In whose hands is a sinister scheme, And whose right hand is full of bribes.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 26:11: Psalms 26:11 But as for me, I will walk in my integrity; Redeem me and be merciful to me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 26:12: Psalms 26:12 My foot stands in an even place; In the congregations I will bless the LORD.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 27:1: Psalms 27:1 A Psalm of David.   The LORD is my light and my salvation; Whom shall I fear? The LORD is the strength of my life; Of whom shall I be afraid?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 27:2: Psalms 27:2 When the wicked came against me To eat up my flesh, My enemies and foes, They stumbled and fell.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 27:3: Psalms 27:3 Though an army may encamp against me, My heart shall not fear; Though war may rise against me, In this I will be confident.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 27:4: Psalms 27:4 One thing I have desired of the LORD, That will I seek: That I may dwell in the house of the LORD All the days of my life, To behold the beauty of the LORD, And to inquire in His temple.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 27:5: Psalms 27:5 For in the time of trouble He shall hide me in His pavilion; In the secret place of His tabernacle He shall hide me; He shall set me high upon a rock.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 27:6: Psalms 27:6 And now my head shall be lifted up above my enemies all around me; Therefore I will offer sacrifices of joy in His tabernacle; I will sing, yes, I will sing praises to the LORD.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 27:7: Psalms 27:7 Hear, O LORD, when I cry with my voice! Have mercy also upon me, and answer me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 27:8: Psalms 27:8 When You said, "Seek My face," My heart said to You, "Your face, LORD, I will seek."(NKJV)
verses.psalms 27:9: Psalms 27:9 Do not hide Your face from me; Do not turn Your servant away in anger; You have been my help; Do not leave me nor forsake me, O God of my salvation.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 27:10: Psalms 27:10 When my father and my mother forsake me, Then the LORD will take care of me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 27:11: Psalms 27:11 Teach me Your way, O LORD, And lead me in a smooth path, because of my enemies.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 27:12: Psalms 27:12 Do not deliver me to the will of my adversaries; For false witnesses have risen against me, And such as breathe out violence.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 27:13: Psalms 27:13 I would have lost heart, unless I had believed That I would see the goodness of the LORD  In the land of the living.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 27:14: Psalms 27:14 Wait on the LORD; Be of good courage, And He shall strengthen your heart; Wait, I say, on the LORD!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 28:1: Psalms 28:1 A Psalm of David.   To You I will cry, O LORD my Rock:  Do not be silent to me,  Lest, if You are silent to me, I become like those who go down to the pit.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 28:2: Psalms 28:2 Hear the voice of my supplications When I cry to You,  When I lift up my hands toward Your holy sanctuary.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 28:3: Psalms 28:3 Do not take me away with the wicked And with the workers of iniquity,  Who speak peace to their neighbors, But evil is in their hearts.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 28:4: Psalms 28:4 Give them according to their deeds, And according to the wickedness of their endeavors; Give them according to the work of their hands; Render to them what they deserve.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 28:5: Psalms 28:5 Because they do not regard the works of the LORD, Nor the operation of His hands, He shall destroy them And not build them up.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 28:6: Psalms 28:6 Blessed be the LORD, Because He has heard the voice of my supplications!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 28:7: Psalms 28:7 The LORD is my strength and my shield; My heart trusted in Him, and I am helped; Therefore my heart greatly rejoices, And with my song I will praise Him.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 28:8: Psalms 28:8 The LORD is their strength, And He is the saving refuge of His anointed.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 28:9: Psalms 28:9 Save Your people, And bless Your inheritance; Shepherd them also,  And bear them up forever.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 29:1: Psalms 29:1 A Psalm of David.   Give unto the LORD, O you mighty ones, Give unto the LORD glory and strength.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 29:2: Psalms 29:2 Give unto the LORD the glory due to His name; Worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 29:3: Psalms 29:3 The voice of the LORD is over the waters;  The God of glory thunders; The LORD is over many waters.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 29:4: Psalms 29:4 The voice of the LORD is powerful; The voice of the LORD is full of majesty.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 29:5: Psalms 29:5 The voice of the LORD breaks the cedars, Yes, the LORD splinters the cedars of Lebanon.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 29:6: Psalms 29:6 He makes them also skip like a calf, Lebanon and Sirion like a young wild ox.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 29:7: Psalms 29:7 The voice of the LORD divides the flames of fire.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 29:8: Psalms 29:8 The voice of the LORD shakes the wilderness; The LORD shakes the Wilderness of Kadesh.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 29:9: Psalms 29:9 The voice of the LORD makes the deer give birth, And strips the forests bare; And in His temple everyone says, "Glory!"(NKJV)
verses.psalms 29:10: Psalms 29:10 The LORD sat enthroned at the Flood, And the LORD sits as King forever.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 29:11: Psalms 29:11 The LORD will give strength to His people; The LORD will bless His people with peace.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 30:1: Psalms 30:1 A Psalm. A Song at the dedication of the house of David.   I will extol You, O LORD, for You have lifted me up, And have not let my foes rejoice over me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 30:2: Psalms 30:2 O LORD my God, I cried out to You, And You healed me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 30:3: Psalms 30:3 O LORD, You brought my soul up from the grave; You have kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 30:4: Psalms 30:4 Sing praise to the LORD, you saints of His, And give thanks at the remembrance of His holy name.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 30:5: Psalms 30:5 For His anger is but for a moment,  His favor is for life; Weeping may endure for a night, But joy comes in the morning.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 30:6: Psalms 30:6 Now in my prosperity I said, "I shall never be moved."(NKJV)
verses.psalms 30:7: Psalms 30:7 LORD, by Your favor You have made my mountain stand strong;  You hid Your face, and I was troubled.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 30:8: Psalms 30:8 I cried out to You, O LORD; And to the LORD I made supplication:(NKJV)
verses.psalms 30:9: Psalms 30:9 "What profit is there in my blood, When I go down to the pit?  Will the dust praise You? Will it declare Your truth?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 30:10: Psalms 30:10 Hear, O LORD, and have mercy on me; LORD, be my helper!"(NKJV)
verses.psalms 30:11: Psalms 30:11 You have turned for me my mourning into dancing; You have put off my sackcloth and clothed me with gladness,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 30:12: Psalms 30:12 To the end that my glory may sing praise to You and not be silent. O LORD my God, I will give thanks to You forever.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 31:1: Psalms 31:1 To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David.   In You, O LORD, I put my trust; Let me never be ashamed; Deliver me in Your righteousness.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 31:2: Psalms 31:2 Bow down Your ear to me, Deliver me speedily; Be my rock of refuge, A fortress of defense to save me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 31:3: Psalms 31:3 For You are my rock and my fortress; Therefore, for Your name's sake, Lead me and guide me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 31:4: Psalms 31:4 Pull me out of the net which they have secretly laid for me, For You are my strength.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 31:5: Psalms 31:5 Into Your hand I commit my spirit; You have redeemed me, O LORD God of truth.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 31:6: Psalms 31:6 I have hated those who regard useless idols; But I trust in the LORD.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 31:7: Psalms 31:7 I will be glad and rejoice in Your mercy, For You have considered my trouble; You have known my soul in adversities,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 31:8: Psalms 31:8 And have not shut me up into the hand of the enemy;  You have set my feet in a wide place.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 31:9: Psalms 31:9 Have mercy on me, O LORD, for I am in trouble;  My eye wastes away with grief, Yes, my soul and my body!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 31:10: Psalms 31:10 For my life is spent with grief, And my years with sighing; My strength fails because of my iniquity, And my bones waste away.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 31:11: Psalms 31:11 I am a reproach among all my enemies, But especially among my neighbors, And am repulsive to my acquaintances;  Those who see me outside flee from me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 31:12: Psalms 31:12 I am forgotten like a dead man, out of mind; I am like a broken vessel.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 31:13: Psalms 31:13 For I hear the slander of many;  Fear is on every side; While they take counsel together against me, They scheme to take away my life.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 31:14: Psalms 31:14 But as for me, I trust in You, O LORD; I say, "You are my God."(NKJV)
verses.psalms 31:15: Psalms 31:15 My times are in Your hand; Deliver me from the hand of my enemies, And from those who persecute me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 31:16: Psalms 31:16 Make Your face shine upon Your servant; Save me for Your mercies' sake.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 31:17: Psalms 31:17 Do not let me be ashamed, O LORD, for I have called upon You; Let the wicked be ashamed;  Let them be silent in the grave.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 31:18: Psalms 31:18 Let the lying lips be put to silence, Which speak insolent things proudly and contemptuously against the righteous.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 31:19: Psalms 31:19 Oh, how great is Your goodness, Which You have laid up for those who fear You, Which You have prepared for those who trust in You In the presence of the sons of men!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 31:20: Psalms 31:20 You shall hide them in the secret place of Your presence From the plots of man;  You shall keep them secretly in a pavilion From the strife of tongues.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 31:21: Psalms 31:21 Blessed be the LORD, For He has shown me His marvelous kindness in a strong city!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 31:22: Psalms 31:22 For I said in my haste, "I am cut off from before Your eyes"; Nevertheless You heard the voice of my supplications When I cried out to You.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 31:23: Psalms 31:23 Oh, love the LORD, all you His saints! For the LORD preserves the faithful, And fully repays the proud person.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 31:24: Psalms 31:24 Be of good courage, And He shall strengthen your heart, All you who hope in the LORD.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 32:1: Psalms 32:1 A Psalm of David. A Contemplation.   Blessed is he whose transgression is forgiven, Whose sin is covered.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 32:2: Psalms 32:2 Blessed is the man to whom the LORD does not impute iniquity, And in whose spirit there is no deceit.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 32:3: Psalms 32:3 When I kept silent, my bones grew old Through my groaning all the day long.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 32:4: Psalms 32:4 For day and night Your hand was heavy upon me; My vitality was turned into the drought of summer.  Selah(NKJV)
verses.psalms 32:5: Psalms 32:5 I acknowledged my sin to You, And my iniquity I have not hidden.  I said, "I will confess my transgressions to the LORD," And You forgave the iniquity of my sin.  Selah(NKJV)
verses.psalms 32:6: Psalms 32:6 For this cause everyone who is godly shall pray to You In a time when You may be found; Surely in a flood of great waters They shall not come near him.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 32:7: Psalms 32:7 You are my hiding place; You shall preserve me from trouble; You shall surround me with songs of deliverance.  Selah(NKJV)
verses.psalms 32:8: Psalms 32:8 I will instruct you and teach you in the way you should go; I will guide you with My eye.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 32:9: Psalms 32:9 Do not be like the horse or like the mule, Which have no understanding, Which must be harnessed with bit and bridle, Else they will not come near you.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 32:10: Psalms 32:10 Many sorrows shall be to the wicked; But he who trusts in the LORD, mercy shall surround him.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 32:11: Psalms 32:11 Be glad in the LORD and rejoice, you righteous; And shout for joy, all you upright in heart!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 33:1: Psalms 33:1 Rejoice in the LORD, O you righteous! For praise from the upright is beautiful.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 33:2: Psalms 33:2 Praise the LORD with the harp; Make melody to Him with an instrument of ten strings.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 33:3: Psalms 33:3 Sing to Him a new song; Play skillfully with a shout of joy.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 33:4: Psalms 33:4 For the word of the LORD is right, And all His work is done in truth.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 33:5: Psalms 33:5 He loves righteousness and justice; The earth is full of the goodness of the LORD.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 33:6: Psalms 33:6 By the word of the LORD the heavens were made, And all the host of them by the breath of His mouth.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 33:7: Psalms 33:7 He gathers the waters of the sea together as a heap; He lays up the deep in storehouses.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 33:8: Psalms 33:8 Let all the earth fear the LORD; Let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of Him.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 33:9: Psalms 33:9 For He spoke, and it was done; He commanded, and it stood fast.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 33:10: Psalms 33:10 The LORD brings the counsel of the nations to nothing; He makes the plans of the peoples of no effect.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 33:11: Psalms 33:11 The counsel of the LORD stands forever, The plans of His heart to all generations.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 33:12: Psalms 33:12 Blessed is the nation whose God is the LORD, The people He has chosen as His own inheritance.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 33:13: Psalms 33:13 The LORD looks from heaven; He sees all the sons of men.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 33:14: Psalms 33:14 From the place of His dwelling He looks On all the inhabitants of the earth;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 33:15: Psalms 33:15 He fashions their hearts individually;  He considers all their works.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 33:16: Psalms 33:16 No king is saved by the multitude of an army; A mighty man is not delivered by great strength.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 33:17: Psalms 33:17 A horse is a vain hope for safety; Neither shall it deliver any by its great strength.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 33:18: Psalms 33:18 Behold, the eye of the LORD is on those who fear Him, On those who hope in His mercy,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 33:19: Psalms 33:19 To deliver their soul from death, And to keep them alive in famine.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 33:20: Psalms 33:20 Our soul waits for the LORD; He is our help and our shield.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 33:21: Psalms 33:21 For our heart shall rejoice in Him, Because we have trusted in His holy name.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 33:22: Psalms 33:22 Let Your mercy, O LORD, be upon us, Just as we hope in You.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 34:1: Psalms 34:1 A Psalm of David when he pretended madness before Abimelech, who drove him away, and he departed.   I will bless the LORD at all times; His praise shall continually be in my mouth.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 34:2: Psalms 34:2 My soul shall make its boast in the LORD; The humble shall hear of it and be glad.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 34:3: Psalms 34:3 Oh, magnify the LORD with me, And let us exalt His name together.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 34:4: Psalms 34:4 I sought the LORD, and He heard me, And delivered me from all my fears.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 34:5: Psalms 34:5 They looked to Him and were radiant, And their faces were not ashamed.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 34:6: Psalms 34:6 This poor man cried out, and the LORD heard him, And saved him out of all his troubles.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 34:7: Psalms 34:7 The angel of the LORD encamps all around those who fear Him, And delivers them.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 34:8: Psalms 34:8 Oh, taste and see that the LORD is good;  Blessed is the man who trusts in Him!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 34:9: Psalms 34:9 Oh, fear the LORD, you His saints! There is no want to those who fear Him.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 34:10: Psalms 34:10 The young lions lack and suffer hunger;  But those who seek the LORD shall not lack any good thing.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 34:11: Psalms 34:11 Come, you children, listen to me;  I will teach you the fear of the LORD.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 34:12: Psalms 34:12 Who is the man who desires life, And loves many days, that he may see good?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 34:13: Psalms 34:13 Keep your tongue from evil, And your lips from speaking deceit.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 34:14: Psalms 34:14 Depart from evil and do good;  Seek peace and pursue it.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 34:15: Psalms 34:15 The eyes of the LORD are on the righteous, And His ears are open to their cry.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 34:16: Psalms 34:16 The face of the LORD is against those who do evil,  To cut off the remembrance of them from the earth.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 34:17: Psalms 34:17 The righteous cry out, and the LORD hears, And delivers them out of all their troubles.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 34:18: Psalms 34:18 The LORD is near to those who have a broken heart, And saves such as have a contrite spirit.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 34:19: Psalms 34:19 Many are the afflictions of the righteous,  But the LORD delivers him out of them all.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 34:20: Psalms 34:20 He guards all his bones;  Not one of them is broken.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 34:21: Psalms 34:21 Evil shall slay the wicked, And those who hate the righteous shall be condemned.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 34:22: Psalms 34:22 The LORD redeems the soul of His servants, And none of those who trust in Him shall be condemned.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 35:1: Psalms 35:1 A Psalm of David.   Plead my cause, O LORD, with those who strive with me; Fight against those who fight against me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 35:2: Psalms 35:2 Take hold of shield and buckler, And stand up for my help.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 35:3: Psalms 35:3 Also draw out the spear, And stop those who pursue me. Say to my soul, "I am your salvation."(NKJV)
verses.psalms 35:4: Psalms 35:4 Let those be put to shame and brought to dishonor Who seek after my life; Let those be turned back and brought to confusion Who plot my hurt.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 35:5: Psalms 35:5 Let them be like chaff before the wind, And let the angel of the LORD chase them.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 35:6: Psalms 35:6 Let their way be dark and slippery, And let the angel of the LORD pursue them.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 35:7: Psalms 35:7 For without cause they have hidden their net for me in a pit, Which they have dug without cause for my life.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 35:8: Psalms 35:8 Let destruction come upon him unexpectedly, And let his net that he has hidden catch himself; Into that very destruction let him fall.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 35:9: Psalms 35:9 And my soul shall be joyful in the LORD; It shall rejoice in His salvation.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 35:10: Psalms 35:10 All my bones shall say, "LORD, who is like You, Delivering the poor from him who is too strong for him, Yes, the poor and the needy from him who plunders him?"(NKJV)
verses.psalms 35:11: Psalms 35:11 Fierce witnesses rise up; They ask me things that I do not know.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 35:12: Psalms 35:12 They reward me evil for good, To the sorrow of my soul.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 35:13: Psalms 35:13 But as for me, when they were sick, My clothing was sackcloth; I humbled myself with fasting; And my prayer would return to my own heart.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 35:14: Psalms 35:14 I paced about as though he were my friend or brother; I bowed down heavily, as one who mourns for his mother.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 35:15: Psalms 35:15 But in my adversity they rejoiced And gathered together; Attackers gathered against me, And I did not know it; They tore at me and did not cease;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 35:16: Psalms 35:16 With ungodly mockers at feasts They gnashed at me with their teeth.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 35:17: Psalms 35:17 Lord, how long will You look on? Rescue me from their destructions, My precious life from the lions.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 35:18: Psalms 35:18 I will give You thanks in the great assembly; I will praise You among many people.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 35:19: Psalms 35:19 Let them not rejoice over me who are wrongfully my enemies; Nor let them wink with the eye who hate me without a cause.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 35:20: Psalms 35:20 For they do not speak peace, But they devise deceitful matters Against the quiet ones in the land.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 35:21: Psalms 35:21 They also opened their mouth wide against me, And said, "Aha, aha! Our eyes have seen it."(NKJV)
verses.psalms 35:22: Psalms 35:22 This You have seen, O LORD; Do not keep silence. O Lord, do not be far from me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 35:23: Psalms 35:23 Stir up Yourself, and awake to my vindication, To my cause, my God and my Lord.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 35:24: Psalms 35:24 Vindicate me, O LORD my God, according to Your righteousness; And let them not rejoice over me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 35:25: Psalms 35:25 Let them not say in their hearts, "Ah, so we would have it!" Let them not say, "We have swallowed him up."(NKJV)
verses.psalms 35:26: Psalms 35:26 Let them be ashamed and brought to mutual confusion Who rejoice at my hurt; Let them be clothed with shame and dishonor Who exalt themselves against me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 35:27: Psalms 35:27 Let them shout for joy and be glad, Who favor my righteous cause; And let them say continually, "Let the LORD be magnified, Who has pleasure in the prosperity of His servant."(NKJV)
verses.psalms 35:28: Psalms 35:28 And my tongue shall speak of Your righteousness And of Your praise all the day long.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 36:1: Psalms 36:1 To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David the servant of the LORD.   An oracle within my heart concerning the transgression of the wicked:  There is no fear of God before his eyes.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 36:2: Psalms 36:2 For he flatters himself in his own eyes, When he finds out his iniquity and when he hates.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 36:3: Psalms 36:3 The words of his mouth are wickedness and deceit;  He has ceased to be wise and to do good.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 36:4: Psalms 36:4 He devises wickedness on his bed; He sets himself in a way that is not good; He does not abhor evil.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 36:5: Psalms 36:5 Your mercy, O LORD, is in the heavens; Your faithfulness reaches to the clouds.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 36:6: Psalms 36:6 Your righteousness is like the great mountains;  Your judgments are a great deep; O LORD, You preserve man and beast.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 36:7: Psalms 36:7 How precious is Your lovingkindness, O God! Therefore the children of men put their trust under the shadow of Your wings.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 36:8: Psalms 36:8 They are abundantly satisfied with the fullness of Your house, And You give them drink from the river of Your pleasures.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 36:9: Psalms 36:9 For with You is the fountain of life;  In Your light we see light.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 36:10: Psalms 36:10 Oh, continue Your lovingkindness to those who know You, And Your righteousness to the upright in heart.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 36:11: Psalms 36:11 Let not the foot of pride come against me, And let not the hand of the wicked drive me away.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 36:12: Psalms 36:12 There the workers of iniquity have fallen; They have been cast down and are not able to rise.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 37:1: Psalms 37:1 A Psalm of David.   Do  not fret because of evildoers, Nor be envious of the workers of iniquity.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 37:2: Psalms 37:2 For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, And wither as the green herb.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 37:3: Psalms 37:3 Trust in the LORD, and do good; Dwell in the land, and feed on His faithfulness.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 37:4: Psalms 37:4 Delight yourself also in the LORD, And He shall give you the desires of your heart.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 37:5: Psalms 37:5 Commit your way to the LORD, Trust also in Him, And He shall bring it to pass.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 37:6: Psalms 37:6 He shall bring forth your righteousness as the light, And your justice as the noonday.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 37:7: Psalms 37:7 Rest in the LORD, and wait patiently for Him; Do not fret because of him who prospers in his way, Because of the man who brings wicked schemes to pass.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 37:8: Psalms 37:8 Cease from anger, and forsake wrath;  Do not fret"”it only causes harm.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 37:9: Psalms 37:9 For evildoers shall be cut off; But those who wait on the LORD, They shall inherit the earth.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 37:10: Psalms 37:10 For yet a little while and the wicked shall be no more; Indeed, you will look carefully for his place, But it shall be no more.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 37:11: Psalms 37:11 But the meek shall inherit the earth, And shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 37:12: Psalms 37:12 The wicked plots against the just,  And gnashes at him with his teeth.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 37:13: Psalms 37:13 The Lord laughs at him, For He sees that his day is coming.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 37:14: Psalms 37:14 The wicked have drawn the sword And have bent their bow, To cast down the poor and needy, To slay those who are of upright conduct.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 37:15: Psalms 37:15 Their sword shall enter their own heart, And their bows shall be broken.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 37:16: Psalms 37:16 A little that a righteous man has Is better than the riches of many wicked.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 37:17: Psalms 37:17 For the arms of the wicked shall be broken, But the LORD upholds the righteous.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 37:18: Psalms 37:18 The LORD knows the days of the upright, And their inheritance shall be forever.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 37:19: Psalms 37:19 They shall not be ashamed in the evil time, And in the days of famine they shall be satisfied.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 37:20: Psalms 37:20 But the wicked shall perish; And the enemies of the LORD, Like the splendor of the meadows, shall vanish. Into smoke they shall vanish away.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 37:21: Psalms 37:21 The wicked borrows and does not repay, But the righteous shows mercy and gives.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 37:22: Psalms 37:22 For those blessed by Him shall inherit the earth, But those cursed by Him shall be cut off.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 37:23: Psalms 37:23 The steps of a good man are ordered by the LORD, And He delights in his way.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 37:24: Psalms 37:24 Though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down; For the LORD upholds him with His hand.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 37:25: Psalms 37:25 I have been young, and now am old; Yet I have not seen the righteous forsaken, Nor his descendants begging bread.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 37:26: Psalms 37:26 He is ever merciful, and lends; And his descendants are blessed.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 37:27: Psalms 37:27 Depart from evil, and do good; And dwell forevermore.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 37:28: Psalms 37:28 For the LORD loves justice, And does not forsake His saints; They are preserved forever, But the descendants of the wicked shall be cut off.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 37:29: Psalms 37:29 The righteous shall inherit the land, And dwell in it forever.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 37:30: Psalms 37:30 The mouth of the righteous speaks wisdom, And his tongue talks of justice.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 37:31: Psalms 37:31 The law of his God is in his heart; None of his steps shall slide.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 37:32: Psalms 37:32 The wicked watches the righteous, And seeks to slay him.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 37:33: Psalms 37:33 The LORD will not leave him in his hand, Nor condemn him when he is judged.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 37:34: Psalms 37:34 Wait on the LORD, And keep His way, And He shall exalt you to inherit the land; When the wicked are cut off, you shall see it.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 37:35: Psalms 37:35 I have seen the wicked in great power, And spreading himself like a native green tree.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 37:36: Psalms 37:36 Yet he passed away, and behold, he was no more; Indeed I sought him, but he could not be found.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 37:37: Psalms 37:37 Mark the blameless man, and observe the upright; For the future of that man is peace.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 37:38: Psalms 37:38 But the transgressors shall be destroyed together; The future of the wicked shall be cut off.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 37:39: Psalms 37:39 But the salvation of the righteous is from the LORD; He is their strength in the time of trouble.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 37:40: Psalms 37:40 And the LORD shall help them and deliver them; He shall deliver them from the wicked, And save them,  Because they trust in Him.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 38:1: Psalms 38:1 A Psalm of David. To bring to remembrance.   O LORD, do not rebuke me in Your wrath, Nor chasten me in Your hot displeasure!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 38:2: Psalms 38:2 For Your arrows pierce me deeply, And Your hand presses me down.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 38:3: Psalms 38:3 There is no soundness in my flesh Because of Your anger, Nor any health in my bones Because of my sin.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 38:4: Psalms 38:4 For my iniquities have gone over my head; Like a heavy burden they are too heavy for me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 38:5: Psalms 38:5 My wounds are foul and festering Because of my foolishness.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 38:6: Psalms 38:6 I am troubled, I am bowed down greatly; I go mourning all the day long.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 38:7: Psalms 38:7 For my loins are full of inflammation, And there is no soundness in my flesh.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 38:8: Psalms 38:8 I am feeble and severely broken; I groan because of the turmoil of my heart.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 38:9: Psalms 38:9 Lord, all my desire is before You; And my sighing is not hidden from You.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 38:10: Psalms 38:10 My heart pants, my strength fails me; As for the light of my eyes, it also has gone from me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 38:11: Psalms 38:11 My loved ones and my friends stand aloof from my plague, And my relatives stand afar off.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 38:12: Psalms 38:12 Those also who seek my life lay snares for me; Those who seek my hurt speak of destruction, And plan deception all the day long.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 38:13: Psalms 38:13 But I, like a deaf man, do not hear; And I am like a mute who does not open his mouth.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 38:14: Psalms 38:14 Thus I am like a man who does not hear, And in whose mouth is no response.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 38:15: Psalms 38:15 For in You, O LORD, I hope; You will hear, O Lord my God.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 38:16: Psalms 38:16 For I said, "Hear me, lest they rejoice over me, Lest, when my foot slips, they exalt themselves against me."(NKJV)
verses.psalms 38:17: Psalms 38:17 For I am ready to fall, And my sorrow is continually before me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 38:18: Psalms 38:18 For I will declare my iniquity; I will be in anguish over my sin.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 38:19: Psalms 38:19 But my enemies are vigorous, and they are strong; And those who hate me wrongfully have multiplied.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 38:20: Psalms 38:20 Those also who render evil for good, They are my adversaries, because I follow what is good.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 38:21: Psalms 38:21 Do not forsake me, O LORD; O my God, be not far from me!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 38:22: Psalms 38:22 Make haste to help me, O Lord, my salvation!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 39:1: Psalms 39:1 To the Chief Musician. To Jeduthun. A Psalm of David.   I said, "I will guard my ways, Lest I sin with my tongue; I will restrain my mouth with a muzzle, While the wicked are before me."(NKJV)
verses.psalms 39:2: Psalms 39:2 I was mute with silence, I held my peace even from good; And my sorrow was stirred up.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 39:3: Psalms 39:3 My heart was hot within me; While I was musing, the fire burned. Then I spoke with my tongue:(NKJV)
verses.psalms 39:4: Psalms 39:4 "LORD, make me to know my end, And what is the measure of my days, That I may know how frail I am.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 39:5: Psalms 39:5 Indeed, You have made my days as handbreadths, And my age is as nothing before You; Certainly every man at his best state is but vapor.  Selah(NKJV)
verses.psalms 39:6: Psalms 39:6 Surely every man walks about like a shadow; Surely they busy themselves in vain; He heaps up riches, And does not know who will gather them.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 39:7: Psalms 39:7 "And now, Lord, what do I wait for? My hope is in You.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 39:8: Psalms 39:8 Deliver me from all my transgressions; Do not make me the reproach of the foolish.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 39:9: Psalms 39:9 I was mute, I did not open my mouth, Because it was You who did it.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 39:10: Psalms 39:10 Remove Your plague from me; I am consumed by the blow of Your hand.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 39:11: Psalms 39:11 When with rebukes You correct man for iniquity, You make his beauty melt away like a moth; Surely every man is vapor.  Selah(NKJV)
verses.psalms 39:12: Psalms 39:12 "Hear my prayer, O LORD, And give ear to my cry; Do not be silent at my tears; For I am a stranger with You, A sojourner, as all my fathers were.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 39:13: Psalms 39:13 Remove Your gaze from me, that I may regain strength, Before I go away and am no more."(NKJV)
verses.psalms 40:1: Psalms 40:1 To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David.   I waited patiently for the LORD; And He inclined to me, And heard my cry.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 40:2: Psalms 40:2 He also brought me up out of a horrible pit, Out of the miry clay, And set my feet upon a rock, And established my steps.(NKJV)
