verses.psalms 40:3: Psalms 40:3 He has put a new song in my mouth"” Praise to our God; Many will see it and fear, And will trust in the LORD.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 40:4: Psalms 40:4 Blessed is that man who makes the LORD his trust, And does not respect the proud, nor such as turn aside to lies.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 40:5: Psalms 40:5 Many, O LORD my God, are Your wonderful works Which You have done;  And Your thoughts toward us Cannot be recounted to You in order; If I would declare and speak of them, They are more than can be numbered.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 40:6: Psalms 40:6 Sacrifice and offering You did not desire; My ears You have opened. Burnt offering and sin offering You did not require.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 40:7: Psalms 40:7 Then I said, "Behold, I come; In the scroll of the book it is written of me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 40:8: Psalms 40:8 I delight to do Your will, O my God, And Your law is within my heart."(NKJV)
verses.psalms 40:9: Psalms 40:9 I have proclaimed the good news of righteousness In the great assembly; Indeed, I do not restrain my lips, O LORD, You Yourself know.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 40:10: Psalms 40:10 I have not hidden Your righteousness within my heart; I have declared Your faithfulness and Your salvation; I have not concealed Your lovingkindness and Your truth From the great assembly.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 40:11: Psalms 40:11 Do not withhold Your tender mercies from me, O LORD;  Let Your lovingkindness and Your truth continually preserve me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 40:12: Psalms 40:12 For innumerable evils have surrounded me;  My iniquities have overtaken me, so that I am not able to look up; They are more than the hairs of my head; Therefore my heart fails me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 40:13: Psalms 40:13 Be pleased, O LORD, to deliver me; O LORD, make haste to help me!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 40:14: Psalms 40:14 Let them be ashamed and brought to mutual confusion Who seek to destroy my life; Let them be driven backward and brought to dishonor Who wish me evil.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 40:15: Psalms 40:15 Let them be confounded because of their shame, Who say to me, "Aha, aha!"(NKJV)
verses.psalms 40:16: Psalms 40:16 Let all those who seek You rejoice and be glad in You; Let such as love Your salvation say continually, "The LORD be magnified!"(NKJV)
verses.psalms 40:17: Psalms 40:17 But I am poor and needy;  Yet the LORD thinks upon me. You are my help and my deliverer; Do not delay, O my God.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 41:1: Psalms 41:1 To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David.   Blessed is he who considers the poor; The LORD will deliver him in time of trouble.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 41:2: Psalms 41:2 The LORD will preserve him and keep him alive, And he will be blessed on the earth;  You will not deliver him to the will of his enemies.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 41:3: Psalms 41:3 The LORD will strengthen him on his bed of illness; You will sustain him on his sickbed.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 41:4: Psalms 41:4 I said, "LORD, be merciful to me;  Heal my soul, for I have sinned against You."(NKJV)
verses.psalms 41:5: Psalms 41:5 My enemies speak evil of me: "When will he die, and his name perish?"(NKJV)
verses.psalms 41:6: Psalms 41:6 And if he comes to see me, he speaks lies; His heart gathers iniquity to itself; When he goes out, he tells it.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 41:7: Psalms 41:7 All who hate me whisper together against me; Against me they devise my hurt.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 41:8: Psalms 41:8 "An evil disease," they say, "clings to him. And now that he lies down, he will rise up no more."(NKJV)
verses.psalms 41:9: Psalms 41:9 Even my own familiar friend in whom I trusted,  Who ate my bread, Has lifted up his heel against me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 41:10: Psalms 41:10 But You, O LORD, be merciful to me, and raise me up, That I may repay them.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 41:11: Psalms 41:11 By this I know that You are well pleased with me, Because my enemy does not triumph over me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 41:12: Psalms 41:12 As for me, You uphold me in my integrity, And set me before Your face forever.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 41:13: Psalms 41:13 Blessed be the LORD God of Israel From everlasting to everlasting! Amen and Amen.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 42:1: Psalms 42:1 To the Chief Musician. A Contemplation of the sons of Korah.   As the deer pants for the water brooks, So pants my soul for You, O God.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 42:2: Psalms 42:2 My soul thirsts for God, for the living God. When shall I come and appear before God?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 42:3: Psalms 42:3 My tears have been my food day and night, While they continually say to me,  "Where is your God?"(NKJV)
verses.psalms 42:4: Psalms 42:4 When I remember these things,  I pour out my soul within me. For I used to go with the multitude;  I went with them to the house of God, With the voice of joy and praise, With a multitude that kept a pilgrim feast.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 42:5: Psalms 42:5 Why are you cast down, O my soul? And why are you disquieted within me?  Hope in God, for I shall yet praise Him For the help of His countenance.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 42:6: Psalms 42:6 O my God, my soul is cast down within me; Therefore I will remember You from the land of the Jordan, And from the heights of Hermon, From the Hill Mizar.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 42:7: Psalms 42:7 Deep calls unto deep at the noise of Your waterfalls;  All Your waves and billows have gone over me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 42:8: Psalms 42:8 The LORD will command His lovingkindness in the daytime, And in the night His song shall be with me"” A prayer to the God of my life.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 42:9: Psalms 42:9 I will say to God my Rock,  "Why have You forgotten me? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?"(NKJV)
verses.psalms 42:10: Psalms 42:10 As with a breaking of my bones, My enemies reproach me,  While they say to me all day long, "Where is your God?"(NKJV)
verses.psalms 42:11: Psalms 42:11 Why are you cast down, O my soul? And why are you disquieted within me? Hope in God; For I shall yet praise Him, The help of my countenance and my God.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 43:1: Psalms 43:1 Vindicate me, O God, And plead my cause against an ungodly nation; Oh, deliver me from the deceitful and unjust man!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 43:2: Psalms 43:2 For You are the God of my strength; Why do You cast me off?  Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 43:3: Psalms 43:3 Oh, send out Your light and Your truth! Let them lead me; Let them bring me to Your holy hill And to Your tabernacle.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 43:4: Psalms 43:4 Then I will go to the altar of God, To God my exceeding joy; And on the harp I will praise You, O God, my God.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 43:5: Psalms 43:5 Why are you cast down, O my soul? And why are you disquieted within me? Hope in God; For I shall yet praise Him, The help of my countenance and my God.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 44:1: Psalms 44:1 To the Chief Musician. A Contemplation of the sons of Korah.   We have heard with our ears, O God,  Our fathers have told us, The deeds You did in their days, In days of old:(NKJV)
verses.psalms 44:2: Psalms 44:2 You drove out the nations with Your hand, But them You planted; You afflicted the peoples, and cast them out.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 44:3: Psalms 44:3 For they did not gain possession of the land by their own sword, Nor did their own arm save them; But it was Your right hand, Your arm, and the light of Your countenance,  Because You favored them.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 44:4: Psalms 44:4 You are my King, O God; Command victories for Jacob.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 44:5: Psalms 44:5 Through You we will push down our enemies; Through Your name we will trample those who rise up against us.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 44:6: Psalms 44:6 For I will not trust in my bow, Nor shall my sword save me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 44:7: Psalms 44:7 But You have saved us from our enemies, And have put to shame those who hated us.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 44:8: Psalms 44:8 In God we boast all day long, And praise Your name forever.  Selah(NKJV)
verses.psalms 44:9: Psalms 44:9 But You have cast us off and put us to shame, And You do not go out with our armies.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 44:10: Psalms 44:10 You make us turn back from the enemy, And those who hate us have taken spoil for themselves.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 44:11: Psalms 44:11 You have given us up like sheep intended for food, And have scattered us among the nations.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 44:12: Psalms 44:12 You sell Your people for next to nothing, And are not enriched by selling them.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 44:13: Psalms 44:13 You make us a reproach to our neighbors, A scorn and a derision to those all around us.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 44:14: Psalms 44:14 You make us a byword among the nations,  A shaking of the head among the peoples.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 44:15: Psalms 44:15 My dishonor is continually before me, And the shame of my face has covered me,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 44:16: Psalms 44:16 Because of the voice of him who reproaches and reviles,  Because of the enemy and the avenger.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 44:17: Psalms 44:17 All this has come upon us; But we have not forgotten You, Nor have we dealt falsely with Your covenant.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 44:18: Psalms 44:18 Our heart has not turned back,  Nor have our steps departed from Your way;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 44:19: Psalms 44:19 But You have severely broken us in the place of jackals, And covered us with the shadow of death.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 44:20: Psalms 44:20 If we had forgotten the name of our God, Or stretched out our hands to a foreign god,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 44:21: Psalms 44:21 Would not God search this out? For He knows the secrets of the heart.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 44:22: Psalms 44:22 Yet for Your sake we are killed all day long; We are accounted as sheep for the slaughter.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 44:23: Psalms 44:23 Awake! Why do You sleep, O Lord? Arise! Do not cast us off forever.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 44:24: Psalms 44:24 Why do You hide Your face, And forget our affliction and our oppression?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 44:25: Psalms 44:25 For our soul is bowed down to the dust; Our body clings to the ground.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 44:26: Psalms 44:26 Arise for our help, And redeem us for Your mercies' sake.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 45:1: Psalms 45:1 To the Chief Musician. Set to "The Lilies." A Contemplation of the sons of Korah. A Song of Love.   My heart is overflowing with a good theme; I recite my composition concerning the King; My tongue is the pen of a ready writer.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 45:2: Psalms 45:2 You are fairer than the sons of men;  Grace is poured upon Your lips; Therefore God has blessed You forever.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 45:3: Psalms 45:3 Gird Your sword upon Your thigh, O Mighty One, With Your glory and Your majesty.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 45:4: Psalms 45:4 And in Your majesty ride prosperously because of truth, humility, and righteousness; And Your right hand shall teach You awesome things.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 45:5: Psalms 45:5 Your arrows are sharp in the heart of the King's enemies; The peoples fall under You.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 45:6: Psalms 45:6 Your throne, O God, is forever and ever; A scepter of righteousness is the scepter of Your kingdom.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 45:7: Psalms 45:7 You love righteousness and hate wickedness; Therefore God, Your God, has anointed You With the oil of gladness more than Your companions.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 45:8: Psalms 45:8 All Your garments are scented with myrrh and aloes and cassia, Out of the ivory palaces, by which they have made You glad.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 45:9: Psalms 45:9 Kings' daughters are among Your honorable women;  At Your right hand stands the queen in gold from Ophir.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 45:10: Psalms 45:10 Listen, O daughter, Consider and incline your ear;  Forget your own people also, and your father's house;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 45:11: Psalms 45:11 So the King will greatly desire your beauty;  Because He is your Lord, worship Him.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 45:12: Psalms 45:12 And the daughter of Tyre will come with a gift;  The rich among the people will seek your favor.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 45:13: Psalms 45:13 The royal daughter is all glorious within the palace; Her clothing is woven with gold.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 45:14: Psalms 45:14 She shall be brought to the King in robes of many colors; The virgins, her companions who follow her, shall be brought to You.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 45:15: Psalms 45:15 With gladness and rejoicing they shall be brought; They shall enter the King's palace.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 45:16: Psalms 45:16 Instead of Your fathers shall be Your sons,  Whom You shall make princes in all the earth.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 45:17: Psalms 45:17 I will make Your name to be remembered in all generations; Therefore the people shall praise You forever and ever.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 46:1: Psalms 46:1 To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of the sons of Korah. A Song for Alamoth.   God is our refuge and strength,  A very present help in trouble.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 46:2: Psalms 46:2 Therefore we will not fear, Even though the earth be removed, And though the mountains be carried into the midst of the sea;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 46:3: Psalms 46:3 Though its waters roar and be troubled, Though the mountains shake with its swelling.  Selah(NKJV)
verses.psalms 46:4: Psalms 46:4 There is a river whose streams shall make glad the city of God, The holy place of the tabernacle of the Most High.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 46:5: Psalms 46:5 God is in the midst of her, she shall not be moved; God shall help her, just at the break of dawn.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 46:6: Psalms 46:6 The nations raged, the kingdoms were moved; He uttered His voice, the earth melted.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 46:7: Psalms 46:7 The LORD of hosts is with us; The God of Jacob is our refuge.  Selah(NKJV)
verses.psalms 46:8: Psalms 46:8 Come, behold the works of the LORD, Who has made desolations in the earth.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 46:9: Psalms 46:9 He makes wars cease to the end of the earth;  He breaks the bow and cuts the spear in two;  He burns the chariot in the fire.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 46:10: Psalms 46:10 Be still, and know that I am God;  I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted in the earth!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 46:11: Psalms 46:11 The LORD of hosts is with us; The God of Jacob is our refuge.  Selah(NKJV)
verses.psalms 47:1: Psalms 47:1 To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of the sons of Korah.   Oh, clap your hands, all you peoples! Shout to God with the voice of triumph!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 47:2: Psalms 47:2 For the LORD Most High is awesome; He is a great King over all the earth.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 47:3: Psalms 47:3 He will subdue the peoples under us, And the nations under our feet.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 47:4: Psalms 47:4 He will choose our inheritance for us, The excellence of Jacob whom He loves.  Selah(NKJV)
verses.psalms 47:5: Psalms 47:5 God has gone up with a shout, The LORD with the sound of a trumpet.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 47:6: Psalms 47:6 Sing praises to God, sing praises! Sing praises to our King, sing praises!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 47:7: Psalms 47:7 For God is the King of all the earth;  Sing praises with understanding.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 47:8: Psalms 47:8 God reigns over the nations; God sits on His holy throne.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 47:9: Psalms 47:9 The princes of the people have gathered together,  The people of the God of Abraham.  For the shields of the earth belong to God; He is greatly exalted.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 48:1: Psalms 48:1 A Song. A Psalm of the sons of Korah.   Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised In the city of our God, In His holy mountain.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 48:2: Psalms 48:2 Beautiful in elevation, The joy of the whole earth, Is Mount Zion on the sides of the north, The city of the great King.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 48:3: Psalms 48:3 God is in her palaces; He is known as her refuge.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 48:4: Psalms 48:4 For behold, the kings assembled, They passed by together.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 48:5: Psalms 48:5 They saw it, and so they marveled; They were troubled, they hastened away.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 48:6: Psalms 48:6 Fear took hold of them there, And pain, as of a woman in birth pangs,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 48:7: Psalms 48:7 As when You break the ships of Tarshish With an east wind.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 48:8: Psalms 48:8 As we have heard, So we have seen In the city of the LORD of hosts, In the city of our God: God will establish it forever.  Selah(NKJV)
verses.psalms 48:9: Psalms 48:9 We have thought, O God, on Your lovingkindness, In the midst of Your temple.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 48:10: Psalms 48:10 According to Your name, O God, So is Your praise to the ends of the earth; Your right hand is full of righteousness.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 48:11: Psalms 48:11 Let Mount Zion rejoice, Let the daughters of Judah be glad, Because of Your judgments.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 48:12: Psalms 48:12 Walk about Zion, And go all around her. Count her towers;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 48:13: Psalms 48:13 Mark well her bulwarks; Consider her palaces; That you may tell it to the generation following.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 48:14: Psalms 48:14 For this is God, Our God forever and ever;  He will be our guide Even to death.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 49:1: Psalms 49:1 To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of the sons of Korah.   Hear this, all peoples; Give ear, all inhabitants of the world,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 49:2: Psalms 49:2 Both low and high, Rich and poor together.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 49:3: Psalms 49:3 My mouth shall speak wisdom, And the meditation of my heart shall give understanding.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 49:4: Psalms 49:4 I will incline my ear to a proverb; I will disclose my dark saying on the harp.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 49:5: Psalms 49:5 Why should I fear in the days of evil, When the iniquity at my heels surrounds me?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 49:6: Psalms 49:6 Those who trust in their wealth And boast in the multitude of their riches,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 49:7: Psalms 49:7 None of them can by any means redeem his brother, Nor give to God a ransom for him"”(NKJV)
verses.psalms 49:8: Psalms 49:8 For the redemption of their souls is costly, And it shall cease forever"”(NKJV)
verses.psalms 49:9: Psalms 49:9 That he should continue to live eternally, And not see the Pit.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 49:10: Psalms 49:10 For he sees wise men die; Likewise the fool and the senseless person perish, And leave their wealth to others.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 49:11: Psalms 49:11 Their inner thought is that their houses will last forever, Their dwelling places to all generations; They call their lands after their own names.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 49:12: Psalms 49:12 Nevertheless man, though in honor, does not remain; He is like the beasts that perish.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 49:13: Psalms 49:13 This is the way of those who are foolish, And of their posterity who approve their sayings.  Selah(NKJV)
verses.psalms 49:14: Psalms 49:14 Like sheep they are laid in the grave; Death shall feed on them;  The upright shall have dominion over them in the morning;  And their beauty shall be consumed in the grave, far from their dwelling.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 49:15: Psalms 49:15 But God will redeem my soul from the power of the grave, For He shall receive me.  Selah(NKJV)
verses.psalms 49:16: Psalms 49:16 Do not be afraid when one becomes rich, When the glory of his house is increased;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 49:17: Psalms 49:17 For when he dies he shall carry nothing away; His glory shall not descend after him.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 49:18: Psalms 49:18 Though while he lives he blesses himself (For men will praise you when you do well for yourself),(NKJV)
verses.psalms 49:19: Psalms 49:19 He shall go to the generation of his fathers; They shall never see light.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 49:20: Psalms 49:20 A man who is in honor, yet does not understand,  Is like the beasts that perish.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 50:1: Psalms 50:1 A Psalm of Asaph.   The Mighty One, God the LORD, Has spoken and called the earth From the rising of the sun to its going down.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 50:2: Psalms 50:2 Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty,  God will shine forth.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 50:3: Psalms 50:3 Our God shall come, and shall not keep silent;  A fire shall devour before Him, And it shall be very tempestuous all around Him.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 50:4: Psalms 50:4 He shall call to the heavens from above, And to the earth, that He may judge His people:(NKJV)
verses.psalms 50:5: Psalms 50:5 "Gather My saints together to Me,  Those who have made a covenant with Me by sacrifice."(NKJV)
verses.psalms 50:6: Psalms 50:6 Let the heavens declare His righteousness, For God Himself is Judge.  Selah(NKJV)
verses.psalms 50:7: Psalms 50:7 "Hear, O My people, and I will speak, O Israel, and I will testify against you;  I am God, your God!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 50:8: Psalms 50:8 I will not rebuke you for your sacrifices Or your burnt offerings, Which are continually before Me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 50:9: Psalms 50:9 I will not take a bull from your house, Nor goats out of your folds.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 50:10: Psalms 50:10 For every beast of the forest is Mine, And the cattle on a thousand hills.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 50:11: Psalms 50:11 I know all the birds of the mountains, And the wild beasts of the field are Mine.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 50:12: Psalms 50:12 "If I were hungry, I would not tell you;  For the world is Mine, and all its fullness.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 50:13: Psalms 50:13 Will I eat the flesh of bulls, Or drink the blood of goats?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 50:14: Psalms 50:14 Offer to God thanksgiving, And pay your vows to the Most High.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 50:15: Psalms 50:15 Call upon Me in the day of trouble; I will deliver you, and you shall glorify Me."(NKJV)
verses.psalms 50:16: Psalms 50:16 But to the wicked God says: "What right have you to declare My statutes, Or take My covenant in your mouth,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 50:17: Psalms 50:17 Seeing you hate instruction And cast My words behind you?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 50:18: Psalms 50:18 When you saw a thief, you consented with him, And have been a partaker with adulterers.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 50:19: Psalms 50:19 You give your mouth to evil, And your tongue frames deceit.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 50:20: Psalms 50:20 You sit and speak against your brother; You slander your own mother's son.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 50:21: Psalms 50:21 These things you have done, and I kept silent;  You thought that I was altogether like you; But I will rebuke you, And set them in order before your eyes.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 50:22: Psalms 50:22 "Now consider this, you who forget God, Lest I tear you in pieces, And there be none to deliver:(NKJV)
verses.psalms 50:23: Psalms 50:23 Whoever offers praise glorifies Me; And to him who orders his conduct aright I will show the salvation of God."(NKJV)
verses.psalms 51:1: Psalms 51:1 To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David when Nathan the prophet went to him, after he had gone in to Bathsheba.   Have mercy upon me, O God, According to Your lovingkindness; According to the multitude of Your tender mercies,  Blot out my transgressions.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 51:2: Psalms 51:2 Wash me thoroughly from my iniquity, And cleanse me from my sin.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 51:3: Psalms 51:3 For I acknowledge my transgressions, And my sin is always before me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 51:4: Psalms 51:4 Against You, You only, have I sinned, And done this evil in Your sight"”  That You may be found just when You speak, And blameless when You judge.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 51:5: Psalms 51:5 Behold, I was brought forth in iniquity, And in sin my mother conceived me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 51:6: Psalms 51:6 Behold, You desire truth in the inward parts, And in the hidden part You will make me to know wisdom.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 51:7: Psalms 51:7 Purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean; Wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 51:8: Psalms 51:8 Make me hear joy and gladness, That the bones You have broken may rejoice.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 51:9: Psalms 51:9 Hide Your face from my sins, And blot out all my iniquities.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 51:10: Psalms 51:10 Create in me a clean heart, O God, And renew a steadfast spirit within me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 51:11: Psalms 51:11 Do not cast me away from Your presence, And do not take Your Holy Spirit from me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 51:12: Psalms 51:12 Restore to me the joy of Your salvation, And uphold me by Your generous Spirit.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 51:13: Psalms 51:13 Then I will teach transgressors Your ways, And sinners shall be converted to You.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 51:14: Psalms 51:14 Deliver me from the guilt of bloodshed, O God, The God of my salvation, And my tongue shall sing aloud of Your righteousness.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 51:15: Psalms 51:15 O Lord, open my lips, And my mouth shall show forth Your praise.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 51:16: Psalms 51:16 For You do not desire sacrifice, or else I would give it; You do not delight in burnt offering.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 51:17: Psalms 51:17 The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit, A broken and a contrite heart"” These, O God, You will not despise.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 51:18: Psalms 51:18 Do good in Your good pleasure to Zion; Build the walls of Jerusalem.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 51:19: Psalms 51:19 Then You shall be pleased with the sacrifices of righteousness, With burnt offering and whole burnt offering; Then they shall offer bulls on Your altar.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 52:1: Psalms 52:1 To the Chief Musician. A Contemplation of David when Doeg the Edomite went and told Saul, and said to him, "David has gone to the house of Ahimelech."   Why do you boast in evil, O mighty man? The goodness of God endures continually.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 52:2: Psalms 52:2 Your tongue devises destruction, Like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 52:3: Psalms 52:3 You love evil more than good, Lying rather than speaking righteousness.  Selah(NKJV)
verses.psalms 52:4: Psalms 52:4 You love all devouring words, You deceitful tongue.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 52:5: Psalms 52:5 God shall likewise destroy you forever; He shall take you away, and pluck you out of your dwelling place, And uproot you from the land of the living.  Selah(NKJV)
verses.psalms 52:6: Psalms 52:6 The righteous also shall see and fear, And shall laugh at him, saying,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 52:7: Psalms 52:7 "Here is the man who did not make God his strength, But trusted in the abundance of his riches, And strengthened himself in his wickedness."(NKJV)
verses.psalms 52:8: Psalms 52:8 But I am like a green olive tree in the house of God; I trust in the mercy of God forever and ever.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 52:9: Psalms 52:9 I will praise You forever, Because You have done it; And in the presence of Your saints I will wait on Your name, for it is good.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 53:1: Psalms 53:1 To the Chief Musician. Set to "Mahalath." A Contemplation of David.   The fool has said in his heart, "There is no God." They are corrupt, and have done abominable iniquity;  There is none who does good.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 53:2: Psalms 53:2 God looks down from heaven upon the children of men, To see if there are any who understand, who seek God.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 53:3: Psalms 53:3 Every one of them has turned aside; They have together become corrupt; There is none who does good, No, not one.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 53:4: Psalms 53:4 Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge, Who eat up my people as they eat bread, And do not call upon God?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 53:5: Psalms 53:5 There they are in great fear Where no fear was, For God has scattered the bones of him who encamps against you; You have put them to shame, Because God has despised them.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 53:6: Psalms 53:6 Oh, that the salvation of Israel would come out of Zion! When God brings back the captivity of His people, Let Jacob rejoice and Israel be glad.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 54:1: Psalms 54:1 To the Chief Musician. With stringed instruments. A Contemplation of David when the Ziphites went and said to Saul, "Is David not hiding with us?"   Save me, O God, by Your name, And vindicate me by Your strength.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 54:2: Psalms 54:2 Hear my prayer, O God; Give ear to the words of my mouth.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 54:3: Psalms 54:3 For strangers have risen up against me, And oppressors have sought after my life; They have not set God before them.  Selah(NKJV)
verses.psalms 54:4: Psalms 54:4 Behold, God is my helper; The Lord is with those who uphold my life.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 54:5: Psalms 54:5 He will repay my enemies for their evil. Cut them off in Your truth.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 54:6: Psalms 54:6 I will freely sacrifice to You; I will praise Your name, O LORD, for it is good.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 54:7: Psalms 54:7 For He has delivered me out of all trouble;  And my eye has seen its desire upon my enemies.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 55:1: Psalms 55:1 To the Chief Musician. With stringed instruments. A Contemplation of David.   Give ear to my prayer, O God, And do not hide Yourself from my supplication.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 55:2: Psalms 55:2 Attend to me, and hear me; I am restless in my complaint, and moan noisily,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 55:3: Psalms 55:3 Because of the voice of the enemy, Because of the oppression of the wicked;  For they bring down trouble upon me, And in wrath they hate me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 55:4: Psalms 55:4 My heart is severely pained within me, And the terrors of death have fallen upon me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 55:5: Psalms 55:5 Fearfulness and trembling have come upon me, And horror has overwhelmed me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 55:6: Psalms 55:6 So I said, "Oh, that I had wings like a dove! I would fly away and be at rest.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 55:7: Psalms 55:7 Indeed, I would wander far off, And remain in the wilderness.  Selah(NKJV)
verses.psalms 55:8: Psalms 55:8 I would hasten my escape From the windy storm and tempest."(NKJV)
verses.psalms 55:9: Psalms 55:9 Destroy, O Lord, and divide their tongues, For I have seen violence and strife in the city.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 55:10: Psalms 55:10 Day and night they go around it on its walls;  Iniquity and trouble are also in the midst of it.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 55:11: Psalms 55:11 Destruction is in its midst;  Oppression and deceit do not depart from its streets.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 55:12: Psalms 55:12 For it is not an enemy who reproaches me; Then I could bear it. Nor is it one who hates me who has exalted himself against me; Then I could hide from him.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 55:13: Psalms 55:13 But it was you, a man my equal,  My companion and my acquaintance.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 55:14: Psalms 55:14 We took sweet counsel together, And walked to the house of God in the throng.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 55:15: Psalms 55:15 Let death seize them; Let them go down alive into hell, For wickedness is in their dwellings and among them.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 55:16: Psalms 55:16 As for me, I will call upon God, And the LORD shall save me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 55:17: Psalms 55:17 Evening and morning and at noon I will pray, and cry aloud, And He shall hear my voice.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 55:18: Psalms 55:18 He has redeemed my soul in peace from the battle that was against me, For there were many against me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 55:19: Psalms 55:19 God will hear, and afflict them,  Even He who abides from of old.  Selah Because they do not change, Therefore they do not fear God.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 55:20: Psalms 55:20 He has put forth his hands against those who were at peace with him; He has broken his covenant.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 55:21: Psalms 55:21 The words of his mouth were smoother than butter, But war was in his heart; His words were softer than oil, Yet they were drawn swords.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 55:22: Psalms 55:22 Cast your burden on the LORD, And He shall sustain you; He shall never permit the righteous to be moved.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 55:23: Psalms 55:23 But You, O God, shall bring them down to the pit of destruction;  Bloodthirsty and deceitful men shall not live out half their days; But I will trust in You.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 56:1: Psalms 56:1 To the Chief Musician. Set to "The Silent Dove in Distant Lands." A Michtam of David when the Philistines captured him in Gath.   Be merciful to me, O God, for man would swallow me up; Fighting all day he oppresses me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 56:2: Psalms 56:2 My enemies would hound me all day, For there are many who fight against me, O Most High.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 56:3: Psalms 56:3 Whenever I am afraid, I will trust in You.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 56:4: Psalms 56:4 In God (I will praise His word), In God I have put my trust;  I will not fear. What can flesh do to me?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 56:5: Psalms 56:5 All day they twist my words; All their thoughts are against me for evil.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 56:6: Psalms 56:6 They gather together, They hide, they mark my steps, When they lie in wait for my life.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 56:7: Psalms 56:7 Shall they escape by iniquity? In anger cast down the peoples, O God!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 56:8: Psalms 56:8 You number my wanderings; Put my tears into Your bottle;  Are they not in Your book?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 56:9: Psalms 56:9 When I cry out to You, Then my enemies will turn back; This I know, because God is for me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 56:10: Psalms 56:10 In God (I will praise His word), In the LORD (I will praise His word),(NKJV)
verses.psalms 56:11: Psalms 56:11 In God I have put my trust; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 56:12: Psalms 56:12 Vows made to You are binding upon me, O God; I will render praises to You,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 56:13: Psalms 56:13 For You have delivered my soul from death. Have You not kept my feet from falling, That I may walk before God In the light of the living?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 57:1: Psalms 57:1 To the Chief Musician. Set to "Do Not Destroy." A Michtam of David when he fled from Saul into the cave.   Be merciful to me, O God, be merciful to me! For my soul trusts in You;  And in the shadow of Your wings I will make my refuge,  Until these calamities have passed by.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 57:2: Psalms 57:2 I will cry out to God Most High, To God who performs all things for me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 57:3: Psalms 57:3 He shall send from heaven and save me; He reproaches the one who would swallow me up.  Selah God shall send forth His mercy and His truth.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 57:4: Psalms 57:4 My soul is among lions; I lie among the sons of men Who are set on fire,  Whose teeth are spears and arrows, And their tongue a sharp sword.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 57:5: Psalms 57:5 Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; Let Your glory be above all the earth.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 57:6: Psalms 57:6 They have prepared a net for my steps; My soul is bowed down; They have dug a pit before me; Into the midst of it they themselves have fallen.  Selah(NKJV)
verses.psalms 57:7: Psalms 57:7 My heart is steadfast, O God, my heart is steadfast; I will sing and give praise.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 57:8: Psalms 57:8 Awake, my glory! Awake, lute and harp! I will awaken the dawn.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 57:9: Psalms 57:9 I will praise You, O Lord, among the peoples; I will sing to You among the nations.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 57:10: Psalms 57:10 For Your mercy reaches unto the heavens, And Your truth unto the clouds.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 57:11: Psalms 57:11 Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; Let Your glory be above all the earth.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 58:1: Psalms 58:1 To the Chief Musician. Set to "Do Not Destroy." A Michtam of David.   Do you indeed speak righteousness, you silent ones? Do you judge uprightly, you sons of men?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 58:2: Psalms 58:2 No, in heart you work wickedness; You weigh out the violence of your hands in the earth.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 58:3: Psalms 58:3 The wicked are estranged from the womb; They go astray as soon as they are born, speaking lies.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 58:4: Psalms 58:4 Their poison is like the poison of a serpent; They are like the deaf cobra that stops its ear,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 58:5: Psalms 58:5 Which will not heed the voice of charmers, Charming ever so skillfully.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 58:6: Psalms 58:6 Break their teeth in their mouth, O God! Break out the fangs of the young lions, O LORD!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 58:7: Psalms 58:7 Let them flow away as waters which run continually; When he bends his bow, Let his arrows be as if cut in pieces.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 58:8: Psalms 58:8 Let them be like a snail which melts away as it goes,  Like a stillborn child of a woman, that they may not see the sun.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 58:9: Psalms 58:9 Before your pots can feel the burning thorns, He shall take them away as with a whirlwind, As in His living and burning wrath.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 58:10: Psalms 58:10 The righteous shall rejoice when he sees the vengeance;  He shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 58:11: Psalms 58:11 So that men will say, "Surely there is a reward for the righteous; Surely He is God who judges in the earth."(NKJV)
verses.psalms 59:1: Psalms 59:1 To the Chief Musician. Set to "Do Not Destroy." A Michtam of David when Saul sent men, and they watched the house in order to kill him.   Deliver me from my enemies, O my God; Defend me from those who rise up against me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 59:2: Psalms 59:2 Deliver me from the workers of iniquity, And save me from bloodthirsty men.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 59:3: Psalms 59:3 For look, they lie in wait for my life;  The mighty gather against me, Not for my transgression nor for my sin, O LORD.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 59:4: Psalms 59:4 They run and prepare themselves through no fault of mine.  Awake to help me, and behold!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 59:5: Psalms 59:5 You therefore, O LORD God of hosts, the God of Israel, Awake to punish all the nations; Do not be merciful to any wicked transgressors.  Selah(NKJV)
verses.psalms 59:6: Psalms 59:6 At evening they return, They growl like a dog, And go all around the city.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 59:7: Psalms 59:7 Indeed, they belch with their mouth;  Swords are in their lips; For they say, "Who hears?"(NKJV)
verses.psalms 59:8: Psalms 59:8 But You, O LORD, shall laugh at them; You shall have all the nations in derision.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 59:9: Psalms 59:9 I will wait for You, O You his Strength;  For God is my defense.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 59:10: Psalms 59:10 My God of mercy shall come to meet me; God shall let me see my desire on my enemies.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 59:11: Psalms 59:11 Do not slay them, lest my people forget; Scatter them by Your power, And bring them down, O Lord our shield.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 59:12: Psalms 59:12 For the sin of their mouth and the words of their lips, Let them even be taken in their pride, And for the cursing and lying which they speak.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 59:13: Psalms 59:13 Consume them in wrath, consume them, That they may not be; And let them know that God rules in Jacob To the ends of the earth.  Selah(NKJV)
verses.psalms 59:14: Psalms 59:14 And at evening they return, They growl like a dog, And go all around the city.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 59:15: Psalms 59:15 They wander up and down for food, And howl if they are not satisfied.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 59:16: Psalms 59:16 But I will sing of Your power; Yes, I will sing aloud of Your mercy in the morning; For You have been my defense And refuge in the day of my trouble.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 59:17: Psalms 59:17 To You, O my Strength, I will sing praises; For God is my defense, My God of mercy.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 60:1: Psalms 60:1 To the Chief Musician. Set to "Lily of the Testimony." A Michtam of David. For teaching. When he fought against Mesopotamia and Syria of Zobah, and Joab returned and killed twelve thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt.   O God, You have cast us off; You have broken us down; You have been displeased; Oh, restore us again!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 60:2: Psalms 60:2 You have made the earth tremble; You have broken it;  Heal its breaches, for it is shaking.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 60:3: Psalms 60:3 You have shown Your people hard things;  You have made us drink the wine of confusion.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 60:4: Psalms 60:4 You have given a banner to those who fear You, That it may be displayed because of the truth.  Selah(NKJV)
verses.psalms 60:5: Psalms 60:5 That Your beloved may be delivered, Save with Your right hand, and hear me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 60:6: Psalms 60:6 God has spoken in His holiness: "I will rejoice; I will divide Shechem And measure out the Valley of Succoth.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 60:7: Psalms 60:7 Gilead is Mine, and Manasseh is Mine;  Ephraim also is the helmet for My head;  Judah is My lawgiver.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 60:8: Psalms 60:8 Moab is My washpot;  Over Edom I will cast My shoe;  Philistia, shout in triumph because of Me."(NKJV)
verses.psalms 60:9: Psalms 60:9 Who will bring me to the strong city? Who will lead me to Edom?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 60:10: Psalms 60:10 Is it not You, O God, who cast us off? And You, O God, who did not go out with our armies?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 60:11: Psalms 60:11 Give us help from trouble,  For the help of man is useless.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 60:12: Psalms 60:12 Through God we will do valiantly, For it is He who shall tread down our enemies.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 61:1: Psalms 61:1 To the Chief Musician. On a stringed instrument. A Psalm of David.   Hear my cry, O God; Attend to my prayer.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 61:2: Psalms 61:2 From the end of the earth I will cry to You, When my heart is overwhelmed; Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 61:3: Psalms 61:3 For You have been a shelter for me,  A strong tower from the enemy.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 61:4: Psalms 61:4 I will abide in Your tabernacle forever;  I will trust in the shelter of Your wings.  Selah(NKJV)
verses.psalms 61:5: Psalms 61:5 For You, O God, have heard my vows; You have given me the heritage of those who fear Your name.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 61:6: Psalms 61:6 You will prolong the king's life, His years as many generations.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 61:7: Psalms 61:7 He shall abide before God forever. Oh, prepare mercy and truth, which may preserve him!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 61:8: Psalms 61:8 So I will sing praise to Your name forever, That I may daily perform my vows.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 62:1: Psalms 62:1 To the Chief Musician. To Jeduthun. A Psalm of David.   Truly my soul silently waits for God; From Him comes my salvation.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 62:2: Psalms 62:2 He only is my rock and my salvation; He is my defense; I shall not be greatly moved.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 62:3: Psalms 62:3 How long will you attack a man? You shall be slain, all of you,  Like a leaning wall and a tottering fence.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 62:4: Psalms 62:4 They only consult to cast him down from his high position; They delight in lies; They bless with their mouth, But they curse inwardly.  Selah(NKJV)
verses.psalms 62:5: Psalms 62:5 My soul, wait silently for God alone, For my expectation is from Him.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 62:6: Psalms 62:6 He only is my rock and my salvation; He is my defense; I shall not be moved.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 62:7: Psalms 62:7 In God is my salvation and my glory; The rock of my strength, And my refuge, is in God.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 62:8: Psalms 62:8 Trust in Him at all times, you people;  Pour out your heart before Him; God is a refuge for us.  Selah(NKJV)
verses.psalms 62:9: Psalms 62:9 Surely men of low degree are a vapor, Men of high degree are a lie; If they are weighed on the scales, They are altogether lighter than vapor.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 62:10: Psalms 62:10 Do not trust in oppression, Nor vainly hope in robbery;  If riches increase, Do not set your heart on them.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 62:11: Psalms 62:11 God has spoken once, Twice I have heard this: That power belongs to God.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 62:12: Psalms 62:12 Also to You, O Lord, belongs mercy; For You render to each one according to his work.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 63:1: Psalms 63:1 A Psalm of David when he was in the wilderness of Judah.   O God, You are my God; Early will I seek You;  My soul thirsts for You; My flesh longs for You In a dry and thirsty land Where there is no water.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 63:2: Psalms 63:2 So I have looked for You in the sanctuary, To see Your power and Your glory.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 63:3: Psalms 63:3 Because Your lovingkindness is better than life, My lips shall praise You.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 63:4: Psalms 63:4 Thus I will bless You while I live; I will lift up my hands in Your name.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 63:5: Psalms 63:5 My soul shall be satisfied as with marrow and fatness, And my mouth shall praise You with joyful lips.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 63:6: Psalms 63:6 When I remember You on my bed, I meditate on You in the night watches.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 63:7: Psalms 63:7 Because You have been my help, Therefore in the shadow of Your wings I will rejoice.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 63:8: Psalms 63:8 My soul follows close behind You; Your right hand upholds me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 63:9: Psalms 63:9 But those who seek my life, to destroy it, Shall go into the lower parts of the earth.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 63:10: Psalms 63:10 They shall fall by the sword; They shall be a portion for jackals.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 63:11: Psalms 63:11 But the king shall rejoice in God;  Everyone who swears by Him shall glory; But the mouth of those who speak lies shall be stopped.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 64:1: Psalms 64:1 To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David.   Hear my voice, O God, in my meditation; Preserve my life from fear of the enemy.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 64:2: Psalms 64:2 Hide me from the secret plots of the wicked, From the rebellion of the workers of iniquity,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 64:3: Psalms 64:3 Who sharpen their tongue like a sword,  And bend their bows to shoot their arrows"”bitter words,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 64:4: Psalms 64:4 That they may shoot in secret at the blameless; Suddenly they shoot at him and do not fear.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 64:5: Psalms 64:5 They encourage themselves in an evil matter; They talk of laying snares secretly;  They say, "Who will see them?"(NKJV)
verses.psalms 64:6: Psalms 64:6 They devise iniquities: "We have perfected a shrewd scheme." Both the inward thought and the heart of man are deep.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 64:7: Psalms 64:7 But God shall shoot at them with an arrow; Suddenly they shall be wounded.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 64:8: Psalms 64:8 So He will make them stumble over their own tongue;  All who see them shall flee away.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 64:9: Psalms 64:9 All men shall fear, And shall declare the work of God; For they shall wisely consider His doing.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 64:10: Psalms 64:10 The righteous shall be glad in the LORD, and trust in Him. And all the upright in heart shall glory.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 65:1: Psalms 65:1 To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David. A Song.   Praise is awaiting You, O God, in Zion; And to You the vow shall be performed.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 65:2: Psalms 65:2 O You who hear prayer,  To You all flesh will come.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 65:3: Psalms 65:3 Iniquities prevail against me; As for our transgressions, You will provide atonement for them.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 65:4: Psalms 65:4 Blessed is the man You choose, And cause to approach You, That he may dwell in Your courts.  We shall be satisfied with the goodness of Your house, Of Your holy temple.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 65:5: Psalms 65:5 By awesome deeds in righteousness You will answer us, O God of our salvation, You who are the confidence of all the ends of the earth, And of the far-off seas;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 65:6: Psalms 65:6 Who established the mountains by His strength,  Being clothed with power;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 65:7: Psalms 65:7 You who still the noise of the seas, The noise of their waves,  And the tumult of the peoples.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 65:8: Psalms 65:8 They also who dwell in the farthest parts are afraid of Your signs; You make the outgoings of the morning and evening rejoice.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 65:9: Psalms 65:9 You visit the earth and water it, You greatly enrich it;  The river of God is full of water; You provide their grain, For so You have prepared it.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 65:10: Psalms 65:10 You water its ridges abundantly, You settle its furrows; You make it soft with showers, You bless its growth.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 65:11: Psalms 65:11 You crown the year with Your goodness, And Your paths drip with abundance.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 65:12: Psalms 65:12 They drop on the pastures of the wilderness, And the little hills rejoice on every side.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 65:13: Psalms 65:13 The pastures are clothed with flocks;  The valleys also are covered with grain; They shout for joy, they also sing.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 66:1: Psalms 66:1 To the Chief Musician. A Song. A Psalm.   Make a joyful shout to God, all the earth!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 66:2: Psalms 66:2 Sing out the honor of His name; Make His praise glorious.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 66:3: Psalms 66:3 Say to God, "How awesome are Your works!  Through the greatness of Your power Your enemies shall submit themselves to You.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 66:4: Psalms 66:4 All the earth shall worship You And sing praises to You; They shall sing praises to Your name."  Selah(NKJV)
verses.psalms 66:5: Psalms 66:5 Come and see the works of God; He is awesome in His doing toward the sons of men.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 66:6: Psalms 66:6 He turned the sea into dry land;  They went through the river on foot. There we will rejoice in Him.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 66:7: Psalms 66:7 He rules by His power forever; His eyes observe the nations; Do not let the rebellious exalt themselves.  Selah(NKJV)
verses.psalms 66:8: Psalms 66:8 Oh, bless our God, you peoples! And make the voice of His praise to be heard,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 66:9: Psalms 66:9 Who keeps our soul among the living, And does not allow our feet to be moved.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 66:10: Psalms 66:10 For You, O God, have tested us;  You have refined us as silver is refined.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 66:11: Psalms 66:11 You brought us into the net; You laid affliction on our backs.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 66:12: Psalms 66:12 You have caused men to ride over our heads;  We went through fire and through water; But You brought us out to rich fulfillment.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 66:13: Psalms 66:13 I will go into Your house with burnt offerings;  I will pay You my vows,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 66:14: Psalms 66:14 Which my lips have uttered And my mouth has spoken when I was in trouble.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 66:15: Psalms 66:15 I will offer You burnt sacrifices of fat animals, With the sweet aroma of rams; I will offer bulls with goats.  Selah(NKJV)
verses.psalms 66:16: Psalms 66:16 Come and hear, all you who fear God, And I will declare what He has done for my soul.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 66:17: Psalms 66:17 I cried to Him with my mouth, And He was extolled with my tongue.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 66:18: Psalms 66:18 If I regard iniquity in my heart, The Lord will not hear.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 66:19: Psalms 66:19 But certainly God has heard me; He has attended to the voice of my prayer.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 66:20: Psalms 66:20 Blessed be God, Who has not turned away my prayer, Nor His mercy from me!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 67:1: Psalms 67:1 To the Chief Musician. On stringed instruments. A Psalm. A Song.   God be merciful to us and bless us, And cause His face to shine upon us,  Selah(NKJV)
verses.psalms 67:2: Psalms 67:2 That Your way may be known on earth,  Your salvation among all nations.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 67:3: Psalms 67:3 Let the peoples praise You, O God; Let all the peoples praise You.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 67:4: Psalms 67:4 Oh, let the nations be glad and sing for joy! For You shall judge the people righteously, And govern the nations on earth.  Selah(NKJV)
verses.psalms 67:5: Psalms 67:5 Let the peoples praise You, O God; Let all the peoples praise You.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 67:6: Psalms 67:6 Then the earth shall yield her increase; God, our own God, shall bless us.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 67:7: Psalms 67:7 God shall bless us, And all the ends of the earth shall fear Him.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 68:1: Psalms 68:1 To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David. A Song.   Let God arise, Let His enemies be scattered; Let those also who hate Him flee before Him.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 68:2: Psalms 68:2 As smoke is driven away, So drive them away;  As wax melts before the fire, So let the wicked perish at the presence of God.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 68:3: Psalms 68:3 But let the righteous be glad; Let them rejoice before God; Yes, let them rejoice exceedingly.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 68:4: Psalms 68:4 Sing to God, sing praises to His name;  Extol Him who rides on the clouds,  By His name YAH, And rejoice before Him.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 68:5: Psalms 68:5 A father of the fatherless, a defender of widows, Is God in His holy habitation.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 68:6: Psalms 68:6 God sets the solitary in families;  He brings out those who are bound into prosperity; But the rebellious dwell in a dry land.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 68:7: Psalms 68:7 O God, when You went out before Your people, When You marched through the wilderness,  Selah(NKJV)
verses.psalms 68:8: Psalms 68:8 The earth shook; The heavens also dropped rain at the presence of God; Sinai itself was moved at the presence of God, the God of Israel.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 68:9: Psalms 68:9 You, O God, sent a plentiful rain, Whereby You confirmed Your inheritance, When it was weary.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 68:10: Psalms 68:10 Your congregation dwelt in it;  You, O God, provided from Your goodness for the poor.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 68:11: Psalms 68:11 The Lord gave the word; Great was the company of those who proclaimed it:(NKJV)
verses.psalms 68:12: Psalms 68:12 "Kings  of armies flee, they flee, And she who remains at home divides the spoil.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 68:13: Psalms 68:13 Though you lie down among the sheepfolds,  You will be like the wings of a dove covered with silver, And her feathers with yellow gold."(NKJV)
verses.psalms 68:14: Psalms 68:14 When the Almighty scattered kings in it, It was white as snow in Zalmon.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 68:15: Psalms 68:15 A mountain of God is the mountain of Bashan; A mountain of many peaks is the mountain of Bashan.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 68:16: Psalms 68:16 Why do you fume with envy, you mountains of many peaks?  This is the mountain which God desires to dwell in; Yes, the LORD will dwell in it forever.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 68:17: Psalms 68:17 The chariots of God are twenty thousand, Even thousands of thousands; The Lord is among them as in Sinai, in the Holy Place.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 68:18: Psalms 68:18 You have ascended on high,  You have led captivity captive;  You have received gifts among men, Even from the rebellious,  That the LORD God might dwell there.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 68:19: Psalms 68:19 Blessed be the Lord, Who daily loads us with benefits, The God of our salvation!  Selah(NKJV)
verses.psalms 68:20: Psalms 68:20 Our God is the God of salvation; And to GOD the Lord belong escapes from death.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 68:21: Psalms 68:21 But God will wound the head of His enemies,  The hairy scalp of the one who still goes on in his trespasses.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 68:22: Psalms 68:22 The Lord said, "I will bring back from Bashan, I will bring them back from the depths of the sea,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 68:23: Psalms 68:23 That your foot may crush them in blood,  And the tongues of your dogs may have their portion from your enemies."(NKJV)
verses.psalms 68:24: Psalms 68:24 They have seen Your procession, O God, The procession of my God, my King, into the sanctuary.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 68:25: Psalms 68:25 The singers went before, the players on instruments followed after; Among them were the maidens playing timbrels.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 68:26: Psalms 68:26 Bless God in the congregations, The Lord, from the fountain of Israel.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 68:27: Psalms 68:27 There is little Benjamin, their leader, The princes of Judah and their company, The princes of Zebulun and the princes of Naphtali.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 68:28: Psalms 68:28 Your God has commanded your strength; Strengthen, O God, what You have done for us.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 68:29: Psalms 68:29 Because of Your temple at Jerusalem,  Kings will bring presents to You.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 68:30: Psalms 68:30 Rebuke the beasts of the reeds,  The herd of bulls with the calves of the peoples, Till everyone submits himself with pieces of silver. Scatter the peoples who delight in war.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 68:31: Psalms 68:31 Envoys will come out of Egypt;  Ethiopia will quickly stretch out her hands to God.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 68:32: Psalms 68:32 Sing to God, you kingdoms of the earth; Oh, sing praises to the Lord,  Selah(NKJV)
verses.psalms 68:33: Psalms 68:33 To Him who rides on the heaven of heavens, which were of old! Indeed, He sends out His voice, a mighty voice.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 68:34: Psalms 68:34 Ascribe strength to God; His excellence is over Israel, And His strength is in the clouds.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 68:35: Psalms 68:35 O God, You are more awesome than Your holy places. The God of Israel is He who gives strength and power to His people. Blessed be God!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 69:1: Psalms 69:1 To the Chief Musician. Set to "The Lilies." A Psalm of David.   Save me, O God! For the waters have come up to my neck.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 69:2: Psalms 69:2 I sink in deep mire, Where there is no standing; I have come into deep waters, Where the floods overflow me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 69:3: Psalms 69:3 I am weary with my crying; My throat is dry;  My eyes fail while I wait for my God.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 69:4: Psalms 69:4 Those who hate me without a cause Are more than the hairs of my head; They are mighty who would destroy me, Being my enemies wrongfully; Though I have stolen nothing, I still must restore it.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 69:5: Psalms 69:5 O God, You know my foolishness; And my sins are not hidden from You.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 69:6: Psalms 69:6 Let not those who wait for You, O Lord GOD of hosts, be ashamed because of me; Let not those who seek You be confounded because of me, O God of Israel.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 69:7: Psalms 69:7 Because for Your sake I have borne reproach; Shame has covered my face.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 69:8: Psalms 69:8 I have become a stranger to my brothers, And an alien to my mother's children;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 69:9: Psalms 69:9 Because zeal for Your house has eaten me up,  And the reproaches of those who reproach You have fallen on me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 69:10: Psalms 69:10 When I wept and chastened my soul with fasting, That became my reproach.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 69:11: Psalms 69:11 I also made sackcloth my garment; I became a byword to them.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 69:12: Psalms 69:12 Those who sit in the gate speak against me, And I am the song of the drunkards.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 69:13: Psalms 69:13 But as for me, my prayer is to You, O LORD, in the acceptable time; O God, in the multitude of Your mercy, Hear me in the truth of Your salvation.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 69:14: Psalms 69:14 Deliver me out of the mire, And let me not sink; Let me be delivered from those who hate me, And out of the deep waters.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 69:15: Psalms 69:15 Let not the floodwater overflow me, Nor let the deep swallow me up; And let not the pit shut its mouth on me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 69:16: Psalms 69:16 Hear me, O LORD, for Your lovingkindness is good; Turn to me according to the multitude of Your tender mercies.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 69:17: Psalms 69:17 And do not hide Your face from Your servant, For I am in trouble; Hear me speedily.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 69:18: Psalms 69:18 Draw near to my soul, and redeem it; Deliver me because of my enemies.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 69:19: Psalms 69:19 You know my reproach, my shame, and my dishonor; My adversaries are all before You.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 69:20: Psalms 69:20 Reproach has broken my heart, And I am full of heaviness;  I looked for someone to take pity, but there was none; And for comforters, but I found none.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 69:21: Psalms 69:21 They also gave me gall for my food,  And for my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 69:22: Psalms 69:22 Let their table become a snare before them, And their well-being a trap.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 69:23: Psalms 69:23 Let their eyes be darkened, so that they do not see; And make their loins shake continually.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 69:24: Psalms 69:24 Pour out Your indignation upon them, And let Your wrathful anger take hold of them.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 69:25: Psalms 69:25 Let their dwelling place be desolate; Let no one live in their tents.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 69:26: Psalms 69:26 For they persecute the ones You have struck, And talk of the grief of those You have wounded.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 69:27: Psalms 69:27 Add iniquity to their iniquity,  And let them not come into Your righteousness.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 69:28: Psalms 69:28 Let them be blotted out of the book of the living,  And not be written with the righteous.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 69:29: Psalms 69:29 But I am poor and sorrowful; Let Your salvation, O God, set me up on high.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 69:30: Psalms 69:30 I will praise the name of God with a song, And will magnify Him with thanksgiving.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 69:31: Psalms 69:31 This also shall please the LORD better than an ox or bull, Which has horns and hooves.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 69:32: Psalms 69:32 The humble shall see this and be glad; And you who seek God, your hearts shall live.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 69:33: Psalms 69:33 For the LORD hears the poor, And does not despise His prisoners.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 69:34: Psalms 69:34 Let heaven and earth praise Him, The seas and everything that moves in them.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 69:35: Psalms 69:35 For God will save Zion And build the cities of Judah, That they may dwell there and possess it.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 69:36: Psalms 69:36 Also, the descendants of His servants shall inherit it, And those who love His name shall dwell in it.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 70:1: Psalms 70:1 To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David. To bring to remembrance.   Make haste, O God, to deliver me! Make haste to help me, O LORD!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 70:2: Psalms 70:2 Let them be ashamed and confounded Who seek my life; Let them be turned back and confused Who desire my hurt.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 70:3: Psalms 70:3 Let them be turned back because of their shame, Who say, "Aha, aha!"(NKJV)
verses.psalms 70:4: Psalms 70:4 Let all those who seek You rejoice and be glad in You; And let those who love Your salvation say continually, "Let God be magnified!"(NKJV)
verses.psalms 70:5: Psalms 70:5 But I am poor and needy;  Make haste to me, O God! You are my help and my deliverer; O LORD, do not delay.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 71:1: Psalms 71:1 In You, O LORD, I put my trust; Let me never be put to shame.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 71:2: Psalms 71:2 Deliver me in Your righteousness, and cause me to escape;  Incline Your ear to me, and save me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 71:3: Psalms 71:3 Be my strong refuge, To which I may resort continually; You have given the commandment to save me, For You are my rock and my fortress.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 71:4: Psalms 71:4 Deliver me, O my God, out of the hand of the wicked, Out of the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 71:5: Psalms 71:5 For You are my hope, O Lord GOD; You are my trust from my youth.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 71:6: Psalms 71:6 By You I have been upheld from birth; You are He who took me out of my mother's womb. My praise shall be continually of You.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 71:7: Psalms 71:7 I have become as a wonder to many, But You are my strong refuge.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 71:8: Psalms 71:8 Let my mouth be filled with Your praise And with Your glory all the day.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 71:9: Psalms 71:9 Do not cast me off in the time of old age; Do not forsake me when my strength fails.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 71:10: Psalms 71:10 For my enemies speak against me; And those who lie in wait for my life take counsel together,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 71:11: Psalms 71:11 Saying, "God has forsaken him; Pursue and take him, for there is none to deliver him."(NKJV)
verses.psalms 71:12: Psalms 71:12 O God, do not be far from me; O my God, make haste to help me!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 71:13: Psalms 71:13 Let them be confounded and consumed Who are adversaries of my life; Let them be covered with reproach and dishonor Who seek my hurt.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 71:14: Psalms 71:14 But I will hope continually, And will praise You yet more and more.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 71:15: Psalms 71:15 My mouth shall tell of Your righteousness And Your salvation all the day, For I do not know their limits.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 71:16: Psalms 71:16 I will go in the strength of the Lord GOD; I will make mention of Your righteousness, of Yours only.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 71:17: Psalms 71:17 O God, You have taught me from my youth; And to this day I declare Your wondrous works.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 71:18: Psalms 71:18 Now also when I am old and grayheaded, O God, do not forsake me, Until I declare Your strength to this generation, Your power to everyone who is to come.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 71:19: Psalms 71:19 Also Your righteousness, O God, is very high, You who have done great things;  O God, who is like You?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 71:20: Psalms 71:20 You, who have shown me great and severe troubles,  Shall revive me again, And bring me up again from the depths of the earth.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 71:21: Psalms 71:21 You shall increase my greatness, And comfort me on every side.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 71:22: Psalms 71:22 Also with the lute I will praise You"” And Your faithfulness, O my God! To You I will sing with the harp, O Holy One of Israel.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 71:23: Psalms 71:23 My lips shall greatly rejoice when I sing to You, And my soul, which You have redeemed.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 71:24: Psalms 71:24 My tongue also shall talk of Your righteousness all the day long; For they are confounded, For they are brought to shame Who seek my hurt.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 72:1: Psalms 72:1 A Psalm of Solomon.   Give the king Your judgments, O God, And Your righteousness to the king's Son.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 72:2: Psalms 72:2 He will judge Your people with righteousness, And Your poor with justice.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 72:3: Psalms 72:3 The mountains will bring peace to the people, And the little hills, by righteousness.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 72:4: Psalms 72:4 He will bring justice to the poor of the people; He will save the children of the needy, And will break in pieces the oppressor.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 72:5: Psalms 72:5 They shall fear You  As long as the sun and moon endure, Throughout all generations.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 72:6: Psalms 72:6 He shall come down like rain upon the grass before mowing, Like showers that water the earth.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 72:7: Psalms 72:7 In His days the righteous shall flourish,  And abundance of peace, Until the moon is no more.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 72:8: Psalms 72:8 He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, And from the River to the ends of the earth.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 72:9: Psalms 72:9 Those who dwell in the wilderness will bow before Him,  And His enemies will lick the dust.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 72:10: Psalms 72:10 The kings of Tarshish and of the isles Will bring presents; The kings of Sheba and Seba Will offer gifts.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 72:11: Psalms 72:11 Yes, all kings shall fall down before Him; All nations shall serve Him.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 72:12: Psalms 72:12 For He will deliver the needy when he cries, The poor also, and him who has no helper.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 72:13: Psalms 72:13 He will spare the poor and needy, And will save the souls of the needy.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 72:14: Psalms 72:14 He will redeem their life from oppression and violence; And precious shall be their blood in His sight.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 72:15: Psalms 72:15 And He shall live; And the gold of Sheba will be given to Him; Prayer also will be made for Him continually, And daily He shall be praised.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 72:16: Psalms 72:16 There will be an abundance of grain in the earth, On the top of the mountains; Its fruit shall wave like Lebanon;  And those of the city shall flourish like grass of the earth.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 72:17: Psalms 72:17 His name shall endure forever; His name shall continue as long as the sun. And men shall be blessed in Him;  All nations shall call Him blessed.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 72:18: Psalms 72:18 Blessed be the LORD God, the God of Israel,  Who only does wondrous things!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 72:19: Psalms 72:19 And blessed be His glorious name forever!  And let the whole earth be filled with His glory. Amen and Amen.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 72:20: Psalms 72:20 The prayers of David the son of Jesse are ended.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 73:1: Psalms 73:1 A Psalm of Asaph.   Truly God is good to Israel, To such as are pure in heart.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 73:2: Psalms 73:2 But as for me, my feet had almost stumbled; My steps had nearly slipped.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 73:3: Psalms 73:3 For I was envious of the boastful, When I saw the prosperity of the wicked.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 73:4: Psalms 73:4 For there are no pangs in their death, But their strength is firm.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 73:5: Psalms 73:5 They are not in trouble as other men, Nor are they plagued like other men.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 73:6: Psalms 73:6 Therefore pride serves as their necklace; Violence covers them like a garment.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 73:7: Psalms 73:7 Their eyes bulge with abundance; They have more than heart could wish.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 73:8: Psalms 73:8 They scoff and speak wickedly concerning oppression; They speak loftily.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 73:9: Psalms 73:9 They set their mouth against the heavens, And their tongue walks through the earth.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 73:10: Psalms 73:10 Therefore his people return here,  And waters of a full cup are drained by them.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 73:11: Psalms 73:11 And they say, "How does God know? And is there knowledge in the Most High?"(NKJV)
verses.psalms 73:12: Psalms 73:12 Behold, these are the ungodly, Who are always at ease; They increase in riches.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 73:13: Psalms 73:13 Surely I have cleansed my heart in vain, And washed my hands in innocence.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 73:14: Psalms 73:14 For all day long I have been plagued, And chastened every morning.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 73:15: Psalms 73:15 If I had said, "I will speak thus," Behold, I would have been untrue to the generation of Your children.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 73:16: Psalms 73:16 When I thought how to understand this, It was too painful for me"”(NKJV)
verses.psalms 73:17: Psalms 73:17 Until I went into the sanctuary of God; Then I understood their end.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 73:18: Psalms 73:18 Surely You set them in slippery places; You cast them down to destruction.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 73:19: Psalms 73:19 Oh, how they are brought to desolation, as in a moment! They are utterly consumed with terrors.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 73:20: Psalms 73:20 As a dream when one awakes, So, Lord, when You awake, You shall despise their image.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 73:21: Psalms 73:21 Thus my heart was grieved, And I was vexed in my mind.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 73:22: Psalms 73:22 I was so foolish and ignorant; I was like a beast before You.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 73:23: Psalms 73:23 Nevertheless I am continually with You; You hold me by my right hand.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 73:24: Psalms 73:24 You will guide me with Your counsel, And afterward receive me to glory.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 73:25: Psalms 73:25 Whom have I in heaven but You? And there is none upon earth that I desire besides You.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 73:26: Psalms 73:26 My flesh and my heart fail; But God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 73:27: Psalms 73:27 For indeed, those who are far from You shall perish; You have destroyed all those who desert You for harlotry.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 73:28: Psalms 73:28 But it is good for me to draw near to God; I have put my trust in the Lord GOD, That I may declare all Your works.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 74:1: Psalms 74:1 A Contemplation of Asaph.   O God, why have You cast us off forever? Why does Your anger smoke against the sheep of Your pasture?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 74:2: Psalms 74:2 Remember Your congregation, which You have purchased of old, The tribe of Your inheritance, which You have redeemed"” This Mount Zion where You have dwelt.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 74:3: Psalms 74:3 Lift up Your feet to the perpetual desolations. The enemy has damaged everything in the sanctuary.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 74:4: Psalms 74:4 Your enemies roar in the midst of Your meeting place;  They set up their banners for signs.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 74:5: Psalms 74:5 They seem like men who lift up Axes among the thick trees.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 74:6: Psalms 74:6 And now they break down its carved work, all at once, With axes and hammers.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 74:7: Psalms 74:7 They have set fire to Your sanctuary; They have defiled the dwelling place of Your name to the ground.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 74:8: Psalms 74:8 They said in their hearts, "Let us destroy them altogether." They have burned up all the meeting places of God in the land.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 74:9: Psalms 74:9 We do not see our signs;  There is no longer any prophet; Nor is there any among us who knows how long.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 74:10: Psalms 74:10 O God, how long will the adversary reproach? Will the enemy blaspheme Your name forever?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 74:11: Psalms 74:11 Why do You withdraw Your hand, even Your right hand? Take it out of Your bosom and destroy them.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 74:12: Psalms 74:12 For God is my King from of old, Working salvation in the midst of the earth.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 74:13: Psalms 74:13 You divided the sea by Your strength; You broke the heads of the sea serpents in the waters.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 74:14: Psalms 74:14 You broke the heads of Leviathan in pieces, And gave him as food to the people inhabiting the wilderness.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 74:15: Psalms 74:15 You broke open the fountain and the flood;  You dried up mighty rivers.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 74:16: Psalms 74:16 The day is Yours, the night also is Yours;  You have prepared the light and the sun.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 74:17: Psalms 74:17 You have set all the borders of the earth;  You have made summer and winter.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 74:18: Psalms 74:18 Remember this, that the enemy has reproached, O LORD, And that a foolish people has blasphemed Your name.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 74:19: Psalms 74:19 Oh, do not deliver the life of Your turtledove to the wild beast! Do not forget the life of Your poor forever.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 74:20: Psalms 74:20 Have respect to the covenant; For the dark places of the earth are full of the haunts of cruelty.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 74:21: Psalms 74:21 Oh, do not let the oppressed return ashamed! Let the poor and needy praise Your name.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 74:22: Psalms 74:22 Arise, O God, plead Your own cause; Remember how the foolish man reproaches You daily.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 74:23: Psalms 74:23 Do not forget the voice of Your enemies; The tumult of those who rise up against You increases continually.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 75:1: Psalms 75:1 To the Chief Musician. Set to "Do Not Destroy." A Psalm of Asaph. A Song.   We give thanks to You, O God, we give thanks! For Your wondrous works declare that Your name is near.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 75:2: Psalms 75:2 "When I choose the proper time, I will judge uprightly.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 75:3: Psalms 75:3 The earth and all its inhabitants are dissolved; I set up its pillars firmly.  Selah(NKJV)
verses.psalms 75:4: Psalms 75:4 "I said to the boastful, "˜Do not deal boastfully,' And to the wicked, "˜Do not lift up the horn.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 75:5: Psalms 75:5 Do not lift up your horn on high; Do not speak with a stiff neck.' "(NKJV)
verses.psalms 75:6: Psalms 75:6 For exaltation comes neither from the east Nor from the west nor from the south.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 75:7: Psalms 75:7 But God is the Judge:  He puts down one, And exalts another.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 75:8: Psalms 75:8 For in the hand of the LORD there is a cup, And the wine is red; It is fully mixed, and He pours it out; Surely its dregs shall all the wicked of the earth Drain and drink down.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 75:9: Psalms 75:9 But I will declare forever, I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 75:10: Psalms 75:10 "All  the horns of the wicked I will also cut off, But the horns of the righteous shall be exalted."(NKJV)
verses.psalms 76:1: Psalms 76:1 To the Chief Musician. On stringed instruments. A Psalm of Asaph. A Song.   In Judah God is known; His name is great in Israel.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 76:2: Psalms 76:2 In Salem also is His tabernacle, And His dwelling place in Zion.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 76:3: Psalms 76:3 There He broke the arrows of the bow, The shield and sword of battle.  Selah(NKJV)
verses.psalms 76:4: Psalms 76:4 You are more glorious and excellent  Than the mountains of prey.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 76:5: Psalms 76:5 The stouthearted were plundered;  They have sunk into their sleep; And none of the mighty men have found the use of their hands.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 76:6: Psalms 76:6 At Your rebuke, O God of Jacob, Both the chariot and horse were cast into a dead sleep.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 76:7: Psalms 76:7 You, Yourself, are to be feared; And who may stand in Your presence When once You are angry?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 76:8: Psalms 76:8 You caused judgment to be heard from heaven;  The earth feared and was still,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 76:9: Psalms 76:9 When God arose to judgment, To deliver all the oppressed of the earth.  Selah(NKJV)
verses.psalms 76:10: Psalms 76:10 Surely the wrath of man shall praise You; With the remainder of wrath You shall gird Yourself.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 76:11: Psalms 76:11 Make vows to the LORD your God, and pay them;  Let all who are around Him bring presents to Him who ought to be feared.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 76:12: Psalms 76:12 He shall cut off the spirit of princes;  He is awesome to the kings of the earth.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 77:1: Psalms 77:1 To the Chief Musician. To Jeduthun. A Psalm of Asaph.   I cried out to God with my voice"” To God with my voice; And He gave ear to me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 77:2: Psalms 77:2 In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord; My hand was stretched out in the night without ceasing; My soul refused to be comforted.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 77:3: Psalms 77:3 I remembered God, and was troubled; I complained, and my spirit was overwhelmed.  Selah(NKJV)
verses.psalms 77:4: Psalms 77:4 You hold my eyelids open; I am so troubled that I cannot speak.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 77:5: Psalms 77:5 I have considered the days of old, The years of ancient times.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 77:6: Psalms 77:6 I call to remembrance my song in the night; I meditate within my heart, And my spirit makes diligent search.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 77:7: Psalms 77:7 Will the Lord cast off forever? And will He be favorable no more?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 77:8: Psalms 77:8 Has His mercy ceased forever? Has His promise failed forevermore?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 77:9: Psalms 77:9 Has God forgotten to be gracious? Has He in anger shut up His tender mercies?  Selah(NKJV)
verses.psalms 77:10: Psalms 77:10 And I said, "This is my anguish; But I will remember the years of the right hand of the Most High."(NKJV)
verses.psalms 77:11: Psalms 77:11 I will remember the works of the LORD; Surely I will remember Your wonders of old.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 77:12: Psalms 77:12 I will also meditate on all Your work, And talk of Your deeds.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 77:13: Psalms 77:13 Your way, O God, is in the sanctuary; Who is so great a God as our God?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 77:14: Psalms 77:14 You are the God who does wonders; You have declared Your strength among the peoples.(NKJV)
