verses.psalms 77:15: Psalms 77:15 You have with Your arm redeemed Your people, The sons of Jacob and Joseph.  Selah(NKJV)
verses.psalms 77:16: Psalms 77:16 The waters saw You, O God; The waters saw You, they were afraid; The depths also trembled.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 77:17: Psalms 77:17 The clouds poured out water; The skies sent out a sound; Your arrows also flashed about.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 77:18: Psalms 77:18 The voice of Your thunder was in the whirlwind; The lightnings lit up the world; The earth trembled and shook.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 77:19: Psalms 77:19 Your way was in the sea, Your path in the great waters, And Your footsteps were not known.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 77:20: Psalms 77:20 You led Your people like a flock By the hand of Moses and Aaron.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 78:1: Psalms 78:1 A Contemplation of Asaph.   Give ear, O my people, to my law; Incline your ears to the words of my mouth.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 78:2: Psalms 78:2 I will open my mouth in a parable; I will utter dark sayings of old,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 78:3: Psalms 78:3 Which we have heard and known, And our fathers have told us.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 78:4: Psalms 78:4 We will not hide them from their children,  Telling to the generation to come the praises of the LORD, And His strength and His wonderful works that He has done.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 78:5: Psalms 78:5 For He established a testimony in Jacob, And appointed a law in Israel, Which He commanded our fathers, That they should make them known to their children;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 78:6: Psalms 78:6 That the generation to come might know them, The children who would be born, That they may arise and declare them to their children,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 78:7: Psalms 78:7 That they may set their hope in God, And not forget the works of God, But keep His commandments;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 78:8: Psalms 78:8 And may not be like their fathers,  A stubborn and rebellious generation, A generation that did not set its heart aright, And whose spirit was not faithful to God.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 78:9: Psalms 78:9 The children of Ephraim, being armed and carrying bows, Turned back in the day of battle.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 78:10: Psalms 78:10 They did not keep the covenant of God; They refused to walk in His law,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 78:11: Psalms 78:11 And forgot His works And His wonders that He had shown them.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 78:12: Psalms 78:12 Marvelous things He did in the sight of their fathers, In the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 78:13: Psalms 78:13 He divided the sea and caused them to pass through; And He made the waters stand up like a heap.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 78:14: Psalms 78:14 In the daytime also He led them with the cloud, And all the night with a light of fire.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 78:15: Psalms 78:15 He split the rocks in the wilderness, And gave them drink in abundance like the depths.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 78:16: Psalms 78:16 He also brought streams out of the rock, And caused waters to run down like rivers.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 78:17: Psalms 78:17 But they sinned even more against Him By rebelling against the Most High in the wilderness.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 78:18: Psalms 78:18 And they tested God in their heart By asking for the food of their fancy.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 78:19: Psalms 78:19 Yes, they spoke against God: They said, "Can God prepare a table in the wilderness?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 78:20: Psalms 78:20 Behold, He struck the rock, So that the waters gushed out, And the streams overflowed. Can He give bread also? Can He provide meat for His people?"(NKJV)
verses.psalms 78:21: Psalms 78:21 Therefore the LORD heard this and was furious; So a fire was kindled against Jacob, And anger also came up against Israel,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 78:22: Psalms 78:22 Because they did not believe in God, And did not trust in His salvation.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 78:23: Psalms 78:23 Yet He had commanded the clouds above,  And opened the doors of heaven,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 78:24: Psalms 78:24 Had rained down manna on them to eat, And given them of the bread of heaven.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 78:25: Psalms 78:25 Men ate angels' food; He sent them food to the full.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 78:26: Psalms 78:26 He caused an east wind to blow in the heavens; And by His power He brought in the south wind.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 78:27: Psalms 78:27 He also rained meat on them like the dust, Feathered fowl like the sand of the seas;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 78:28: Psalms 78:28 And He let them fall in the midst of their camp, All around their dwellings.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 78:29: Psalms 78:29 So they ate and were well filled, For He gave them their own desire.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 78:30: Psalms 78:30 They were not deprived of their craving; But while their food was still in their mouths,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 78:31: Psalms 78:31 The wrath of God came against them, And slew the stoutest of them, And struck down the choice men of Israel.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 78:32: Psalms 78:32 In spite of this they still sinned, And did not believe in His wondrous works.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 78:33: Psalms 78:33 Therefore their days He consumed in futility, And their years in fear.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 78:34: Psalms 78:34 When He slew them, then they sought Him; And they returned and sought earnestly for God.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 78:35: Psalms 78:35 Then they remembered that God was their rock, And the Most High God their Redeemer.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 78:36: Psalms 78:36 Nevertheless they flattered Him with their mouth, And they lied to Him with their tongue;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 78:37: Psalms 78:37 For their heart was not steadfast with Him, Nor were they faithful in His covenant.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 78:38: Psalms 78:38 But He, being full of compassion, forgave their iniquity, And did not destroy them. Yes, many a time He turned His anger away, And did not stir up all His wrath;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 78:39: Psalms 78:39 For He remembered that they were but flesh,  A breath that passes away and does not come again.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 78:40: Psalms 78:40 How often they provoked Him in the wilderness, And grieved Him in the desert!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 78:41: Psalms 78:41 Yes, again and again they tempted God, And limited the Holy One of Israel.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 78:42: Psalms 78:42 They did not remember His power: The day when He redeemed them from the enemy,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 78:43: Psalms 78:43 When He worked His signs in Egypt, And His wonders in the field of Zoan;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 78:44: Psalms 78:44 Turned their rivers into blood, And their streams, that they could not drink.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 78:45: Psalms 78:45 He sent swarms of flies among them, which devoured them, And frogs, which destroyed them.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 78:46: Psalms 78:46 He also gave their crops to the caterpillar, And their labor to the locust.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 78:47: Psalms 78:47 He destroyed their vines with hail, And their sycamore trees with frost.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 78:48: Psalms 78:48 He also gave up their cattle to the hail, And their flocks to fiery lightning.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 78:49: Psalms 78:49 He cast on them the fierceness of His anger, Wrath, indignation, and trouble, By sending angels of destruction among them.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 78:50: Psalms 78:50 He made a path for His anger; He did not spare their soul from death, But gave their life over to the plague,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 78:51: Psalms 78:51 And destroyed all the firstborn in Egypt, The first of their strength in the tents of Ham.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 78:52: Psalms 78:52 But He made His own people go forth like sheep, And guided them in the wilderness like a flock;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 78:53: Psalms 78:53 And He led them on safely, so that they did not fear; But the sea overwhelmed their enemies.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 78:54: Psalms 78:54 And He brought them to His holy border, This mountain which His right hand had acquired.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 78:55: Psalms 78:55 He also drove out the nations before them,  Allotted them an inheritance by survey, And made the tribes of Israel dwell in their tents.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 78:56: Psalms 78:56 Yet they tested and provoked the Most High God, And did not keep His testimonies,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 78:57: Psalms 78:57 But turned back and acted unfaithfully like their fathers; They were turned aside like a deceitful bow.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 78:58: Psalms 78:58 For they provoked Him to anger with their high places, And moved Him to jealousy with their carved images.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 78:59: Psalms 78:59 When God heard this, He was furious, And greatly abhorred Israel,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 78:60: Psalms 78:60 So that He forsook the tabernacle of Shiloh, The tent He had placed among men,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 78:61: Psalms 78:61 And delivered His strength into captivity, And His glory into the enemy's hand.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 78:62: Psalms 78:62 He also gave His people over to the sword, And was furious with His inheritance.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 78:63: Psalms 78:63 The fire consumed their young men, And their maidens were not given in marriage.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 78:64: Psalms 78:64 Their priests fell by the sword, And their widows made no lamentation.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 78:65: Psalms 78:65 Then the Lord awoke as from sleep,  Like a mighty man who shouts because of wine.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 78:66: Psalms 78:66 And He beat back His enemies; He put them to a perpetual reproach.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 78:67: Psalms 78:67 Moreover He rejected the tent of Joseph, And did not choose the tribe of Ephraim,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 78:68: Psalms 78:68 But chose the tribe of Judah, Mount Zion which He loved.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 78:69: Psalms 78:69 And He built His sanctuary like the heights, Like the earth which He has established forever.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 78:70: Psalms 78:70 He also chose David His servant, And took him from the sheepfolds;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 78:71: Psalms 78:71 From following the ewes that had young He brought him,  To shepherd Jacob His people, And Israel His inheritance.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 78:72: Psalms 78:72 So he shepherded them according to the integrity of his heart, And guided them by the skillfulness of his hands.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 79:1: Psalms 79:1 A Psalm of Asaph.   O God, the nations have come into Your inheritance; Your holy temple they have defiled;  They have laid Jerusalem in heaps.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 79:2: Psalms 79:2 The dead bodies of Your servants They have given as food for the birds of the heavens, The flesh of Your saints to the beasts of the earth.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 79:3: Psalms 79:3 Their blood they have shed like water all around Jerusalem, And there was no one to bury them.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 79:4: Psalms 79:4 We have become a reproach to our neighbors, A scorn and derision to those who are around us.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 79:5: Psalms 79:5 How long, LORD? Will You be angry forever? Will Your jealousy burn like fire?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 79:6: Psalms 79:6 Pour out Your wrath on the nations that do not know You, And on the kingdoms that do not call on Your name.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 79:7: Psalms 79:7 For they have devoured Jacob, And laid waste his dwelling place.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 79:8: Psalms 79:8 Oh, do not remember former iniquities against us! Let Your tender mercies come speedily to meet us, For we have been brought very low.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 79:9: Psalms 79:9 Help us, O God of our salvation, For the glory of Your name; And deliver us, and provide atonement for our sins,  For Your name's sake!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 79:10: Psalms 79:10 Why should the nations say, "Where is their God?" Let there be known among the nations in our sight The avenging of the blood of Your servants which has been shed.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 79:11: Psalms 79:11 Let the groaning of the prisoner come before You; According to the greatness of Your power Preserve those who are appointed to die;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 79:12: Psalms 79:12 And return to our neighbors sevenfold into their bosom  Their reproach with which they have reproached You, O Lord.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 79:13: Psalms 79:13 So we, Your people and sheep of Your pasture, Will give You thanks forever;  We will show forth Your praise to all generations.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 80:1: Psalms 80:1 To the Chief Musician. Set to "The Lilies." A Testimony of Asaph. A Psalm.   Give ear, O Shepherd of Israel,  You who lead Joseph like a flock; You who dwell between the cherubim, shine forth!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 80:2: Psalms 80:2 Before Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh, Stir up Your strength, And come and save us!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 80:3: Psalms 80:3 Restore us, O God;  Cause Your face to shine, And we shall be saved!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 80:4: Psalms 80:4 O LORD God of hosts,  How long will You be angry Against the prayer of Your people?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 80:5: Psalms 80:5 You have fed them with the bread of tears, And given them tears to drink in great measure.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 80:6: Psalms 80:6 You have made us a strife to our neighbors, And our enemies laugh among themselves.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 80:7: Psalms 80:7 Restore us, O God of hosts; Cause Your face to shine, And we shall be saved!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 80:8: Psalms 80:8 You have brought a vine out of Egypt;  You have cast out the nations, and planted it.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 80:9: Psalms 80:9 You prepared room for it, And caused it to take deep root, And it filled the land.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 80:10: Psalms 80:10 The hills were covered with its shadow, And the mighty cedars with its boughs.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 80:11: Psalms 80:11 She sent out her boughs to the Sea, And her branches to the River.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 80:12: Psalms 80:12 Why have You broken down her hedges, So that all who pass by the way pluck her fruit?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 80:13: Psalms 80:13 The boar out of the woods uproots it, And the wild beast of the field devours it.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 80:14: Psalms 80:14 Return, we beseech You, O God of hosts;  Look down from heaven and see, And visit this vine(NKJV)
verses.psalms 80:15: Psalms 80:15 And the vineyard which Your right hand has planted, And the branch that You made strong for Yourself.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 80:16: Psalms 80:16 It is burned with fire, it is cut down;  They perish at the rebuke of Your countenance.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 80:17: Psalms 80:17 Let Your hand be upon the man of Your right hand, Upon the son of man whom You made strong for Yourself.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 80:18: Psalms 80:18 Then we will not turn back from You; Revive us, and we will call upon Your name.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 80:19: Psalms 80:19 Restore us, O LORD God of hosts; Cause Your face to shine, And we shall be saved!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 81:1: Psalms 81:1 To the Chief Musician. On an instrument of Gath. A Psalm of Asaph.   Sing aloud to God our strength; Make a joyful shout to the God of Jacob.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 81:2: Psalms 81:2 Raise a song and strike the timbrel, The pleasant harp with the lute.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 81:3: Psalms 81:3 Blow the trumpet at the time of the New Moon, At the full moon, on our solemn feast day.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 81:4: Psalms 81:4 For this is a statute for Israel, A law of the God of Jacob.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 81:5: Psalms 81:5 This He established in Joseph as a testimony, When He went throughout the land of Egypt,  Where I heard a language I did not understand.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 81:6: Psalms 81:6 "I removed his shoulder from the burden; His hands were freed from the baskets.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 81:7: Psalms 81:7 You called in trouble, and I delivered you;  I answered you in the secret place of thunder; I tested you at the waters of Meribah.  Selah(NKJV)
verses.psalms 81:8: Psalms 81:8 "Hear,  O My people, and I will admonish you! O Israel, if you will listen to Me!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 81:9: Psalms 81:9 There shall be no foreign god among you; Nor shall you worship any foreign god.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 81:10: Psalms 81:10 I am the LORD your God, Who brought you out of the land of Egypt;  Open your mouth wide, and I will fill it.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 81:11: Psalms 81:11 "But My people would not heed My voice, And Israel would have none of Me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 81:12: Psalms 81:12 So I gave them over to their own stubborn heart, To walk in their own counsels.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 81:13: Psalms 81:13 "Oh,  that My people would listen to Me, That Israel would walk in My ways!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 81:14: Psalms 81:14 I would soon subdue their enemies, And turn My hand against their adversaries.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 81:15: Psalms 81:15 The haters of the LORD would pretend submission to Him, But their fate would endure forever.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 81:16: Psalms 81:16 He would have fed them also with the finest of wheat; And with honey from the rock I would have satisfied you."(NKJV)
verses.psalms 82:1: Psalms 82:1 A Psalm of Asaph.   God stands in the congregation of the mighty; He judges among the gods.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 82:2: Psalms 82:2 How long will you judge unjustly, And show partiality to the wicked?  Selah(NKJV)
verses.psalms 82:3: Psalms 82:3 Defend the poor and fatherless; Do justice to the afflicted and needy.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 82:4: Psalms 82:4 Deliver the poor and needy; Free them from the hand of the wicked.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 82:5: Psalms 82:5 They do not know, nor do they understand; They walk about in darkness; All the foundations of the earth are unstable.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 82:6: Psalms 82:6 I said, "You are gods, And all of you are children of the Most High.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 82:7: Psalms 82:7 But you shall die like men, And fall like one of the princes."(NKJV)
verses.psalms 82:8: Psalms 82:8 Arise, O God, judge the earth;  For You shall inherit all nations.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 83:1: Psalms 83:1 A Song. A Psalm of Asaph.   Do  not keep silent, O God! Do not hold Your peace, And do not be still, O God!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 83:2: Psalms 83:2 For behold, Your enemies make a tumult; And those who hate You have lifted up their head.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 83:3: Psalms 83:3 They have taken crafty counsel against Your people, And consulted together against Your sheltered ones.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 83:4: Psalms 83:4 They have said, "Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation, That the name of Israel may be remembered no more."(NKJV)
verses.psalms 83:5: Psalms 83:5 For they have consulted together with one consent; They form a confederacy against You:(NKJV)
verses.psalms 83:6: Psalms 83:6 The tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites; Moab and the Hagrites;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 83:7: Psalms 83:7 Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek; Philistia with the inhabitants of Tyre;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 83:8: Psalms 83:8 Assyria also has joined with them; They have helped the children of Lot.  Selah(NKJV)
verses.psalms 83:9: Psalms 83:9 Deal with them as with Midian, As with Sisera, As with Jabin at the Brook Kishon,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 83:10: Psalms 83:10 Who perished at En Dor,  Who became as refuse on the earth.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 83:11: Psalms 83:11 Make their nobles like Oreb and like Zeeb, Yes, all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 83:12: Psalms 83:12 Who said, "Let us take for ourselves The pastures of God for a possession."(NKJV)
verses.psalms 83:13: Psalms 83:13 O my God, make them like the whirling dust,  Like the chaff before the wind!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 83:14: Psalms 83:14 As the fire burns the woods, And as the flame sets the mountains on fire,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 83:15: Psalms 83:15 So pursue them with Your tempest, And frighten them with Your storm.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 83:16: Psalms 83:16 Fill their faces with shame, That they may seek Your name, O LORD.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 83:17: Psalms 83:17 Let them be confounded and dismayed forever; Yes, let them be put to shame and perish,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 83:18: Psalms 83:18 That they may know that You, whose name alone is the LORD, Are the Most High over all the earth.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 84:1: Psalms 84:1 To the Chief Musician. On an instrument of Gath. A Psalm of the sons of Korah.   How lovely is Your tabernacle, O LORD of hosts!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 84:2: Psalms 84:2 My soul longs, yes, even faints For the courts of the LORD; My heart and my flesh cry out for the living God.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 84:3: Psalms 84:3 Even the sparrow has found a home, And the swallow a nest for herself, Where she may lay her young"” Even Your altars, O LORD of hosts, My King and my God.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 84:4: Psalms 84:4 Blessed are those who dwell in Your house; They will still be praising You.  Selah(NKJV)
verses.psalms 84:5: Psalms 84:5 Blessed is the man whose strength is in You, Whose heart is set on pilgrimage.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 84:6: Psalms 84:6 As they pass through the Valley of Baca, They make it a spring; The rain also covers it with pools.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 84:7: Psalms 84:7 They go from strength to strength; Each one appears before God in Zion.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 84:8: Psalms 84:8 O LORD God of hosts, hear my prayer; Give ear, O God of Jacob!  Selah(NKJV)
verses.psalms 84:9: Psalms 84:9 O God, behold our shield, And look upon the face of Your anointed.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 84:10: Psalms 84:10 For a day in Your courts is better than a thousand. I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God Than dwell in the tents of wickedness.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 84:11: Psalms 84:11 For the LORD God is a sun and shield; The LORD will give grace and glory;  No good thing will He withhold From those who walk uprightly.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 84:12: Psalms 84:12 O LORD of hosts,  Blessed is the man who trusts in You!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 85:1: Psalms 85:1 To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of the sons of Korah.   LORD, You have been favorable to Your land; You have brought back the captivity of Jacob.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 85:2: Psalms 85:2 You have forgiven the iniquity of Your people; You have covered all their sin.  Selah(NKJV)
verses.psalms 85:3: Psalms 85:3 You have taken away all Your wrath; You have turned from the fierceness of Your anger.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 85:4: Psalms 85:4 Restore us, O God of our salvation, And cause Your anger toward us to cease.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 85:5: Psalms 85:5 Will You be angry with us forever? Will You prolong Your anger to all generations?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 85:6: Psalms 85:6 Will You not revive us again, That Your people may rejoice in You?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 85:7: Psalms 85:7 Show us Your mercy, LORD, And grant us Your salvation.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 85:8: Psalms 85:8 I will hear what God the LORD will speak, For He will speak peace To His people and to His saints; But let them not turn back to folly.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 85:9: Psalms 85:9 Surely His salvation is near to those who fear Him,  That glory may dwell in our land.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 85:10: Psalms 85:10 Mercy and truth have met together;  Righteousness and peace have kissed.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 85:11: Psalms 85:11 Truth shall spring out of the earth, And righteousness shall look down from heaven.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 85:12: Psalms 85:12 Yes, the LORD will give what is good; And our land will yield its increase.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 85:13: Psalms 85:13 Righteousness will go before Him, And shall make His footsteps our pathway.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 86:1: Psalms 86:1 A Prayer of David.   Bow down Your ear, O LORD, hear me; For I am poor and needy.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 86:2: Psalms 86:2 Preserve my life, for I am holy; You are my God; Save Your servant who trusts in You!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 86:3: Psalms 86:3 Be merciful to me, O Lord, For I cry to You all day long.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 86:4: Psalms 86:4 Rejoice the soul of Your servant,  For to You, O Lord, I lift up my soul.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 86:5: Psalms 86:5 For You, Lord, are good, and ready to forgive, And abundant in mercy to all those who call upon You.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 86:6: Psalms 86:6 Give ear, O LORD, to my prayer; And attend to the voice of my supplications.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 86:7: Psalms 86:7 In the day of my trouble I will call upon You, For You will answer me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 86:8: Psalms 86:8 Among the gods there is none like You, O Lord; Nor are there any works like Your works.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 86:9: Psalms 86:9 All nations whom You have made Shall come and worship before You, O Lord, And shall glorify Your name.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 86:10: Psalms 86:10 For You are great, and do wondrous things;  You alone are God.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 86:11: Psalms 86:11 Teach me Your way, O LORD; I will walk in Your truth; Unite my heart to fear Your name.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 86:12: Psalms 86:12 I will praise You, O Lord my God, with all my heart, And I will glorify Your name forevermore.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 86:13: Psalms 86:13 For great is Your mercy toward me, And You have delivered my soul from the depths of Sheol.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 86:14: Psalms 86:14 O God, the proud have risen against me, And a mob of violent men have sought my life, And have not set You before them.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 86:15: Psalms 86:15 But You, O Lord, are a God full of compassion, and gracious, Longsuffering and abundant in mercy and truth.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 86:16: Psalms 86:16 Oh, turn to me, and have mercy on me! Give Your strength to Your servant, And save the son of Your maidservant.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 86:17: Psalms 86:17 Show me a sign for good, That those who hate me may see it and be ashamed, Because You, LORD, have helped me and comforted me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 87:1: Psalms 87:1 A Psalm of the sons of Korah. A Song.   His foundation is in the holy mountains.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 87:2: Psalms 87:2 The LORD loves the gates of Zion More than all the dwellings of Jacob.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 87:3: Psalms 87:3 Glorious things are spoken of you, O city of God!  Selah(NKJV)
verses.psalms 87:4: Psalms 87:4 "I will make mention of Rahab and Babylon to those who know Me; Behold, O Philistia and Tyre, with Ethiopia: "˜This one was born there.' "(NKJV)
verses.psalms 87:5: Psalms 87:5 And of Zion it will be said, "This one and that one were born in her; And the Most High Himself shall establish her."(NKJV)
verses.psalms 87:6: Psalms 87:6 The LORD will record, When He registers the peoples: "This one was born there."  Selah(NKJV)
verses.psalms 87:7: Psalms 87:7 Both the singers and the players on instruments say, "All my springs are in you."(NKJV)
verses.psalms 88:1: Psalms 88:1 A Song. A Psalm of the sons of Korah. To the Chief Musician. Set to "Mahalath Leannoth." A Contemplation of Heman the Ezrahite.   O LORD, God of my salvation, I have cried out day and night before You.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 88:2: Psalms 88:2 Let my prayer come before You; Incline Your ear to my cry.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 88:3: Psalms 88:3 For my soul is full of troubles, And my life draws near to the grave.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 88:4: Psalms 88:4 I am counted with those who go down to the pit;  I am like a man who has no strength,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 88:5: Psalms 88:5 Adrift among the dead, Like the slain who lie in the grave, Whom You remember no more, And who are cut off from Your hand.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 88:6: Psalms 88:6 You have laid me in the lowest pit, In darkness, in the depths.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 88:7: Psalms 88:7 Your wrath lies heavy upon me, And You have afflicted me with all Your waves.  Selah(NKJV)
verses.psalms 88:8: Psalms 88:8 You have put away my acquaintances far from me; You have made me an abomination to them;  I am shut up, and I cannot get out;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 88:9: Psalms 88:9 My eye wastes away because of affliction.  LORD, I have called daily upon You; I have stretched out my hands to You.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 88:10: Psalms 88:10 Will You work wonders for the dead? Shall the dead arise and praise You?  Selah(NKJV)
verses.psalms 88:11: Psalms 88:11 Shall Your lovingkindness be declared in the grave? Or Your faithfulness in the place of destruction?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 88:12: Psalms 88:12 Shall Your wonders be known in the dark? And Your righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 88:13: Psalms 88:13 But to You I have cried out, O LORD, And in the morning my prayer comes before You.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 88:14: Psalms 88:14 LORD, why do You cast off my soul? Why do You hide Your face from me?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 88:15: Psalms 88:15 I have been afflicted and ready to die from my youth; I suffer Your terrors; I am distraught.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 88:16: Psalms 88:16 Your fierce wrath has gone over me; Your terrors have cut me off.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 88:17: Psalms 88:17 They came around me all day long like water; They engulfed me altogether.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 88:18: Psalms 88:18 Loved one and friend You have put far from me, And my acquaintances into darkness.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 89:1: Psalms 89:1 A Contemplation of Ethan the Ezrahite.   I will sing of the mercies of the LORD forever; With my mouth will I make known Your faithfulness to all generations.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 89:2: Psalms 89:2 For I have said, "Mercy shall be built up forever;  Your faithfulness You shall establish in the very heavens."(NKJV)
verses.psalms 89:3: Psalms 89:3 "I  have made a covenant with My chosen, I have sworn to My servant David:(NKJV)
verses.psalms 89:4: Psalms 89:4 "˜Your seed I will establish forever, And build up your throne to all generations.' "  Selah(NKJV)
verses.psalms 89:5: Psalms 89:5 And the heavens will praise Your wonders, O LORD; Your faithfulness also in the assembly of the saints.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 89:6: Psalms 89:6 For who in the heavens can be compared to the LORD? Who among the sons of the mighty can be likened to the LORD?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 89:7: Psalms 89:7 God is greatly to be feared in the assembly of the saints, And to be held in reverence by all those around Him.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 89:8: Psalms 89:8 O LORD God of hosts, Who is mighty like You, O LORD? Your faithfulness also surrounds You.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 89:9: Psalms 89:9 You rule the raging of the sea; When its waves rise, You still them.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 89:10: Psalms 89:10 You have broken Rahab in pieces, as one who is slain; You have scattered Your enemies with Your mighty arm.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 89:11: Psalms 89:11 The heavens are Yours, the earth also is Yours; The world and all its fullness, You have founded them.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 89:12: Psalms 89:12 The north and the south, You have created them;  Tabor and Hermon rejoice in Your name.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 89:13: Psalms 89:13 You have a mighty arm; Strong is Your hand, and high is Your right hand.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 89:14: Psalms 89:14 Righteousness and justice are the foundation of Your throne; Mercy and truth go before Your face.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 89:15: Psalms 89:15 Blessed are the people who know the joyful sound! They walk, O LORD, in the light of Your countenance.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 89:16: Psalms 89:16 In Your name they rejoice all day long, And in Your righteousness they are exalted.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 89:17: Psalms 89:17 For You are the glory of their strength, And in Your favor our horn is exalted.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 89:18: Psalms 89:18 For our shield belongs to the LORD, And our king to the Holy One of Israel.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 89:19: Psalms 89:19 Then You spoke in a vision to Your holy one, And said: "I have given help to one who is mighty; I have exalted one chosen from the people.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 89:20: Psalms 89:20 I have found My servant David; With My holy oil I have anointed him,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 89:21: Psalms 89:21 With whom My hand shall be established; Also My arm shall strengthen him.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 89:22: Psalms 89:22 The enemy shall not outwit him, Nor the son of wickedness afflict him.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 89:23: Psalms 89:23 I will beat down his foes before his face, And plague those who hate him.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 89:24: Psalms 89:24 "But My faithfulness and My mercy shall be with him, And in My name his horn shall be exalted.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 89:25: Psalms 89:25 Also I will set his hand over the sea, And his right hand over the rivers.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 89:26: Psalms 89:26 He shall cry to Me, "˜You are my Father, My God, and the rock of my salvation.'(NKJV)
verses.psalms 89:27: Psalms 89:27 Also I will make him My firstborn,  The highest of the kings of the earth.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 89:28: Psalms 89:28 My mercy I will keep for him forever, And My covenant shall stand firm with him.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 89:29: Psalms 89:29 His seed also I will make to endure forever,  And his throne as the days of heaven.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 89:30: Psalms 89:30 "If  his sons forsake My law And do not walk in My judgments,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 89:31: Psalms 89:31 If they break My statutes And do not keep My commandments,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 89:32: Psalms 89:32 Then I will punish their transgression with the rod, And their iniquity with stripes.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 89:33: Psalms 89:33 Nevertheless My lovingkindness I will not utterly take from him, Nor allow My faithfulness to fail.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 89:34: Psalms 89:34 My covenant I will not break, Nor alter the word that has gone out of My lips.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 89:35: Psalms 89:35 Once I have sworn by My holiness; I will not lie to David:(NKJV)
verses.psalms 89:36: Psalms 89:36 His seed shall endure forever, And his throne as the sun before Me;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 89:37: Psalms 89:37 It shall be established forever like the moon, Even like the faithful witness in the sky."  Selah(NKJV)
verses.psalms 89:38: Psalms 89:38 But You have cast off and abhorred, You have been furious with Your anointed.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 89:39: Psalms 89:39 You have renounced the covenant of Your servant;  You have profaned his crown by casting it to the ground.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 89:40: Psalms 89:40 You have broken down all his hedges; You have brought his strongholds to ruin.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 89:41: Psalms 89:41 All who pass by the way plunder him; He is a reproach to his neighbors.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 89:42: Psalms 89:42 You have exalted the right hand of his adversaries; You have made all his enemies rejoice.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 89:43: Psalms 89:43 You have also turned back the edge of his sword, And have not sustained him in the battle.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 89:44: Psalms 89:44 You have made his glory cease, And cast his throne down to the ground.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 89:45: Psalms 89:45 The days of his youth You have shortened; You have covered him with shame.  Selah(NKJV)
verses.psalms 89:46: Psalms 89:46 How long, LORD? Will You hide Yourself forever? Will Your wrath burn like fire?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 89:47: Psalms 89:47 Remember how short my time is; For what futility have You created all the children of men?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 89:48: Psalms 89:48 What man can live and not see death? Can he deliver his life from the power of the grave?  Selah(NKJV)
verses.psalms 89:49: Psalms 89:49 Lord, where are Your former lovingkindnesses, Which You swore to David in Your truth?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 89:50: Psalms 89:50 Remember, Lord, the reproach of Your servants"”  How I bear in my bosom the reproach of all the many peoples,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 89:51: Psalms 89:51 With which Your enemies have reproached, O LORD, With which they have reproached the footsteps of Your anointed.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 89:52: Psalms 89:52 Blessed be the LORD forevermore! Amen and Amen.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 90:1: Psalms 90:1 A Prayer of Moses the man of God.   Lord, You have been our dwelling place in all generations.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 90:2: Psalms 90:2 Before the mountains were brought forth, Or ever You had formed the earth and the world, Even from everlasting to everlasting, You are God.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 90:3: Psalms 90:3 You turn man to destruction, And say, "Return, O children of men."(NKJV)
verses.psalms 90:4: Psalms 90:4 For a thousand years in Your sight Are like yesterday when it is past, And like a watch in the night.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 90:5: Psalms 90:5 You carry them away like a flood;  They are like a sleep. In the morning they are like grass which grows up:(NKJV)
verses.psalms 90:6: Psalms 90:6 In the morning it flourishes and grows up; In the evening it is cut down and withers.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 90:7: Psalms 90:7 For we have been consumed by Your anger, And by Your wrath we are terrified.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 90:8: Psalms 90:8 You have set our iniquities before You, Our secret sins in the light of Your countenance.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 90:9: Psalms 90:9 For all our days have passed away in Your wrath; We finish our years like a sigh.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 90:10: Psalms 90:10 The days of our lives are seventy years; And if by reason of strength they are eighty years, Yet their boast is only labor and sorrow; For it is soon cut off, and we fly away.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 90:11: Psalms 90:11 Who knows the power of Your anger? For as the fear of You, so is Your wrath.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 90:12: Psalms 90:12 So teach us to number our days, That we may gain a heart of wisdom.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 90:13: Psalms 90:13 Return, O LORD! How long? And have compassion on Your servants.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 90:14: Psalms 90:14 Oh, satisfy us early with Your mercy,  That we may rejoice and be glad all our days!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 90:15: Psalms 90:15 Make us glad according to the days in which You have afflicted us, The years in which we have seen evil.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 90:16: Psalms 90:16 Let Your work appear to Your servants, And Your glory to their children.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 90:17: Psalms 90:17 And let the beauty of the LORD our God be upon us, And establish the work of our hands for us; Yes, establish the work of our hands.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 91:1: Psalms 91:1 He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High Shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 91:2: Psalms 91:2 I will say of the LORD, "He is my refuge and my fortress; My God, in Him I will trust."(NKJV)
verses.psalms 91:3: Psalms 91:3 Surely He shall deliver you from the snare of the fowler And from the perilous pestilence.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 91:4: Psalms 91:4 He shall cover you with His feathers, And under His wings you shall take refuge; His truth shall be your shield and buckler.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 91:5: Psalms 91:5 You shall not be afraid of the terror by night, Nor of the arrow that flies by day,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 91:6: Psalms 91:6 Nor of the pestilence that walks in darkness, Nor of the destruction that lays waste at noonday.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 91:7: Psalms 91:7 A thousand may fall at your side, And ten thousand at your right hand; But it shall not come near you.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 91:8: Psalms 91:8 Only with your eyes shall you look, And see the reward of the wicked.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 91:9: Psalms 91:9 Because you have made the LORD, who is my refuge, Even the Most High, your dwelling place,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 91:10: Psalms 91:10 No evil shall befall you, Nor shall any plague come near your dwelling;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 91:11: Psalms 91:11 For He shall give His angels charge over you, To keep you in all your ways.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 91:12: Psalms 91:12 In their hands they shall bear you up,  Lest you dash your foot against a stone.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 91:13: Psalms 91:13 You shall tread upon the lion and the cobra, The young lion and the serpent you shall trample underfoot.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 91:14: Psalms 91:14 "Because he has set his love upon Me, therefore I will deliver him; I will set him on high, because he has known My name.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 91:15: Psalms 91:15 He shall call upon Me, and I will answer him; I will be with him in trouble; I will deliver him and honor him.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 91:16: Psalms 91:16 With long life I will satisfy him, And show him My salvation."(NKJV)
verses.psalms 92:1: Psalms 92:1 A Psalm. A Song for the Sabbath day.   It is good to give thanks to the LORD, And to sing praises to Your name, O Most High;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 92:2: Psalms 92:2 To declare Your lovingkindness in the morning, And Your faithfulness every night,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 92:3: Psalms 92:3 On an instrument of ten strings, On the lute, And on the harp, With harmonious sound.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 92:4: Psalms 92:4 For You, LORD, have made me glad through Your work; I will triumph in the works of Your hands.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 92:5: Psalms 92:5 O LORD, how great are Your works!  Your thoughts are very deep.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 92:6: Psalms 92:6 A senseless man does not know, Nor does a fool understand this.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 92:7: Psalms 92:7 When the wicked spring up like grass, And when all the workers of iniquity flourish, It is that they may be destroyed forever.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 92:8: Psalms 92:8 But You, LORD, are on high forevermore.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 92:9: Psalms 92:9 For behold, Your enemies, O LORD, For behold, Your enemies shall perish; All the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 92:10: Psalms 92:10 But my horn You have exalted like a wild ox; I have been anointed with fresh oil.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 92:11: Psalms 92:11 My eye also has seen my desire on my enemies; My ears hear my desire on the wicked Who rise up against me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 92:12: Psalms 92:12 The righteous shall flourish like a palm tree, He shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 92:13: Psalms 92:13 Those who are planted in the house of the LORD Shall flourish in the courts of our God.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 92:14: Psalms 92:14 They shall still bear fruit in old age; They shall be fresh and flourishing,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 92:15: Psalms 92:15 To declare that the LORD is upright;  He is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in Him.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 93:1: Psalms 93:1 The LORD reigns, He is clothed with majesty; The LORD is clothed,  He has girded Himself with strength. Surely the world is established, so that it cannot be moved.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 93:2: Psalms 93:2 Your throne is established from of old; You are from everlasting.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 93:3: Psalms 93:3 The floods have lifted up, O LORD, The floods have lifted up their voice; The floods lift up their waves.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 93:4: Psalms 93:4 The LORD on high is mightier Than the noise of many waters, Than the mighty waves of the sea.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 93:5: Psalms 93:5 Your testimonies are very sure; Holiness adorns Your house, O LORD, forever.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 94:1: Psalms 94:1 O LORD God, to whom vengeance belongs"” O God, to whom vengeance belongs, shine forth!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 94:2: Psalms 94:2 Rise up, O Judge of the earth; Render punishment to the proud.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 94:3: Psalms 94:3 LORD, how long will the wicked, How long will the wicked triumph?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 94:4: Psalms 94:4 They utter speech, and speak insolent things; All the workers of iniquity boast in themselves.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 94:5: Psalms 94:5 They break in pieces Your people, O LORD, And afflict Your heritage.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 94:6: Psalms 94:6 They slay the widow and the stranger, And murder the fatherless.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 94:7: Psalms 94:7 Yet they say, "The LORD does not see, Nor does the God of Jacob understand."(NKJV)
verses.psalms 94:8: Psalms 94:8 Understand, you senseless among the people; And you fools, when will you be wise?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 94:9: Psalms 94:9 He who planted the ear, shall He not hear? He who formed the eye, shall He not see?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 94:10: Psalms 94:10 He who instructs the nations, shall He not correct, He who teaches man knowledge?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 94:11: Psalms 94:11 The LORD knows the thoughts of man, That they are futile.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 94:12: Psalms 94:12 Blessed is the man whom You instruct, O LORD, And teach out of Your law,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 94:13: Psalms 94:13 That You may give him rest from the days of adversity, Until the pit is dug for the wicked.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 94:14: Psalms 94:14 For the LORD will not cast off His people, Nor will He forsake His inheritance.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 94:15: Psalms 94:15 But judgment will return to righteousness, And all the upright in heart will follow it.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 94:16: Psalms 94:16 Who will rise up for me against the evildoers? Who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 94:17: Psalms 94:17 Unless the LORD had been my help, My soul would soon have settled in silence.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 94:18: Psalms 94:18 If I say, "My foot slips," Your mercy, O LORD, will hold me up.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 94:19: Psalms 94:19 In the multitude of my anxieties within me, Your comforts delight my soul.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 94:20: Psalms 94:20 Shall the throne of iniquity, which devises evil by law, Have fellowship with You?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 94:21: Psalms 94:21 They gather together against the life of the righteous, And condemn innocent blood.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 94:22: Psalms 94:22 But the LORD has been my defense, And my God the rock of my refuge.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 94:23: Psalms 94:23 He has brought on them their own iniquity, And shall cut them off in their own wickedness; The LORD our God shall cut them off.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 95:1: Psalms 95:1 Oh come, let us sing to the LORD! Let us shout joyfully to the Rock of our salvation.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 95:2: Psalms 95:2 Let us come before His presence with thanksgiving; Let us shout joyfully to Him with psalms.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 95:3: Psalms 95:3 For the LORD is the great God, And the great King above all gods.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 95:4: Psalms 95:4 In His hand are the deep places of the earth; The heights of the hills are His also.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 95:5: Psalms 95:5 The sea is His, for He made it; And His hands formed the dry land.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 95:6: Psalms 95:6 Oh come, let us worship and bow down; Let us kneel before the LORD our Maker.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 95:7: Psalms 95:7 For He is our God, And we are the people of His pasture, And the sheep of His hand.  Today, if you will hear His voice:(NKJV)
verses.psalms 95:8: Psalms 95:8 "Do not harden your hearts, as in the rebellion,  As in the day of trial in the wilderness,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 95:9: Psalms 95:9 When your fathers tested Me; They tried Me, though they saw My work.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 95:10: Psalms 95:10 For forty years I was grieved with that generation, And said, "˜It is a people who go astray in their hearts, And they do not know My ways.'(NKJV)
verses.psalms 95:11: Psalms 95:11 So I swore in My wrath, "˜They shall not enter My rest.' "(NKJV)
verses.psalms 96:1: Psalms 96:1 Oh, sing to the LORD a new song! Sing to the LORD, all the earth.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 96:2: Psalms 96:2 Sing to the LORD, bless His name; Proclaim the good news of His salvation from day to day.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 96:3: Psalms 96:3 Declare His glory among the nations, His wonders among all peoples.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 96:4: Psalms 96:4 For the LORD is great and greatly to be praised;  He is to be feared above all gods.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 96:5: Psalms 96:5 For all the gods of the peoples are idols,  But the LORD made the heavens.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 96:6: Psalms 96:6 Honor and majesty are before Him; Strength and beauty are in His sanctuary.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 96:7: Psalms 96:7 Give to the LORD, O families of the peoples, Give to the LORD glory and strength.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 96:8: Psalms 96:8 Give to the LORD the glory due His name; Bring an offering, and come into His courts.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 96:9: Psalms 96:9 Oh, worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness! Tremble before Him, all the earth.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 96:10: Psalms 96:10 Say among the nations, "The LORD reigns; The world also is firmly established, It shall not be moved;  He shall judge the peoples righteously."(NKJV)
verses.psalms 96:11: Psalms 96:11 Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be glad;  Let the sea roar, and all its fullness;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 96:12: Psalms 96:12 Let the field be joyful, and all that is in it. Then all the trees of the woods will rejoice before the LORD.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 96:13: Psalms 96:13 For He is coming, for He is coming to judge the earth.  He shall judge the world with righteousness, And the peoples with His truth.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 97:1: Psalms 97:1 The LORD reigns; Let the earth rejoice; Let the multitude of isles be glad!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 97:2: Psalms 97:2 Clouds and darkness surround Him;  Righteousness and justice are the foundation of His throne.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 97:3: Psalms 97:3 A fire goes before Him, And burns up His enemies round about.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 97:4: Psalms 97:4 His lightnings light the world; The earth sees and trembles.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 97:5: Psalms 97:5 The mountains melt like wax at the presence of the LORD, At the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 97:6: Psalms 97:6 The heavens declare His righteousness, And all the peoples see His glory.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 97:7: Psalms 97:7 Let all be put to shame who serve carved images, Who boast of idols.  Worship Him, all you gods.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 97:8: Psalms 97:8 Zion hears and is glad, And the daughters of Judah rejoice Because of Your judgments, O LORD.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 97:9: Psalms 97:9 For You, LORD, are most high above all the earth;  You are exalted far above all gods.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 97:10: Psalms 97:10 You who love the LORD, hate evil!  He preserves the souls of His saints;  He delivers them out of the hand of the wicked.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 97:11: Psalms 97:11 Light is sown for the righteous, And gladness for the upright in heart.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 97:12: Psalms 97:12 Rejoice in the LORD, you righteous,  And give thanks at the remembrance of His holy name.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 98:1: Psalms 98:1 A Psalm.   Oh, sing to the LORD a new song! For He has done marvelous things; His right hand and His holy arm have gained Him the victory.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 98:2: Psalms 98:2 The LORD has made known His salvation;  His righteousness He has revealed in the sight of the nations.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 98:3: Psalms 98:3 He has remembered His mercy and His faithfulness to the house of Israel;  All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 98:4: Psalms 98:4 Shout joyfully to the LORD, all the earth; Break forth in song, rejoice, and sing praises.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 98:5: Psalms 98:5 Sing to the LORD with the harp, With the harp and the sound of a psalm,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 98:6: Psalms 98:6 With trumpets and the sound of a horn; Shout joyfully before the LORD, the King.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 98:7: Psalms 98:7 Let the sea roar, and all its fullness, The world and those who dwell in it;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 98:8: Psalms 98:8 Let the rivers clap their hands; Let the hills be joyful together before the LORD,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 98:9: Psalms 98:9 For He is coming to judge the earth. With righteousness He shall judge the world, And the peoples with equity.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 99:1: Psalms 99:1 The LORD reigns; Let the peoples tremble!  He dwells between the cherubim; Let the earth be moved!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 99:2: Psalms 99:2 The LORD is great in Zion, And He is high above all the peoples.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 99:3: Psalms 99:3 Let them praise Your great and awesome name"” He is holy.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 99:4: Psalms 99:4 The King's strength also loves justice; You have established equity; You have executed justice and righteousness in Jacob.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 99:5: Psalms 99:5 Exalt the LORD our God, And worship at His footstool"” He is holy.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 99:6: Psalms 99:6 Moses and Aaron were among His priests, And Samuel was among those who called upon His name; They called upon the LORD, and He answered them.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 99:7: Psalms 99:7 He spoke to them in the cloudy pillar; They kept His testimonies and the ordinance He gave them.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 99:8: Psalms 99:8 You answered them, O LORD our God; You were to them God-Who-Forgives, Though You took vengeance on their deeds.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 99:9: Psalms 99:9 Exalt the LORD our God, And worship at His holy hill; For the LORD our God is holy.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 100:1: Psalms 100:1 A Psalm of Thanksgiving.   Make a joyful shout to the LORD, all you lands!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 100:2: Psalms 100:2 Serve the LORD with gladness; Come before His presence with singing.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 100:3: Psalms 100:3 Know that the LORD, He is God;  It is He who has made us, and not we ourselves;  We are His people and the sheep of His pasture.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 100:4: Psalms 100:4 Enter into His gates with thanksgiving, And into His courts with praise. Be thankful to Him, and bless His name.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 100:5: Psalms 100:5 For the LORD is good;  His mercy is everlasting, And His truth endures to all generations.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 101:1: Psalms 101:1 A Psalm of David.   I will sing of mercy and justice; To You, O LORD, I will sing praises.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 101:2: Psalms 101:2 I will behave wisely in a perfect way. Oh, when will You come to me? I will walk within my house with a perfect heart.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 101:3: Psalms 101:3 I will set nothing wicked before my eyes;  I hate the work of those who fall away; It shall not cling to me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 101:4: Psalms 101:4 A perverse heart shall depart from me; I will not know wickedness.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 101:5: Psalms 101:5 Whoever secretly slanders his neighbor, Him I will destroy;  The one who has a haughty look and a proud heart, Him I will not endure.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 101:6: Psalms 101:6 My eyes shall be on the faithful of the land, That they may dwell with me; He who walks in a perfect way, He shall serve me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 101:7: Psalms 101:7 He who works deceit shall not dwell within my house; He who tells lies shall not continue in my presence.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 101:8: Psalms 101:8 Early I will destroy all the wicked of the land, That I may cut off all the evildoers from the city of the LORD.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 102:1: Psalms 102:1 A Prayer of the afflicted, when he is overwhelmed and pours out his complaint before the LORD.   Hear my prayer, O LORD, And let my cry come to You.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 102:2: Psalms 102:2 Do not hide Your face from me in the day of my trouble; Incline Your ear to me; In the day that I call, answer me speedily.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 102:3: Psalms 102:3 For my days are consumed like smoke, And my bones are burned like a hearth.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 102:4: Psalms 102:4 My heart is stricken and withered like grass, So that I forget to eat my bread.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 102:5: Psalms 102:5 Because of the sound of my groaning My bones cling to my skin.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 102:6: Psalms 102:6 I am like a pelican of the wilderness; I am like an owl of the desert.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 102:7: Psalms 102:7 I lie awake, And am like a sparrow alone on the housetop.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 102:8: Psalms 102:8 My enemies reproach me all day long; Those who deride me swear an oath against me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 102:9: Psalms 102:9 For I have eaten ashes like bread, And mingled my drink with weeping,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 102:10: Psalms 102:10 Because of Your indignation and Your wrath; For You have lifted me up and cast me away.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 102:11: Psalms 102:11 My days are like a shadow that lengthens, And I wither away like grass.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 102:12: Psalms 102:12 But You, O LORD, shall endure forever, And the remembrance of Your name to all generations.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 102:13: Psalms 102:13 You will arise and have mercy on Zion; For the time to favor her, Yes, the set time, has come.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 102:14: Psalms 102:14 For Your servants take pleasure in her stones, And show favor to her dust.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 102:15: Psalms 102:15 So the nations shall fear the name of the LORD, And all the kings of the earth Your glory.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 102:16: Psalms 102:16 For the LORD shall build up Zion;  He shall appear in His glory.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 102:17: Psalms 102:17 He shall regard the prayer of the destitute, And shall not despise their prayer.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 102:18: Psalms 102:18 This will be written for the generation to come, That a people yet to be created may praise the LORD.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 102:19: Psalms 102:19 For He looked down from the height of His sanctuary; From heaven the LORD viewed the earth,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 102:20: Psalms 102:20 To hear the groaning of the prisoner, To release those appointed to death,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 102:21: Psalms 102:21 To declare the name of the LORD in Zion, And His praise in Jerusalem,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 102:22: Psalms 102:22 When the peoples are gathered together, And the kingdoms, to serve the LORD.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 102:23: Psalms 102:23 He weakened my strength in the way; He shortened my days.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 102:24: Psalms 102:24 I said, "O my God, Do not take me away in the midst of my days;  Your years are throughout all generations.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 102:25: Psalms 102:25 Of old You laid the foundation of the earth, And the heavens are the work of Your hands.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 102:26: Psalms 102:26 They will perish, but You will endure; Yes, they will all grow old like a garment; Like a cloak You will change them, And they will be changed.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 102:27: Psalms 102:27 But You are the same, And Your years will have no end.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 102:28: Psalms 102:28 The children of Your servants will continue, And their descendants will be established before You."(NKJV)
verses.psalms 103:1: Psalms 103:1 A Psalm of David.   Bless the LORD, O my soul; And all that is within me, bless His holy name!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 103:2: Psalms 103:2 Bless the LORD, O my soul, And forget not all His benefits:(NKJV)
verses.psalms 103:3: Psalms 103:3 Who forgives all your iniquities, Who heals all your diseases,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 103:4: Psalms 103:4 Who redeems your life from destruction,  Who crowns you with lovingkindness and tender mercies,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 103:5: Psalms 103:5 Who satisfies your mouth with good things, So that your youth is renewed like the eagle's.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 103:6: Psalms 103:6 The LORD executes righteousness And justice for all who are oppressed.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 103:7: Psalms 103:7 He made known His ways to Moses, His acts to the children of Israel.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 103:8: Psalms 103:8 The LORD is merciful and gracious, Slow to anger, and abounding in mercy.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 103:9: Psalms 103:9 He will not always strive with us, Nor will He keep His anger forever.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 103:10: Psalms 103:10 He has not dealt with us according to our sins, Nor punished us according to our iniquities.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 103:11: Psalms 103:11 For as the heavens are high above the earth, So great is His mercy toward those who fear Him;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 103:12: Psalms 103:12 As far as the east is from the west, So far has He removed our transgressions from us.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 103:13: Psalms 103:13 As a father pities his children, So the LORD pities those who fear Him.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 103:14: Psalms 103:14 For He knows our frame; He remembers that we are dust.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 103:15: Psalms 103:15 As for man, his days are like grass; As a flower of the field, so he flourishes.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 103:16: Psalms 103:16 For the wind passes over it, and it is gone, And its place remembers it no more.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 103:17: Psalms 103:17 But the mercy of the LORD is from everlasting to everlasting On those who fear Him, And His righteousness to children's children,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 103:18: Psalms 103:18 To such as keep His covenant, And to those who remember His commandments to do them.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 103:19: Psalms 103:19 The LORD has established His throne in heaven, And His kingdom rules over all.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 103:20: Psalms 103:20 Bless the LORD, you His angels, Who excel in strength, who do His word, Heeding the voice of His word.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 103:21: Psalms 103:21 Bless the LORD, all you His hosts,  You ministers of His, who do His pleasure.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 103:22: Psalms 103:22 Bless the LORD, all His works, In all places of His dominion. Bless the LORD, O my soul!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 104:1: Psalms 104:1 Bless the LORD, O my soul! O LORD my God, You are very great: You are clothed with honor and majesty,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 104:2: Psalms 104:2 Who cover Yourself with light as with a garment, Who stretch out the heavens like a curtain.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 104:3: Psalms 104:3 He lays the beams of His upper chambers in the waters, Who makes the clouds His chariot, Who walks on the wings of the wind,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 104:4: Psalms 104:4 Who makes His angels spirits, His ministers a flame of fire.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 104:5: Psalms 104:5 You who laid the foundations of the earth, So that it should not be moved forever,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 104:6: Psalms 104:6 You covered it with the deep as with a garment; The waters stood above the mountains.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 104:7: Psalms 104:7 At Your rebuke they fled; At the voice of Your thunder they hastened away.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 104:8: Psalms 104:8 They went up over the mountains; They went down into the valleys, To the place which You founded for them.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 104:9: Psalms 104:9 You have set a boundary that they may not pass over,  That they may not return to cover the earth.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 104:10: Psalms 104:10 He sends the springs into the valleys; They flow among the hills.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 104:11: Psalms 104:11 They give drink to every beast of the field; The wild donkeys quench their thirst.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 104:12: Psalms 104:12 By them the birds of the heavens have their home; They sing among the branches.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 104:13: Psalms 104:13 He waters the hills from His upper chambers; The earth is satisfied with the fruit of Your works.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 104:14: Psalms 104:14 He causes the grass to grow for the cattle, And vegetation for the service of man, That he may bring forth food from the earth,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 104:15: Psalms 104:15 And wine that makes glad the heart of man, Oil to make his face shine, And bread which strengthens man's heart.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 104:16: Psalms 104:16 The trees of the LORD are full of sap, The cedars of Lebanon which He planted,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 104:17: Psalms 104:17 Where the birds make their nests; The stork has her home in the fir trees.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 104:18: Psalms 104:18 The high hills are for the wild goats; The cliffs are a refuge for the rock badgers.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 104:19: Psalms 104:19 He appointed the moon for seasons; The sun knows its going down.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 104:20: Psalms 104:20 You make darkness, and it is night, In which all the beasts of the forest creep about.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 104:21: Psalms 104:21 The young lions roar after their prey, And seek their food from God.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 104:22: Psalms 104:22 When the sun rises, they gather together And lie down in their dens.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 104:23: Psalms 104:23 Man goes out to his work And to his labor until the evening.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 104:24: Psalms 104:24 O LORD, how manifold are Your works! In wisdom You have made them all. The earth is full of Your possessions"”(NKJV)
verses.psalms 104:25: Psalms 104:25 This great and wide sea, In which are innumerable teeming things, Living things both small and great.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 104:26: Psalms 104:26 There the ships sail about; There is that Leviathan Which You have made to play there.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 104:27: Psalms 104:27 These all wait for You, That You may give them their food in due season.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 104:28: Psalms 104:28 What You give them they gather in; You open Your hand, they are filled with good.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 104:29: Psalms 104:29 You hide Your face, they are troubled;  You take away their breath, they die and return to their dust.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 104:30: Psalms 104:30 You send forth Your Spirit, they are created; And You renew the face of the earth.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 104:31: Psalms 104:31 May the glory of the LORD endure forever; May the LORD rejoice in His works.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 104:32: Psalms 104:32 He looks on the earth, and it trembles;  He touches the hills, and they smoke.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 104:33: Psalms 104:33 I will sing to the LORD as long as I live; I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 104:34: Psalms 104:34 May my meditation be sweet to Him; I will be glad in the LORD.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 104:35: Psalms 104:35 May sinners be consumed from the earth, And the wicked be no more. Bless the LORD, O my soul! Praise the LORD!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 105:1: Psalms 105:1 Oh, give thanks to the LORD! Call upon His name;  Make known His deeds among the peoples!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 105:2: Psalms 105:2 Sing to Him, sing psalms to Him;  Talk of all His wondrous works!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 105:3: Psalms 105:3 Glory in His holy name; Let the hearts of those rejoice who seek the LORD!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 105:4: Psalms 105:4 Seek the LORD and His strength;  Seek His face evermore!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 105:5: Psalms 105:5 Remember His marvelous works which He has done, His wonders, and the judgments of His mouth,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 105:6: Psalms 105:6 O seed of Abraham His servant, You children of Jacob, His chosen ones!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 105:7: Psalms 105:7 He is the LORD our God;  His judgments are in all the earth.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 105:8: Psalms 105:8 He remembers His covenant forever, The word which He commanded, for a thousand generations,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 105:9: Psalms 105:9 The covenant which He made with Abraham, And His oath to Isaac,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 105:10: Psalms 105:10 And confirmed it to Jacob for a statute, To Israel as an everlasting covenant,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 105:11: Psalms 105:11 Saying, "To you I will give the land of Canaan As the allotment of your inheritance,"(NKJV)
verses.psalms 105:12: Psalms 105:12 When they were few in number, Indeed very few, and strangers in it.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 105:13: Psalms 105:13 When they went from one nation to another, From one kingdom to another people,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 105:14: Psalms 105:14 He permitted no one to do them wrong; Yes, He rebuked kings for their sakes,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 105:15: Psalms 105:15 Saying, "Do not touch My anointed ones, And do My prophets no harm."(NKJV)
verses.psalms 105:16: Psalms 105:16 Moreover He called for a famine in the land; He destroyed all the provision of bread.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 105:17: Psalms 105:17 He sent a man before them"” Joseph"”who was sold as a slave.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 105:18: Psalms 105:18 They hurt his feet with fetters, He was laid in irons.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 105:19: Psalms 105:19 Until the time that his word came to pass,  The word of the LORD tested him.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 105:20: Psalms 105:20 The king sent and released him, The ruler of the people let him go free.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 105:21: Psalms 105:21 He made him lord of his house, And ruler of all his possessions,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 105:22: Psalms 105:22 To bind his princes at his pleasure, And teach his elders wisdom.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 105:23: Psalms 105:23 Israel also came into Egypt, And Jacob dwelt in the land of Ham.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 105:24: Psalms 105:24 He increased His people greatly, And made them stronger than their enemies.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 105:25: Psalms 105:25 He turned their heart to hate His people, To deal craftily with His servants.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 105:26: Psalms 105:26 He sent Moses His servant, And Aaron whom He had chosen.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 105:27: Psalms 105:27 They performed His signs among them, And wonders in the land of Ham.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 105:28: Psalms 105:28 He sent darkness, and made it dark; And they did not rebel against His word.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 105:29: Psalms 105:29 He turned their waters into blood, And killed their fish.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 105:30: Psalms 105:30 Their land abounded with frogs, Even in the chambers of their kings.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 105:31: Psalms 105:31 He spoke, and there came swarms of flies, And lice in all their territory.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 105:32: Psalms 105:32 He gave them hail for rain, And flaming fire in their land.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 105:33: Psalms 105:33 He struck their vines also, and their fig trees, And splintered the trees of their territory.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 105:34: Psalms 105:34 He spoke, and locusts came, Young locusts without number,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 105:35: Psalms 105:35 And ate up all the vegetation in their land, And devoured the fruit of their ground.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 105:36: Psalms 105:36 He also destroyed all the firstborn in their land,  The first of all their strength.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 105:37: Psalms 105:37 He also brought them out with silver and gold, And there was none feeble among His tribes.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 105:38: Psalms 105:38 Egypt was glad when they departed, For the fear of them had fallen upon them.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 105:39: Psalms 105:39 He spread a cloud for a covering, And fire to give light in the night.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 105:40: Psalms 105:40 The people asked, and He brought quail, And satisfied them with the bread of heaven.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 105:41: Psalms 105:41 He opened the rock, and water gushed out; It ran in the dry places like a river.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 105:42: Psalms 105:42 For He remembered His holy promise, And Abraham His servant.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 105:43: Psalms 105:43 He brought out His people with joy, His chosen ones with gladness.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 105:44: Psalms 105:44 He gave them the lands of the Gentiles, And they inherited the labor of the nations,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 105:45: Psalms 105:45 That they might observe His statutes And keep His laws. Praise the LORD!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 106:1: Psalms 106:1 Praise the LORD!  Oh, give thanks to the LORD, for He is good! For His mercy endures forever.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 106:2: Psalms 106:2 Who can utter the mighty acts of the LORD? Who can declare all His praise?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 106:3: Psalms 106:3 Blessed are those who keep justice, And he who does righteousness at all times!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 106:4: Psalms 106:4 Remember me, O LORD, with the favor You have toward Your people. Oh, visit me with Your salvation,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 106:5: Psalms 106:5 That I may see the benefit of Your chosen ones, That I may rejoice in the gladness of Your nation, That I may glory with Your inheritance.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 106:6: Psalms 106:6 We have sinned with our fathers, We have committed iniquity, We have done wickedly.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 106:7: Psalms 106:7 Our fathers in Egypt did not understand Your wonders; They did not remember the multitude of Your mercies,  But rebelled by the sea"”the Red Sea.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 106:8: Psalms 106:8 Nevertheless He saved them for His name's sake,  That He might make His mighty power known.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 106:9: Psalms 106:9 He rebuked the Red Sea also, and it dried up; So He led them through the depths, As through the wilderness.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 106:10: Psalms 106:10 He saved them from the hand of him who hated them, And redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 106:11: Psalms 106:11 The waters covered their enemies; There was not one of them left.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 106:12: Psalms 106:12 Then they believed His words; They sang His praise.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 106:13: Psalms 106:13 They soon forgot His works; They did not wait for His counsel,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 106:14: Psalms 106:14 But lusted exceedingly in the wilderness, And tested God in the desert.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 106:15: Psalms 106:15 And He gave them their request, But sent leanness into their soul.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 106:16: Psalms 106:16 When they envied Moses in the camp, And Aaron the saint of the LORD,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 106:17: Psalms 106:17 The earth opened up and swallowed Dathan, And covered the faction of Abiram.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 106:18: Psalms 106:18 A fire was kindled in their company; The flame burned up the wicked.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 106:19: Psalms 106:19 They made a calf in Horeb, And worshiped the molded image.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 106:20: Psalms 106:20 Thus they changed their glory Into the image of an ox that eats grass.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 106:21: Psalms 106:21 They forgot God their Savior, Who had done great things in Egypt,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 106:22: Psalms 106:22 Wondrous works in the land of Ham, Awesome things by the Red Sea.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 106:23: Psalms 106:23 Therefore He said that He would destroy them, Had not Moses His chosen one stood before Him in the breach, To turn away His wrath, lest He destroy them.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 106:24: Psalms 106:24 Then they despised the pleasant land; They did not believe His word,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 106:25: Psalms 106:25 But complained in their tents, And did not heed the voice of the LORD.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 106:26: Psalms 106:26 Therefore He raised His hand in an oath against them,  To overthrow them in the wilderness,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 106:27: Psalms 106:27 To overthrow their descendants among the nations, And to scatter them in the lands.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 106:28: Psalms 106:28 They joined themselves also to Baal of Peor, And ate sacrifices made to the dead.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 106:29: Psalms 106:29 Thus they provoked Him to anger with their deeds, And the plague broke out among them.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 106:30: Psalms 106:30 Then Phinehas stood up and intervened, And the plague was stopped.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 106:31: Psalms 106:31 And that was accounted to him for righteousness To all generations forevermore.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 106:32: Psalms 106:32 They angered Him also at the waters of strife,  So that it went ill with Moses on account of them;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 106:33: Psalms 106:33 Because they rebelled against His Spirit, So that he spoke rashly with his lips.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 106:34: Psalms 106:34 They did not destroy the peoples,  Concerning whom the LORD had commanded them,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 106:35: Psalms 106:35 But they mingled with the Gentiles And learned their works;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 106:36: Psalms 106:36 They served their idols,  Which became a snare to them.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 106:37: Psalms 106:37 They even sacrificed their sons And their daughters to demons,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 106:38: Psalms 106:38 And shed innocent blood, The blood of their sons and daughters, Whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan; And the land was polluted with blood.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 106:39: Psalms 106:39 Thus they were defiled by their own works, And played the harlot by their own deeds.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 106:40: Psalms 106:40 Therefore the wrath of the LORD was kindled against His people, So that He abhorred His own inheritance.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 106:41: Psalms 106:41 And He gave them into the hand of the Gentiles, And those who hated them ruled over them.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 106:42: Psalms 106:42 Their enemies also oppressed them, And they were brought into subjection under their hand.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 106:43: Psalms 106:43 Many times He delivered them; But they rebelled in their counsel, And were brought low for their iniquity.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 106:44: Psalms 106:44 Nevertheless He regarded their affliction, When He heard their cry;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 106:45: Psalms 106:45 And for their sake He remembered His covenant, And relented according to the multitude of His mercies.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 106:46: Psalms 106:46 He also made them to be pitied By all those who carried them away captive.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 106:47: Psalms 106:47 Save us, O LORD our God, And gather us from among the Gentiles, To give thanks to Your holy name, To triumph in Your praise.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 106:48: Psalms 106:48 Blessed be the LORD God of Israel From everlasting to everlasting! And let all the people say, "Amen!" Praise the LORD!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 107:1: Psalms 107:1 Oh, give thanks to the LORD, for He is good! For His mercy endures forever.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 107:2: Psalms 107:2 Let the redeemed of the LORD say so, Whom He has redeemed from the hand of the enemy,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 107:3: Psalms 107:3 And gathered out of the lands, From the east and from the west, From the north and from the south.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 107:4: Psalms 107:4 They wandered in the wilderness in a desolate way; They found no city to dwell in.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 107:5: Psalms 107:5 Hungry and thirsty, Their soul fainted in them.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 107:6: Psalms 107:6 Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, And He delivered them out of their distresses.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 107:7: Psalms 107:7 And He led them forth by the right way, That they might go to a city for a dwelling place.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 107:8: Psalms 107:8 Oh, that men would give thanks to the LORD for His goodness, And for His wonderful works to the children of men!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 107:9: Psalms 107:9 For He satisfies the longing soul, And fills the hungry soul with goodness.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 107:10: Psalms 107:10 Those who sat in darkness and in the shadow of death,  Bound in affliction and irons"”(NKJV)
verses.psalms 107:11: Psalms 107:11 Because they rebelled against the words of God, And despised the counsel of the Most High,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 107:12: Psalms 107:12 Therefore He brought down their heart with labor; They fell down, and there was none to help.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 107:13: Psalms 107:13 Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, And He saved them out of their distresses.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 107:14: Psalms 107:14 He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, And broke their chains in pieces.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 107:15: Psalms 107:15 Oh, that men would give thanks to the LORD for His goodness, And for His wonderful works to the children of men!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 107:16: Psalms 107:16 For He has broken the gates of bronze, And cut the bars of iron in two.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 107:17: Psalms 107:17 Fools, because of their transgression, And because of their iniquities, were afflicted.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 107:18: Psalms 107:18 Their soul abhorred all manner of food, And they drew near to the gates of death.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 107:19: Psalms 107:19 Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, And He saved them out of their distresses.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 107:20: Psalms 107:20 He sent His word and healed them, And delivered them from their destructions.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 107:21: Psalms 107:21 Oh, that men would give thanks to the LORD for His goodness, And for His wonderful works to the children of men!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 107:22: Psalms 107:22 Let them sacrifice the sacrifices of thanksgiving, And declare His works with rejoicing.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 107:23: Psalms 107:23 Those who go down to the sea in ships, Who do business on great waters,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 107:24: Psalms 107:24 They see the works of the LORD, And His wonders in the deep.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 107:25: Psalms 107:25 For He commands and raises the stormy wind, Which lifts up the waves of the sea.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 107:26: Psalms 107:26 They mount up to the heavens, They go down again to the depths;  Their soul melts because of trouble.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 107:27: Psalms 107:27 They reel to and fro, and stagger like a drunken man, And are at their wits' end.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 107:28: Psalms 107:28 Then they cry out to the LORD in their trouble, And He brings them out of their distresses.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 107:29: Psalms 107:29 He calms the storm, So that its waves are still.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 107:30: Psalms 107:30 Then they are glad because they are quiet; So He guides them to their desired haven.(NKJV)
