verses.psalms 107:31: Psalms 107:31 Oh, that men would give thanks to the LORD for His goodness, And for His wonderful works to the children of men!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 107:32: Psalms 107:32 Let them exalt Him also in the assembly of the people, And praise Him in the company of the elders.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 107:33: Psalms 107:33 He turns rivers into a wilderness, And the watersprings into dry ground;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 107:34: Psalms 107:34 A fruitful land into barrenness, For the wickedness of those who dwell in it.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 107:35: Psalms 107:35 He turns a wilderness into pools of water, And dry land into watersprings.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 107:36: Psalms 107:36 There He makes the hungry dwell, That they may establish a city for a dwelling place,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 107:37: Psalms 107:37 And sow fields and plant vineyards, That they may yield a fruitful harvest.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 107:38: Psalms 107:38 He also blesses them, and they multiply greatly; And He does not let their cattle decrease.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 107:39: Psalms 107:39 When they are diminished and brought low Through oppression, affliction, and sorrow,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 107:40: Psalms 107:40 He pours contempt on princes, And causes them to wander in the wilderness where there is no way;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 107:41: Psalms 107:41 Yet He sets the poor on high, far from affliction, And makes their families like a flock.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 107:42: Psalms 107:42 The righteous see it and rejoice, And all iniquity stops its mouth.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 107:43: Psalms 107:43 Whoever is wise will observe these things, And they will understand the lovingkindness of the LORD.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 108:1: Psalms 108:1 A Song. A Psalm of David.   O God, my heart is steadfast; I will sing and give praise, even with my glory.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 108:2: Psalms 108:2 Awake, lute and harp! I will awaken the dawn.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 108:3: Psalms 108:3 I will praise You, O LORD, among the peoples, And I will sing praises to You among the nations.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 108:4: Psalms 108:4 For Your mercy is great above the heavens, And Your truth reaches to the clouds.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 108:5: Psalms 108:5 Be exalted, O God, above the heavens, And Your glory above all the earth;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 108:6: Psalms 108:6 That Your beloved may be delivered, Save with Your right hand, and hear me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 108:7: Psalms 108:7 God has spoken in His holiness: "I will rejoice; I will divide Shechem And measure out the Valley of Succoth.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 108:8: Psalms 108:8 Gilead is Mine; Manasseh is Mine; Ephraim also is the helmet for My head;  Judah is My lawgiver.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 108:9: Psalms 108:9 Moab is My washpot; Over Edom I will cast My shoe; Over Philistia I will triumph."(NKJV)
verses.psalms 108:10: Psalms 108:10 Who will bring me into the strong city? Who will lead me to Edom?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 108:11: Psalms 108:11 Is it not You, O God, who cast us off? And You, O God, who did not go out with our armies?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 108:12: Psalms 108:12 Give us help from trouble, For the help of man is useless.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 108:13: Psalms 108:13 Through God we will do valiantly, For it is He who shall tread down our enemies.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 109:1: Psalms 109:1 To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David.   Do  not keep silent, O God of my praise!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 109:2: Psalms 109:2 For the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of the deceitful Have opened against me; They have spoken against me with a lying tongue.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 109:3: Psalms 109:3 They have also surrounded me with words of hatred, And fought against me without a cause.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 109:4: Psalms 109:4 In return for my love they are my accusers, But I give myself to prayer.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 109:5: Psalms 109:5 Thus they have rewarded me evil for good, And hatred for my love.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 109:6: Psalms 109:6 Set a wicked man over him, And let an accuser stand at his right hand.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 109:7: Psalms 109:7 When he is judged, let him be found guilty, And let his prayer become sin.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 109:8: Psalms 109:8 Let his days be few, And let another take his office.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 109:9: Psalms 109:9 Let his children be fatherless, And his wife a widow.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 109:10: Psalms 109:10 Let his children continually be vagabonds, and beg; Let them seek their bread also from their desolate places.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 109:11: Psalms 109:11 Let the creditor seize all that he has, And let strangers plunder his labor.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 109:12: Psalms 109:12 Let there be none to extend mercy to him, Nor let there be any to favor his fatherless children.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 109:13: Psalms 109:13 Let his posterity be cut off, And in the generation following let their name be blotted out.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 109:14: Psalms 109:14 Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered before the LORD, And let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 109:15: Psalms 109:15 Let them be continually before the LORD, That He may cut off the memory of them from the earth;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 109:16: Psalms 109:16 Because he did not remember to show mercy, But persecuted the poor and needy man, That he might even slay the broken in heart.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 109:17: Psalms 109:17 As he loved cursing, so let it come to him; As he did not delight in blessing, so let it be far from him.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 109:18: Psalms 109:18 As he clothed himself with cursing as with his garment, So let it enter his body like water, And like oil into his bones.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 109:19: Psalms 109:19 Let it be to him like the garment which covers him, And for a belt with which he girds himself continually.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 109:20: Psalms 109:20 Let this be the LORD's reward to my accusers, And to those who speak evil against my person.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 109:21: Psalms 109:21 But You, O GOD the Lord, Deal with me for Your name's sake; Because Your mercy is good, deliver me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 109:22: Psalms 109:22 For I am poor and needy, And my heart is wounded within me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 109:23: Psalms 109:23 I am gone like a shadow when it lengthens; I am shaken off like a locust.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 109:24: Psalms 109:24 My knees are weak through fasting, And my flesh is feeble from lack of fatness.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 109:25: Psalms 109:25 I also have become a reproach to them; When they look at me, they shake their heads.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 109:26: Psalms 109:26 Help me, O LORD my God! Oh, save me according to Your mercy,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 109:27: Psalms 109:27 That they may know that this is Your hand"” That You, LORD, have done it!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 109:28: Psalms 109:28 Let them curse, but You bless; When they arise, let them be ashamed, But let Your servant rejoice.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 109:29: Psalms 109:29 Let my accusers be clothed with shame, And let them cover themselves with their own disgrace as with a mantle.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 109:30: Psalms 109:30 I will greatly praise the LORD with my mouth; Yes, I will praise Him among the multitude.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 109:31: Psalms 109:31 For He shall stand at the right hand of the poor, To save him from those who condemn him.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 110:1: Psalms 110:1 A Psalm of David.   The LORD said to my Lord, "Sit at My right hand, Till I make Your enemies Your footstool."(NKJV)
verses.psalms 110:2: Psalms 110:2 The LORD shall send the rod of Your strength out of Zion.  Rule in the midst of Your enemies!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 110:3: Psalms 110:3 Your people shall be volunteers In the day of Your power;  In the beauties of holiness, from the womb of the morning, You have the dew of Your youth.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 110:4: Psalms 110:4 The LORD has sworn And will not relent, "You are a priest forever According to the order of Melchizedek."(NKJV)
verses.psalms 110:5: Psalms 110:5 The Lord is at Your right hand; He shall execute kings in the day of His wrath.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 110:6: Psalms 110:6 He shall judge among the nations, He shall fill the places with dead bodies,  He shall execute the heads of many countries.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 110:7: Psalms 110:7 He shall drink of the brook by the wayside;  Therefore He shall lift up the head.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 111:1: Psalms 111:1 Praise the LORD!  I will praise the LORD with my whole heart, In the assembly of the upright and in the congregation.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 111:2: Psalms 111:2 The works of the LORD are great,  Studied by all who have pleasure in them.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 111:3: Psalms 111:3 His work is honorable and glorious, And His righteousness endures forever.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 111:4: Psalms 111:4 He has made His wonderful works to be remembered;  The LORD is gracious and full of compassion.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 111:5: Psalms 111:5 He has given food to those who fear Him; He will ever be mindful of His covenant.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 111:6: Psalms 111:6 He has declared to His people the power of His works, In giving them the heritage of the nations.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 111:7: Psalms 111:7 The works of His hands are verity and justice; All His precepts are sure.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 111:8: Psalms 111:8 They stand fast forever and ever, And are done in truth and uprightness.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 111:9: Psalms 111:9 He has sent redemption to His people; He has commanded His covenant forever:  Holy and awesome is His name.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 111:10: Psalms 111:10 The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom; A good understanding have all those who do His commandments. His praise endures forever.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 112:1: Psalms 112:1 Praise the LORD! Blessed is the man who fears the LORD, Who delights greatly in His commandments.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 112:2: Psalms 112:2 His descendants will be mighty on earth; The generation of the upright will be blessed.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 112:3: Psalms 112:3 Wealth and riches will be in his house, And his righteousness endures forever.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 112:4: Psalms 112:4 Unto the upright there arises light in the darkness; He is gracious, and full of compassion, and righteous.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 112:5: Psalms 112:5 A good man deals graciously and lends; He will guide his affairs with discretion.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 112:6: Psalms 112:6 Surely he will never be shaken;  The righteous will be in everlasting remembrance.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 112:7: Psalms 112:7 He will not be afraid of evil tidings; His heart is steadfast, trusting in the LORD.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 112:8: Psalms 112:8 His heart is established;  He will not be afraid, Until he sees his desire upon his enemies.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 112:9: Psalms 112:9 He has dispersed abroad, He has given to the poor; His righteousness endures forever; His horn will be exalted with honor.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 112:10: Psalms 112:10 The wicked will see it and be grieved; He will gnash his teeth and melt away; The desire of the wicked shall perish.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 113:1: Psalms 113:1 Praise the LORD!  Praise, O servants of the LORD, Praise the name of the LORD!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 113:2: Psalms 113:2 Blessed be the name of the LORD From this time forth and forevermore!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 113:3: Psalms 113:3 From the rising of the sun to its going down The LORD's name is to be praised.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 113:4: Psalms 113:4 The LORD is high above all nations,  His glory above the heavens.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 113:5: Psalms 113:5 Who is like the LORD our God, Who dwells on high,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 113:6: Psalms 113:6 Who humbles Himself to behold The things that are in the heavens and in the earth?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 113:7: Psalms 113:7 He raises the poor out of the dust, And lifts the needy out of the ash heap,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 113:8: Psalms 113:8 That He may seat him with princes"” With the princes of His people.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 113:9: Psalms 113:9 He grants the barren woman a home, Like a joyful mother of children. Praise the LORD!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 114:1: Psalms 114:1 When Israel went out of Egypt, The house of Jacob from a people of strange language,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 114:2: Psalms 114:2 Judah became His sanctuary, And Israel His dominion.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 114:3: Psalms 114:3 The sea saw it and fled;  Jordan turned back.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 114:4: Psalms 114:4 The mountains skipped like rams, The little hills like lambs.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 114:5: Psalms 114:5 What ails you, O sea, that you fled? O Jordan, that you turned back?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 114:6: Psalms 114:6 O mountains, that you skipped like rams? O little hills, like lambs?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 114:7: Psalms 114:7 Tremble, O earth, at the presence of the Lord, At the presence of the God of Jacob,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 114:8: Psalms 114:8 Who turned the rock into a pool of water, The flint into a fountain of waters.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 115:1: Psalms 115:1 Not unto us, O LORD, not unto us, But to Your name give glory, Because of Your mercy, Because of Your truth.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 115:2: Psalms 115:2 Why should the Gentiles say,  "So where is their God?"(NKJV)
verses.psalms 115:3: Psalms 115:3 But our God is in heaven; He does whatever He pleases.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 115:4: Psalms 115:4 Their idols are silver and gold, The work of men's hands.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 115:5: Psalms 115:5 They have mouths, but they do not speak; Eyes they have, but they do not see;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 115:6: Psalms 115:6 They have ears, but they do not hear; Noses they have, but they do not smell;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 115:7: Psalms 115:7 They have hands, but they do not handle; Feet they have, but they do not walk; Nor do they mutter through their throat.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 115:8: Psalms 115:8 Those who make them are like them; So is everyone who trusts in them.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 115:9: Psalms 115:9 O Israel, trust in the LORD;  He is their help and their shield.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 115:10: Psalms 115:10 O house of Aaron, trust in the LORD; He is their help and their shield.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 115:11: Psalms 115:11 You who fear the LORD, trust in the LORD; He is their help and their shield.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 115:12: Psalms 115:12 The LORD has been mindful of us; He will bless us; He will bless the house of Israel; He will bless the house of Aaron.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 115:13: Psalms 115:13 He will bless those who fear the LORD, Both small and great.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 115:14: Psalms 115:14 May the LORD give you increase more and more, You and your children.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 115:15: Psalms 115:15 May you be blessed by the LORD,  Who made heaven and earth.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 115:16: Psalms 115:16 The heaven, even the heavens, are the LORD's; But the earth He has given to the children of men.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 115:17: Psalms 115:17 The dead do not praise the LORD, Nor any who go down into silence.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 115:18: Psalms 115:18 But we will bless the LORD From this time forth and forevermore. Praise the LORD!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 116:1: Psalms 116:1 I love the LORD, because He has heard My voice and my supplications.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 116:2: Psalms 116:2 Because He has inclined His ear to me, Therefore I will call upon Him as long as I live.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 116:3: Psalms 116:3 The pains of death surrounded me, And the pangs of Sheol laid hold of me; I found trouble and sorrow.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 116:4: Psalms 116:4 Then I called upon the name of the LORD: "O LORD, I implore You, deliver my soul!"(NKJV)
verses.psalms 116:5: Psalms 116:5 Gracious is the LORD, and righteous; Yes, our God is merciful.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 116:6: Psalms 116:6 The LORD preserves the simple; I was brought low, and He saved me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 116:7: Psalms 116:7 Return to your rest, O my soul, For the LORD has dealt bountifully with you.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 116:8: Psalms 116:8 For You have delivered my soul from death, My eyes from tears, And my feet from falling.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 116:9: Psalms 116:9 I will walk before the LORD  In the land of the living.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 116:10: Psalms 116:10 I believed, therefore I spoke, "I am greatly afflicted."(NKJV)
verses.psalms 116:11: Psalms 116:11 I said in my haste,  "All men are liars."(NKJV)
verses.psalms 116:12: Psalms 116:12 What shall I render to the LORD For all His benefits toward me?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 116:13: Psalms 116:13 I will take up the cup of salvation, And call upon the name of the LORD.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 116:14: Psalms 116:14 I will pay my vows to the LORD Now in the presence of all His people.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 116:15: Psalms 116:15 Precious in the sight of the LORD Is the death of His saints.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 116:16: Psalms 116:16 O LORD, truly I am Your servant; I am Your servant, the son of Your maidservant; You have loosed my bonds.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 116:17: Psalms 116:17 I will offer to You the sacrifice of thanksgiving, And will call upon the name of the LORD.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 116:18: Psalms 116:18 I will pay my vows to the LORD Now in the presence of all His people,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 116:19: Psalms 116:19 In the courts of the LORD's house, In the midst of you, O Jerusalem. Praise the LORD!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 117:1: Psalms 117:1 Praise the LORD, all you Gentiles! Laud Him, all you peoples!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 117:2: Psalms 117:2 For His merciful kindness is great toward us, And the truth of the LORD endures forever. Praise the LORD!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 118:1: Psalms 118:1 Oh, give thanks to the LORD, for He is good!  For His mercy endures forever.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 118:2: Psalms 118:2 Let Israel now say, "His mercy endures forever."(NKJV)
verses.psalms 118:3: Psalms 118:3 Let the house of Aaron now say, "His mercy endures forever."(NKJV)
verses.psalms 118:4: Psalms 118:4 Let those who fear the LORD now say, "His mercy endures forever."(NKJV)
verses.psalms 118:5: Psalms 118:5 I called on the LORD in distress; The LORD answered me and set me in a broad place.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 118:6: Psalms 118:6 The LORD is on my side; I will not fear. What can man do to me?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 118:7: Psalms 118:7 The LORD is for me among those who help me; Therefore I shall see my desire on those who hate me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 118:8: Psalms 118:8 It is better to trust in the LORD Than to put confidence in man.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 118:9: Psalms 118:9 It is better to trust in the LORD Than to put confidence in princes.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 118:10: Psalms 118:10 All nations surrounded me, But in the name of the LORD I will destroy them.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 118:11: Psalms 118:11 They surrounded me, Yes, they surrounded me; But in the name of the LORD I will destroy them.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 118:12: Psalms 118:12 They surrounded me like bees; They were quenched like a fire of thorns; For in the name of the LORD I will destroy them.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 118:13: Psalms 118:13 You pushed me violently, that I might fall, But the LORD helped me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 118:14: Psalms 118:14 The LORD is my strength and song, And He has become my salvation.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 118:15: Psalms 118:15 The voice of rejoicing and salvation Is in the tents of the righteous; The right hand of the LORD does valiantly.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 118:16: Psalms 118:16 The right hand of the LORD is exalted; The right hand of the LORD does valiantly.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 118:17: Psalms 118:17 I shall not die, but live, And declare the works of the LORD.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 118:18: Psalms 118:18 The LORD has chastened me severely, But He has not given me over to death.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 118:19: Psalms 118:19 Open to me the gates of righteousness; I will go through them, And I will praise the LORD.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 118:20: Psalms 118:20 This is the gate of the LORD,  Through which the righteous shall enter.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 118:21: Psalms 118:21 I will praise You, For You have answered me, And have become my salvation.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 118:22: Psalms 118:22 The stone which the builders rejected Has become the chief cornerstone.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 118:23: Psalms 118:23 This was the LORD's doing; It is marvelous in our eyes.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 118:24: Psalms 118:24 This is the day the LORD has made; We will rejoice and be glad in it.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 118:25: Psalms 118:25 Save now, I pray, O LORD; O LORD, I pray, send now prosperity.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 118:26: Psalms 118:26 Blessed is he who comes in the name of the LORD! We have blessed you from the house of the LORD.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 118:27: Psalms 118:27 God is the LORD, And He has given us light; Bind the sacrifice with cords to the horns of the altar.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 118:28: Psalms 118:28 You are my God, and I will praise You;  You are my God, I will exalt You.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 118:29: Psalms 118:29 Oh, give thanks to the LORD, for He is good! For His mercy endures forever.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:1: Psalms 119:1 Blessed are the undefiled in the way,  Who walk in the law of the LORD!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:2: Psalms 119:2 Blessed are those who keep His testimonies, Who seek Him with the whole heart!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:3: Psalms 119:3 They also do no iniquity; They walk in His ways.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:4: Psalms 119:4 You have commanded us To keep Your precepts diligently.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:5: Psalms 119:5 Oh, that my ways were directed To keep Your statutes!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:6: Psalms 119:6 Then I would not be ashamed, When I look into all Your commandments.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:7: Psalms 119:7 I will praise You with uprightness of heart, When I learn Your righteous judgments.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:8: Psalms 119:8 I will keep Your statutes; Oh, do not forsake me utterly!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:9: Psalms 119:9 How can a young man cleanse his way? By taking heed according to Your word.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:10: Psalms 119:10 With my whole heart I have sought You; Oh, let me not wander from Your commandments!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:11: Psalms 119:11 Your word I have hidden in my heart, That I might not sin against You.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:12: Psalms 119:12 Blessed are You, O LORD! Teach me Your statutes.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:13: Psalms 119:13 With my lips I have declared All the judgments of Your mouth.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:14: Psalms 119:14 I have rejoiced in the way of Your testimonies, As much as in all riches.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:15: Psalms 119:15 I will meditate on Your precepts, And contemplate Your ways.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:16: Psalms 119:16 I will delight myself in Your statutes; I will not forget Your word.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:17: Psalms 119:17 Deal bountifully with Your servant, That I may live and keep Your word.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:18: Psalms 119:18 Open my eyes, that I may see Wondrous things from Your law.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:19: Psalms 119:19 I am a stranger in the earth; Do not hide Your commandments from me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:20: Psalms 119:20 My soul breaks with longing For Your judgments at all times.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:21: Psalms 119:21 You rebuke the proud"”the cursed, Who stray from Your commandments.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:22: Psalms 119:22 Remove from me reproach and contempt, For I have kept Your testimonies.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:23: Psalms 119:23 Princes also sit and speak against me, But Your servant meditates on Your statutes.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:24: Psalms 119:24 Your testimonies also are my delight And my counselors.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:25: Psalms 119:25 My soul clings to the dust;  Revive me according to Your word.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:26: Psalms 119:26 I have declared my ways, and You answered me;  Teach me Your statutes.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:27: Psalms 119:27 Make me understand the way of Your precepts; So shall I meditate on Your wonderful works.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:28: Psalms 119:28 My soul melts from heaviness; Strengthen me according to Your word.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:29: Psalms 119:29 Remove from me the way of lying, And grant me Your law graciously.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:30: Psalms 119:30 I have chosen the way of truth; Your judgments I have laid before me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:31: Psalms 119:31 I cling to Your testimonies; O LORD, do not put me to shame!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:32: Psalms 119:32 I will run the course of Your commandments, For You shall enlarge my heart.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:33: Psalms 119:33 Teach me, O LORD, the way of Your statutes, And I shall keep it to the end.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:34: Psalms 119:34 Give me understanding, and I shall keep Your law; Indeed, I shall observe it with my whole heart.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:35: Psalms 119:35 Make me walk in the path of Your commandments, For I delight in it.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:36: Psalms 119:36 Incline my heart to Your testimonies, And not to covetousness.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:37: Psalms 119:37 Turn away my eyes from looking at worthless things, And revive me in Your way.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:38: Psalms 119:38 Establish Your word to Your servant, Who is devoted to fearing You.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:39: Psalms 119:39 Turn away my reproach which I dread, For Your judgments are good.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:40: Psalms 119:40 Behold, I long for Your precepts; Revive me in Your righteousness.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:41: Psalms 119:41 Let Your mercies come also to me, O LORD"” Your salvation according to Your word.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:42: Psalms 119:42 So shall I have an answer for him who reproaches me, For I trust in Your word.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:43: Psalms 119:43 And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth, For I have hoped in Your ordinances.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:44: Psalms 119:44 So shall I keep Your law continually, Forever and ever.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:45: Psalms 119:45 And I will walk at liberty, For I seek Your precepts.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:46: Psalms 119:46 I will speak of Your testimonies also before kings, And will not be ashamed.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:47: Psalms 119:47 And I will delight myself in Your commandments, Which I love.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:48: Psalms 119:48 My hands also I will lift up to Your commandments, Which I love, And I will meditate on Your statutes.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:49: Psalms 119:49 Remember the word to Your servant, Upon which You have caused me to hope.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:50: Psalms 119:50 This is my comfort in my affliction, For Your word has given me life.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:51: Psalms 119:51 The proud have me in great derision, Yet I do not turn aside from Your law.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:52: Psalms 119:52 I remembered Your judgments of old, O LORD, And have comforted myself.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:53: Psalms 119:53 Indignation has taken hold of me Because of the wicked, who forsake Your law.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:54: Psalms 119:54 Your statutes have been my songs In the house of my pilgrimage.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:55: Psalms 119:55 I remember Your name in the night, O LORD, And I keep Your law.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:56: Psalms 119:56 This has become mine, Because I kept Your precepts.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:57: Psalms 119:57 You are my portion, O LORD; I have said that I would keep Your words.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:58: Psalms 119:58 I entreated Your favor with my whole heart; Be merciful to me according to Your word.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:59: Psalms 119:59 I thought about my ways, And turned my feet to Your testimonies.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:60: Psalms 119:60 I made haste, and did not delay To keep Your commandments.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:61: Psalms 119:61 The cords of the wicked have bound me, But I have not forgotten Your law.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:62: Psalms 119:62 At midnight I will rise to give thanks to You, Because of Your righteous judgments.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:63: Psalms 119:63 I am a companion of all who fear You, And of those who keep Your precepts.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:64: Psalms 119:64 The earth, O LORD, is full of Your mercy; Teach me Your statutes.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:65: Psalms 119:65 You have dealt well with Your servant, O LORD, according to Your word.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:66: Psalms 119:66 Teach me good judgment and knowledge, For I believe Your commandments.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:67: Psalms 119:67 Before I was afflicted I went astray, But now I keep Your word.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:68: Psalms 119:68 You are good, and do good; Teach me Your statutes.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:69: Psalms 119:69 The proud have forged a lie against me, But I will keep Your precepts with my whole heart.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:70: Psalms 119:70 Their heart is as fat as grease, But I delight in Your law.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:71: Psalms 119:71 It is good for me that I have been afflicted, That I may learn Your statutes.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:72: Psalms 119:72 The law of Your mouth is better to me Than thousands of coins of gold and silver.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:73: Psalms 119:73 Your hands have made me and fashioned me; Give me understanding, that I may learn Your commandments.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:74: Psalms 119:74 Those who fear You will be glad when they see me, Because I have hoped in Your word.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:75: Psalms 119:75 I know, O LORD, that Your judgments are right, And that in faithfulness You have afflicted me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:76: Psalms 119:76 Let, I pray, Your merciful kindness be for my comfort, According to Your word to Your servant.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:77: Psalms 119:77 Let Your tender mercies come to me, that I may live; For Your law is my delight.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:78: Psalms 119:78 Let the proud be ashamed, For they treated me wrongfully with falsehood; But I will meditate on Your precepts.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:79: Psalms 119:79 Let those who fear You turn to me, Those who know Your testimonies.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:80: Psalms 119:80 Let my heart be blameless regarding Your statutes, That I may not be ashamed.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:81: Psalms 119:81 My soul faints for Your salvation, But I hope in Your word.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:82: Psalms 119:82 My eyes fail from searching Your word, Saying, "When will You comfort me?"(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:83: Psalms 119:83 For I have become like a wineskin in smoke, Yet I do not forget Your statutes.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:84: Psalms 119:84 How many are the days of Your servant?  When will You execute judgment on those who persecute me?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:85: Psalms 119:85 The proud have dug pits for me, Which is not according to Your law.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:86: Psalms 119:86 All Your commandments are faithful; They persecute me wrongfully; Help me!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:87: Psalms 119:87 They almost made an end of me on earth, But I did not forsake Your precepts.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:88: Psalms 119:88 Revive me according to Your lovingkindness, So that I may keep the testimony of Your mouth.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:89: Psalms 119:89 Forever, O LORD, Your word is settled in heaven.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:90: Psalms 119:90 Your faithfulness endures to all generations; You established the earth, and it abides.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:91: Psalms 119:91 They continue this day according to Your ordinances, For all are Your servants.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:92: Psalms 119:92 Unless Your law had been my delight, I would then have perished in my affliction.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:93: Psalms 119:93 I will never forget Your precepts, For by them You have given me life.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:94: Psalms 119:94 I am Yours, save me; For I have sought Your precepts.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:95: Psalms 119:95 The wicked wait for me to destroy me, But I will consider Your testimonies.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:96: Psalms 119:96 I have seen the consummation of all perfection, But Your commandment is exceedingly broad.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:97: Psalms 119:97 Oh, how I love Your law!  It is my meditation all the day.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:98: Psalms 119:98 You, through Your commandments, make me wiser than my enemies; For they are ever with me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:99: Psalms 119:99 I have more understanding than all my teachers,  For Your testimonies are my meditation.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:100: Psalms 119:100 I understand more than the ancients, Because I keep Your precepts.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:101: Psalms 119:101 I have restrained my feet from every evil way, That I may keep Your word.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:102: Psalms 119:102 I have not departed from Your judgments, For You Yourself have taught me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:103: Psalms 119:103 How sweet are Your words to my taste, Sweeter than honey to my mouth!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:104: Psalms 119:104 Through Your precepts I get understanding; Therefore I hate every false way.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:105: Psalms 119:105 Your word is a lamp to my feet And a light to my path.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:106: Psalms 119:106 I have sworn and confirmed That I will keep Your righteous judgments.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:107: Psalms 119:107 I am afflicted very much; Revive me, O LORD, according to Your word.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:108: Psalms 119:108 Accept, I pray, the freewill offerings of my mouth, O LORD, And teach me Your judgments.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:109: Psalms 119:109 My life is continually in my hand, Yet I do not forget Your law.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:110: Psalms 119:110 The wicked have laid a snare for me, Yet I have not strayed from Your precepts.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:111: Psalms 119:111 Your testimonies I have taken as a heritage forever, For they are the rejoicing of my heart.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:112: Psalms 119:112 I have inclined my heart to perform Your statutes Forever, to the very end.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:113: Psalms 119:113 I hate the double-minded, But I love Your law.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:114: Psalms 119:114 You are my hiding place and my shield; I hope in Your word.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:115: Psalms 119:115 Depart from me, you evildoers, For I will keep the commandments of my God!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:116: Psalms 119:116 Uphold me according to Your word, that I may live; And do not let me be ashamed of my hope.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:117: Psalms 119:117 Hold me up, and I shall be safe, And I shall observe Your statutes continually.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:118: Psalms 119:118 You reject all those who stray from Your statutes, For their deceit is falsehood.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:119: Psalms 119:119 You put away all the wicked of the earth like dross; Therefore I love Your testimonies.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:120: Psalms 119:120 My flesh trembles for fear of You, And I am afraid of Your judgments.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:121: Psalms 119:121 I have done justice and righteousness; Do not leave me to my oppressors.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:122: Psalms 119:122 Be surety for Your servant for good; Do not let the proud oppress me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:123: Psalms 119:123 My eyes fail from seeking Your salvation And Your righteous word.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:124: Psalms 119:124 Deal with Your servant according to Your mercy, And teach me Your statutes.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:125: Psalms 119:125 I am Your servant; Give me understanding, That I may know Your testimonies.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:126: Psalms 119:126 It is time for You to act, O LORD, For they have regarded Your law as void.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:127: Psalms 119:127 Therefore I love Your commandments More than gold, yes, than fine gold!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:128: Psalms 119:128 Therefore all Your precepts concerning all things I consider to be right; I hate every false way.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:129: Psalms 119:129 Your testimonies are wonderful; Therefore my soul keeps them.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:130: Psalms 119:130 The entrance of Your words gives light;  It gives understanding to the simple.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:131: Psalms 119:131 I opened my mouth and panted, For I longed for Your commandments.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:132: Psalms 119:132 Look upon me and be merciful to me, As Your custom is toward those who love Your name.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:133: Psalms 119:133 Direct my steps by Your word, And let no iniquity have dominion over me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:134: Psalms 119:134 Redeem me from the oppression of man, That I may keep Your precepts.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:135: Psalms 119:135 Make Your face shine upon Your servant, And teach me Your statutes.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:136: Psalms 119:136 Rivers of water run down from my eyes, Because men do not keep Your law.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:137: Psalms 119:137 Righteous are You, O LORD, And upright are Your judgments.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:138: Psalms 119:138 Your testimonies, which You have commanded, Are righteous and very faithful.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:139: Psalms 119:139 My zeal has consumed me, Because my enemies have forgotten Your words.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:140: Psalms 119:140 Your word is very pure; Therefore Your servant loves it.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:141: Psalms 119:141 I am small and despised, Yet I do not forget Your precepts.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:142: Psalms 119:142 Your righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, And Your law is truth.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:143: Psalms 119:143 Trouble and anguish have overtaken me, Yet Your commandments are my delights.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:144: Psalms 119:144 The righteousness of Your testimonies is everlasting; Give me understanding, and I shall live.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:145: Psalms 119:145 I cry out with my whole heart; Hear me, O LORD! I will keep Your statutes.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:146: Psalms 119:146 I cry out to You; Save me, and I will keep Your testimonies.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:147: Psalms 119:147 I rise before the dawning of the morning, And cry for help; I hope in Your word.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:148: Psalms 119:148 My eyes are awake through the night watches, That I may meditate on Your word.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:149: Psalms 119:149 Hear my voice according to Your lovingkindness; O LORD, revive me according to Your justice.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:150: Psalms 119:150 They draw near who follow after wickedness; They are far from Your law.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:151: Psalms 119:151 You are near, O LORD, And all Your commandments are truth.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:152: Psalms 119:152 Concerning Your testimonies, I have known of old that You have founded them forever.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:153: Psalms 119:153 Consider my affliction and deliver me, For I do not forget Your law.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:154: Psalms 119:154 Plead my cause and redeem me; Revive me according to Your word.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:155: Psalms 119:155 Salvation is far from the wicked, For they do not seek Your statutes.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:156: Psalms 119:156 Great are Your tender mercies, O LORD; Revive me according to Your judgments.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:157: Psalms 119:157 Many are my persecutors and my enemies, Yet I do not turn from Your testimonies.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:158: Psalms 119:158 I see the treacherous, and am disgusted, Because they do not keep Your word.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:159: Psalms 119:159 Consider how I love Your precepts; Revive me, O LORD, according to Your lovingkindness.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:160: Psalms 119:160 The entirety of Your word is truth, And every one of Your righteous judgments endures forever.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:161: Psalms 119:161 Princes persecute me without a cause, But my heart stands in awe of Your word.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:162: Psalms 119:162 I rejoice at Your word As one who finds great treasure.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:163: Psalms 119:163 I hate and abhor lying, But I love Your law.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:164: Psalms 119:164 Seven times a day I praise You, Because of Your righteous judgments.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:165: Psalms 119:165 Great peace have those who love Your law, And nothing causes them to stumble.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:166: Psalms 119:166 LORD, I hope for Your salvation, And I do Your commandments.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:167: Psalms 119:167 My soul keeps Your testimonies, And I love them exceedingly.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:168: Psalms 119:168 I keep Your precepts and Your testimonies,  For all my ways are before You.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:169: Psalms 119:169 Let my cry come before You, O LORD;  Give me understanding according to Your word.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:170: Psalms 119:170 Let my supplication come before You; Deliver me according to Your word.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:171: Psalms 119:171 My lips shall utter praise, For You teach me Your statutes.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:172: Psalms 119:172 My tongue shall speak of Your word, For all Your commandments are righteousness.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:173: Psalms 119:173 Let Your hand become my help, For I have chosen Your precepts.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:174: Psalms 119:174 I long for Your salvation, O LORD, And Your law is my delight.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:175: Psalms 119:175 Let my soul live, and it shall praise You; And let Your judgments help me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 119:176: Psalms 119:176 I have gone astray like a lost sheep; Seek Your servant, For I do not forget Your commandments.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 120:1: Psalms 120:1 A Song of Ascents.   In my distress I cried to the LORD, And He heard me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 120:2: Psalms 120:2 Deliver my soul, O LORD, from lying lips And from a deceitful tongue.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 120:3: Psalms 120:3 What shall be given to you, Or what shall be done to you, You false tongue?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 120:4: Psalms 120:4 Sharp arrows of the warrior, With coals of the broom tree!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 120:5: Psalms 120:5 Woe is me, that I dwell in Meshech,  That I dwell among the tents of Kedar!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 120:6: Psalms 120:6 My soul has dwelt too long With one who hates peace.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 120:7: Psalms 120:7 I am for peace; But when I speak, they are for war.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 121:1: Psalms 121:1 A Song of Ascents.   I will lift up my eyes to the hills"” From whence comes my help?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 121:2: Psalms 121:2 My help comes from the LORD, Who made heaven and earth.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 121:3: Psalms 121:3 He will not allow your foot to be moved;  He who keeps you will not slumber.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 121:4: Psalms 121:4 Behold, He who keeps Israel Shall neither slumber nor sleep.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 121:5: Psalms 121:5 The LORD is your keeper; The LORD is your shade at your right hand.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 121:6: Psalms 121:6 The sun shall not strike you by day, Nor the moon by night.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 121:7: Psalms 121:7 The LORD shall preserve you from all evil; He shall preserve your soul.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 121:8: Psalms 121:8 The LORD shall preserve your going out and your coming in From this time forth, and even forevermore.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 122:1: Psalms 122:1 A Song of Ascents. Of David.   I was glad when they said to me,  "Let us go into the house of the LORD."(NKJV)
verses.psalms 122:2: Psalms 122:2 Our feet have been standing Within your gates, O Jerusalem!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 122:3: Psalms 122:3 Jerusalem is built As a city that is compact together,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 122:4: Psalms 122:4 Where the tribes go up, The tribes of the LORD, To the Testimony of Israel, To give thanks to the name of the LORD.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 122:5: Psalms 122:5 For thrones are set there for judgment, The thrones of the house of David.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 122:6: Psalms 122:6 Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: "May they prosper who love you.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 122:7: Psalms 122:7 Peace be within your walls, Prosperity within your palaces."(NKJV)
verses.psalms 122:8: Psalms 122:8 For the sake of my brethren and companions, I will now say, "Peace be within you."(NKJV)
verses.psalms 122:9: Psalms 122:9 Because of the house of the LORD our God I will seek your good.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 123:1: Psalms 123:1 A Song of Ascents.   Unto You I lift up my eyes, O You who dwell in the heavens.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 123:2: Psalms 123:2 Behold, as the eyes of servants look to the hand of their masters, As the eyes of a maid to the hand of her mistress,  So our eyes look to the LORD our God, Until He has mercy on us.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 123:3: Psalms 123:3 Have mercy on us, O LORD, have mercy on us! For we are exceedingly filled with contempt.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 123:4: Psalms 123:4 Our soul is exceedingly filled With the scorn of those who are at ease, With the contempt of the proud.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 124:1: Psalms 124:1 A Song of Ascents. Of David.   "If it had not been the LORD who was on our side,"  Let Israel now say"”(NKJV)
verses.psalms 124:2: Psalms 124:2 "If it had not been the LORD who was on our side, When men rose up against us,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 124:3: Psalms 124:3 Then they would have swallowed us alive, When their wrath was kindled against us;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 124:4: Psalms 124:4 Then the waters would have overwhelmed us, The stream would have gone over our soul;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 124:5: Psalms 124:5 Then the swollen waters Would have gone over our soul."(NKJV)
verses.psalms 124:6: Psalms 124:6 Blessed be the LORD, Who has not given us as prey to their teeth.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 124:7: Psalms 124:7 Our soul has escaped as a bird from the snare of the fowlers; The snare is broken, and we have escaped.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 124:8: Psalms 124:8 Our help is in the name of the LORD,  Who made heaven and earth.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 125:1: Psalms 125:1 A Song of Ascents.   Those who trust in the LORD Are like Mount Zion, Which cannot be moved, but abides forever.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 125:2: Psalms 125:2 As the mountains surround Jerusalem, So the LORD surrounds His people From this time forth and forever.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 125:3: Psalms 125:3 For the scepter of wickedness shall not rest On the land allotted to the righteous, Lest the righteous reach out their hands to iniquity.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 125:4: Psalms 125:4 Do good, O LORD, to those who are good, And to those who are upright in their hearts.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 125:5: Psalms 125:5 As for such as turn aside to their crooked ways, The LORD shall lead them away With the workers of iniquity.  Peace be upon Israel!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 126:1: Psalms 126:1 A Song of Ascents.   When the LORD brought back the captivity of Zion,  We were like those who dream.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 126:2: Psalms 126:2 Then our mouth was filled with laughter, And our tongue with singing. Then they said among the nations, "The LORD has done great things for them."(NKJV)
verses.psalms 126:3: Psalms 126:3 The LORD has done great things for us, And we are glad.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 126:4: Psalms 126:4 Bring back our captivity, O LORD, As the streams in the South.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 126:5: Psalms 126:5 Those who sow in tears Shall reap in joy.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 126:6: Psalms 126:6 He who continually goes forth weeping, Bearing seed for sowing, Shall doubtless come again with rejoicing, Bringing his sheaves with him.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 127:1: Psalms 127:1 A Song of Ascents. Of Solomon.   Unless the LORD builds the house, They labor in vain who build it; Unless the LORD guards the city, The watchman stays awake in vain.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 127:2: Psalms 127:2 It is vain for you to rise up early, To sit up late, To eat the bread of sorrows; For so He gives His beloved sleep.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 127:3: Psalms 127:3 Behold, children are a heritage from the LORD,  The fruit of the womb is a reward.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 127:4: Psalms 127:4 Like arrows in the hand of a warrior, So are the children of one's youth.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 127:5: Psalms 127:5 Happy is the man who has his quiver full of them;  They shall not be ashamed, But shall speak with their enemies in the gate.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 128:1: Psalms 128:1 A Song of Ascents.   Blessed is every one who fears the LORD, Who walks in His ways.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 128:2: Psalms 128:2 When you eat the labor of your hands, You shall be happy, and it shall be well with you.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 128:3: Psalms 128:3 Your wife shall be like a fruitful vine In the very heart of your house, Your children like olive plants All around your table.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 128:4: Psalms 128:4 Behold, thus shall the man be blessed Who fears the LORD.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 128:5: Psalms 128:5 The LORD bless you out of Zion, And may you see the good of Jerusalem All the days of your life.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 128:6: Psalms 128:6 Yes, may you see your children's children.  Peace be upon Israel!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 129:1: Psalms 129:1 Song of Ascents.   "Many a time they have afflicted me from my youth,"  Let Israel now say"”(NKJV)
verses.psalms 129:2: Psalms 129:2 "Many a time they have afflicted me from my youth; Yet they have not prevailed against me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 129:3: Psalms 129:3 The plowers plowed on my back; They made their furrows long."(NKJV)
verses.psalms 129:4: Psalms 129:4 The LORD is righteous; He has cut in pieces the cords of the wicked.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 129:5: Psalms 129:5 Let all those who hate Zion Be put to shame and turned back.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 129:6: Psalms 129:6 Let them be as the grass on the housetops, Which withers before it grows up,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 129:7: Psalms 129:7 With which the reaper does not fill his hand, Nor he who binds sheaves, his arms.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 129:8: Psalms 129:8 Neither let those who pass by them say,  "The blessing of the LORD be upon you; We bless you in the name of the LORD!"(NKJV)
verses.psalms 130:1: Psalms 130:1 A Song of Ascents.   Out of the depths I have cried to You, O LORD;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 130:2: Psalms 130:2 Lord, hear my voice! Let Your ears be attentive To the voice of my supplications.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 130:3: Psalms 130:3 If You, LORD, should mark iniquities, O Lord, who could stand?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 130:4: Psalms 130:4 But there is forgiveness with You, That You may be feared.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 130:5: Psalms 130:5 I wait for the LORD, my soul waits, And in His word I do hope.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 130:6: Psalms 130:6 My soul waits for the Lord More than those who watch for the morning"” Yes, more than those who watch for the morning.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 130:7: Psalms 130:7 O Israel, hope in the LORD; For with the LORD there is mercy, And with Him is abundant redemption.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 130:8: Psalms 130:8 And He shall redeem Israel From all his iniquities.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 131:1: Psalms 131:1 A Song of Ascents. Of David.   LORD, my heart is not haughty, Nor my eyes lofty.  Neither do I concern myself with great matters, Nor with things too profound for me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 131:2: Psalms 131:2 Surely I have calmed and quieted my soul,  Like a weaned child with his mother; Like a weaned child is my soul within me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 131:3: Psalms 131:3 O Israel, hope in the LORD From this time forth and forever.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 132:1: Psalms 132:1 A Song of Ascents.   LORD, remember David And all his afflictions;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 132:2: Psalms 132:2 How he swore to the LORD,  And vowed to the Mighty One of Jacob:(NKJV)
verses.psalms 132:3: Psalms 132:3 "Surely I will not go into the chamber of my house, Or go up to the comfort of my bed;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 132:4: Psalms 132:4 I will not give sleep to my eyes Or slumber to my eyelids,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 132:5: Psalms 132:5 Until I find a place for the LORD, A dwelling place for the Mighty One of Jacob."(NKJV)
verses.psalms 132:6: Psalms 132:6 Behold, we heard of it in Ephrathah;  We found it in the fields of the woods.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 132:7: Psalms 132:7 Let us go into His tabernacle;  Let us worship at His footstool.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 132:8: Psalms 132:8 Arise, O LORD, to Your resting place, You and the ark of Your strength.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 132:9: Psalms 132:9 Let Your priests be clothed with righteousness, And let Your saints shout for joy.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 132:10: Psalms 132:10 For Your servant David's sake, Do not turn away the face of Your Anointed.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 132:11: Psalms 132:11 The LORD has sworn in truth to David; He will not turn from it: "I will set upon your throne the fruit of your body.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 132:12: Psalms 132:12 If your sons will keep My covenant And My testimony which I shall teach them, Their sons also shall sit upon your throne forevermore."(NKJV)
verses.psalms 132:13: Psalms 132:13 For the LORD has chosen Zion; He has desired it for His dwelling place:(NKJV)
verses.psalms 132:14: Psalms 132:14 "This  is My resting place forever; Here I will dwell, for I have desired it.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 132:15: Psalms 132:15 I will abundantly bless her provision; I will satisfy her poor with bread.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 132:16: Psalms 132:16 I will also clothe her priests with salvation,  And her saints shall shout aloud for joy.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 132:17: Psalms 132:17 There I will make the horn of David grow;  I will prepare a lamp for My Anointed.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 132:18: Psalms 132:18 His enemies I will clothe with shame, But upon Himself His crown shall flourish."(NKJV)
verses.psalms 133:1: Psalms 133:1 A Song of Ascents. Of David.   Behold, how good and how pleasant it is For brethren to dwell together in unity!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 133:2: Psalms 133:2 It is like the precious oil upon the head, Running down on the beard, The beard of Aaron, Running down on the edge of his garments.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 133:3: Psalms 133:3 It is like the dew of Hermon, Descending upon the mountains of Zion; For there the LORD commanded the blessing"” Life forevermore.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 134:1: Psalms 134:1 A Song of Ascents.   Behold, bless the LORD, All you servants of the LORD, Who by night stand in the house of the LORD!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 134:2: Psalms 134:2 Lift up your hands in the sanctuary, And bless the LORD.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 134:3: Psalms 134:3 The LORD who made heaven and earth Bless you from Zion!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 135:1: Psalms 135:1 Praise the LORD! Praise the name of the LORD;  Praise Him, O you servants of the LORD!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 135:2: Psalms 135:2 You who stand in the house of the LORD, In the courts of the house of our God,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 135:3: Psalms 135:3 Praise the LORD, for the LORD is good; Sing praises to His name, for it is pleasant.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 135:4: Psalms 135:4 For the LORD has chosen Jacob for Himself, Israel for His special treasure.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 135:5: Psalms 135:5 For I know that the LORD is great, And our Lord is above all gods.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 135:6: Psalms 135:6 Whatever the LORD pleases He does, In heaven and in earth, In the seas and in all deep places.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 135:7: Psalms 135:7 He causes the vapors to ascend from the ends of the earth;  He makes lightning for the rain; He brings the wind out of His treasuries.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 135:8: Psalms 135:8 He destroyed the firstborn of Egypt, Both of man and beast.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 135:9: Psalms 135:9 He sent signs and wonders into the midst of you, O Egypt,  Upon Pharaoh and all his servants.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 135:10: Psalms 135:10 He defeated many nations And slew mighty kings"”(NKJV)
verses.psalms 135:11: Psalms 135:11 Sihon king of the Amorites, Og king of Bashan, And all the kingdoms of Canaan"”(NKJV)
verses.psalms 135:12: Psalms 135:12 And gave their land as a heritage, A heritage to Israel His people.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 135:13: Psalms 135:13 Your name, O LORD, endures forever, Your fame, O LORD, throughout all generations.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 135:14: Psalms 135:14 For the LORD will judge His people, And He will have compassion on His servants.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 135:15: Psalms 135:15 The idols of the nations are silver and gold, The work of men's hands.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 135:16: Psalms 135:16 They have mouths, but they do not speak; Eyes they have, but they do not see;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 135:17: Psalms 135:17 They have ears, but they do not hear; Nor is there any breath in their mouths.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 135:18: Psalms 135:18 Those who make them are like them; So is everyone who trusts in them.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 135:19: Psalms 135:19 Bless the LORD, O house of Israel! Bless the LORD, O house of Aaron!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 135:20: Psalms 135:20 Bless the LORD, O house of Levi! You who fear the LORD, bless the LORD!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 135:21: Psalms 135:21 Blessed be the LORD out of Zion, Who dwells in Jerusalem! Praise the LORD!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 136:1: Psalms 136:1 Oh, give thanks to the LORD, for He is good!  For His mercy endures forever.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 136:2: Psalms 136:2 Oh, give thanks to the God of gods! For His mercy endures forever.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 136:3: Psalms 136:3 Oh, give thanks to the Lord of lords! For His mercy endures forever:(NKJV)
verses.psalms 136:4: Psalms 136:4 To Him who alone does great wonders, For His mercy endures forever;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 136:5: Psalms 136:5 To Him who by wisdom made the heavens, For His mercy endures forever;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 136:6: Psalms 136:6 To Him who laid out the earth above the waters, For His mercy endures forever;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 136:7: Psalms 136:7 To Him who made great lights, For His mercy endures forever"”(NKJV)
verses.psalms 136:8: Psalms 136:8 The sun to rule by day, For His mercy endures forever;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 136:9: Psalms 136:9 The moon and stars to rule by night, For His mercy endures forever.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 136:10: Psalms 136:10 To Him who struck Egypt in their firstborn, For His mercy endures forever;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 136:11: Psalms 136:11 And brought out Israel from among them, For His mercy endures forever;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 136:12: Psalms 136:12 With a strong hand, and with an outstretched arm, For His mercy endures forever;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 136:13: Psalms 136:13 To Him who divided the Red Sea in two, For His mercy endures forever;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 136:14: Psalms 136:14 And made Israel pass through the midst of it, For His mercy endures forever;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 136:15: Psalms 136:15 But overthrew Pharaoh and his army in the Red Sea, For His mercy endures forever;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 136:16: Psalms 136:16 To Him who led His people through the wilderness, For His mercy endures forever;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 136:17: Psalms 136:17 To Him who struck down great kings, For His mercy endures forever;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 136:18: Psalms 136:18 And slew famous kings, For His mercy endures forever"”(NKJV)
verses.psalms 136:19: Psalms 136:19 Sihon king of the Amorites, For His mercy endures forever;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 136:20: Psalms 136:20 And Og king of Bashan, For His mercy endures forever"”(NKJV)
verses.psalms 136:21: Psalms 136:21 And gave their land as a heritage, For His mercy endures forever;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 136:22: Psalms 136:22 A heritage to Israel His servant, For His mercy endures forever.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 136:23: Psalms 136:23 Who remembered us in our lowly state, For His mercy endures forever;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 136:24: Psalms 136:24 And rescued us from our enemies, For His mercy endures forever;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 136:25: Psalms 136:25 Who gives food to all flesh, For His mercy endures forever.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 136:26: Psalms 136:26 Oh, give thanks to the God of heaven! For His mercy endures forever.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 137:1: Psalms 137:1 By the rivers of Babylon, There we sat down, yea, we wept When we remembered Zion.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 137:2: Psalms 137:2 We hung our harps Upon the willows in the midst of it.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 137:3: Psalms 137:3 For there those who carried us away captive asked of us a song, And those who plundered us requested mirth, Saying, "Sing us one of the songs of Zion!"(NKJV)
verses.psalms 137:4: Psalms 137:4 How shall we sing the LORD's song In a foreign land?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 137:5: Psalms 137:5 If I forget you, O Jerusalem, Let my right hand forget its skill!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 137:6: Psalms 137:6 If I do not remember you, Let my tongue cling to the roof of my mouth"” If I do not exalt Jerusalem Above my chief joy.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 137:7: Psalms 137:7 Remember, O LORD, against the sons of Edom The day of Jerusalem, Who said, "Raze it, raze it, To its very foundation!"(NKJV)
verses.psalms 137:8: Psalms 137:8 O daughter of Babylon, who are to be destroyed, Happy the one who repays you as you have served us!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 137:9: Psalms 137:9 Happy the one who takes and dashes Your little ones against the rock!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 138:1: Psalms 138:1 A Psalm of David.   I will praise You with my whole heart;  Before the gods I will sing praises to You.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 138:2: Psalms 138:2 I will worship toward Your holy temple, And praise Your name For Your lovingkindness and Your truth; For You have magnified Your word above all Your name.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 138:3: Psalms 138:3 In the day when I cried out, You answered me, And made me bold with strength in my soul.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 138:4: Psalms 138:4 All the kings of the earth shall praise You, O LORD, When they hear the words of Your mouth.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 138:5: Psalms 138:5 Yes, they shall sing of the ways of the LORD, For great is the glory of the LORD.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 138:6: Psalms 138:6 Though the LORD is on high, Yet He regards the lowly; But the proud He knows from afar.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 138:7: Psalms 138:7 Though I walk in the midst of trouble, You will revive me; You will stretch out Your hand Against the wrath of my enemies, And Your right hand will save me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 138:8: Psalms 138:8 The LORD will perfect that which concerns me; Your mercy, O LORD, endures forever;  Do not forsake the works of Your hands.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 139:1: Psalms 139:1 For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David.   O LORD, You have searched me and known me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 139:2: Psalms 139:2 You know my sitting down and my rising up; You understand my thought afar off.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 139:3: Psalms 139:3 You comprehend my path and my lying down, And are acquainted with all my ways.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 139:4: Psalms 139:4 For there is not a word on my tongue, But behold, O LORD, You know it altogether.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 139:5: Psalms 139:5 You have hedged me behind and before, And laid Your hand upon me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 139:6: Psalms 139:6 Such knowledge is too wonderful for me; It is high, I cannot attain it.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 139:7: Psalms 139:7 Where can I go from Your Spirit? Or where can I flee from Your presence?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 139:8: Psalms 139:8 If I ascend into heaven, You are there;  If I make my bed in hell, behold, You are there.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 139:9: Psalms 139:9 If I take the wings of the morning, And dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 139:10: Psalms 139:10 Even there Your hand shall lead me, And Your right hand shall hold me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 139:11: Psalms 139:11 If I say, "Surely the darkness shall fall on me," Even the night shall be light about me;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 139:12: Psalms 139:12 Indeed, the darkness shall not hide from You, But the night shines as the day; The darkness and the light are both alike to You.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 139:13: Psalms 139:13 For You formed my inward parts; You covered me in my mother's womb.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 139:14: Psalms 139:14 I will praise You, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made; Marvelous are Your works, And that my soul knows very well.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 139:15: Psalms 139:15 My frame was not hidden from You, When I was made in secret, And skillfully wrought in the lowest parts of the earth.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 139:16: Psalms 139:16 Your eyes saw my substance, being yet unformed. And in Your book they all were written, The days fashioned for me, When as yet there were none of them.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 139:17: Psalms 139:17 How precious also are Your thoughts to me, O God! How great is the sum of them!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 139:18: Psalms 139:18 If I should count them, they would be more in number than the sand; When I awake, I am still with You.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 139:19: Psalms 139:19 Oh, that You would slay the wicked, O God!  Depart from me, therefore, you bloodthirsty men.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 139:20: Psalms 139:20 For they speak against You wickedly; Your enemies take Your name in vain.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 139:21: Psalms 139:21 Do I not hate them, O LORD, who hate You? And do I not loathe those who rise up against You?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 139:22: Psalms 139:22 I hate them with perfect hatred; I count them my enemies.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 139:23: Psalms 139:23 Search me, O God, and know my heart; Try me, and know my anxieties;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 139:24: Psalms 139:24 And see if there is any wicked way in me, And lead me in the way everlasting.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 140:1: Psalms 140:1 To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David.   Deliver me, O LORD, from evil men; Preserve me from violent men,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 140:2: Psalms 140:2 Who plan evil things in their hearts;  They continually gather together for war.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 140:3: Psalms 140:3 They sharpen their tongues like a serpent; The poison of asps is under their lips.  Selah(NKJV)
verses.psalms 140:4: Psalms 140:4 Keep me, O LORD, from the hands of the wicked; Preserve me from violent men, Who have purposed to make my steps stumble.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 140:5: Psalms 140:5 The proud have hidden a snare for me, and cords; They have spread a net by the wayside; They have set traps for me.  Selah(NKJV)
verses.psalms 140:6: Psalms 140:6 I said to the LORD: "You are my God; Hear the voice of my supplications, O LORD.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 140:7: Psalms 140:7 O GOD the Lord, the strength of my salvation, You have covered my head in the day of battle.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 140:8: Psalms 140:8 Do not grant, O LORD, the desires of the wicked; Do not further his wicked scheme,  Lest they be exalted.  Selah(NKJV)
verses.psalms 140:9: Psalms 140:9 "As for the head of those who surround me, Let the evil of their lips cover them;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 140:10: Psalms 140:10 Let burning coals fall upon them; Let them be cast into the fire, Into deep pits, that they rise not up again.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 140:11: Psalms 140:11 Let not a slanderer be established in the earth; Let evil hunt the violent man to overthrow him."(NKJV)
verses.psalms 140:12: Psalms 140:12 I know that the LORD will maintain The cause of the afflicted, And justice for the poor.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 140:13: Psalms 140:13 Surely the righteous shall give thanks to Your name; The upright shall dwell in Your presence.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 141:1: Psalms 141:1 A Psalm of David.   LORD, I cry out to You; Make haste to me! Give ear to my voice when I cry out to You.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 141:2: Psalms 141:2 Let my prayer be set before You as incense,  The lifting up of my hands as the evening sacrifice.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 141:3: Psalms 141:3 Set a guard, O LORD, over my mouth; Keep watch over the door of my lips.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 141:4: Psalms 141:4 Do not incline my heart to any evil thing, To practice wicked works With men who work iniquity;  And do not let me eat of their delicacies.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 141:5: Psalms 141:5 Let the righteous strike me; It shall be a kindness. And let him rebuke me; It shall be as excellent oil; Let my head not refuse it. For still my prayer is against the deeds of the wicked.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 141:6: Psalms 141:6 Their judges are overthrown by the sides of the cliff, And they hear my words, for they are sweet.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 141:7: Psalms 141:7 Our bones are scattered at the mouth of the grave, As when one plows and breaks up the earth.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 141:8: Psalms 141:8 But my eyes are upon You, O GOD the Lord; In You I take refuge; Do not leave my soul destitute.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 141:9: Psalms 141:9 Keep me from the snares they have laid for me, And from the traps of the workers of iniquity.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 141:10: Psalms 141:10 Let the wicked fall into their own nets, While I escape safely.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 142:1: Psalms 142:1 A Contemplation of David. A Prayer when he was in the cave.   I cry out to the LORD with my voice; With my voice to the LORD I make my supplication.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 142:2: Psalms 142:2 I pour out my complaint before Him; I declare before Him my trouble.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 142:3: Psalms 142:3 When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, Then You knew my path. In the way in which I walk They have secretly set a snare for me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 142:4: Psalms 142:4 Look on my right hand and see, For there is no one who acknowledges me; Refuge has failed me; No one cares for my soul.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 142:5: Psalms 142:5 I cried out to You, O LORD: I said, "You are my refuge, My portion in the land of the living.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 142:6: Psalms 142:6 Attend to my cry, For I am brought very low; Deliver me from my persecutors, For they are stronger than I.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 142:7: Psalms 142:7 Bring my soul out of prison, That I may praise Your name; The righteous shall surround me, For You shall deal bountifully with me."(NKJV)
verses.psalms 143:1: Psalms 143:1 A Psalm of David.   Hear my prayer, O LORD, Give ear to my supplications! In Your faithfulness answer me, And in Your righteousness.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 143:2: Psalms 143:2 Do not enter into judgment with Your servant,  For in Your sight no one living is righteous.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 143:3: Psalms 143:3 For the enemy has persecuted my soul; He has crushed my life to the ground; He has made me dwell in darkness, Like those who have long been dead.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 143:4: Psalms 143:4 Therefore my spirit is overwhelmed within me; My heart within me is distressed.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 143:5: Psalms 143:5 I remember the days of old; I meditate on all Your works; I muse on the work of Your hands.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 143:6: Psalms 143:6 I spread out my hands to You;  My soul longs for You like a thirsty land.  Selah(NKJV)
verses.psalms 143:7: Psalms 143:7 Answer me speedily, O LORD; My spirit fails! Do not hide Your face from me,  Lest I be like those who go down into the pit.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 143:8: Psalms 143:8 Cause me to hear Your lovingkindness in the morning, For in You do I trust;  Cause me to know the way in which I should walk, For I lift up my soul to You.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 143:9: Psalms 143:9 Deliver me, O LORD, from my enemies; In You I take shelter.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 143:10: Psalms 143:10 Teach me to do Your will, For You are my God;  Your Spirit is good. Lead me in the land of uprightness.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 143:11: Psalms 143:11 Revive me, O LORD, for Your name's sake! For Your righteousness' sake bring my soul out of trouble.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 143:12: Psalms 143:12 In Your mercy cut off my enemies, And destroy all those who afflict my soul; For I am Your servant.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 144:1: Psalms 144:1 A Psalm of David.   Blessed be the LORD my Rock,  Who trains my hands for war, And my fingers for battle"”(NKJV)
verses.psalms 144:2: Psalms 144:2 My lovingkindness and my fortress, My high tower and my deliverer, My shield and the One in whom I take refuge, Who subdues my people under me.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 144:3: Psalms 144:3 LORD, what is man, that You take knowledge of him? Or the son of man, that You are mindful of him?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 144:4: Psalms 144:4 Man is like a breath;  His days are like a passing shadow.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 144:5: Psalms 144:5 Bow down Your heavens, O LORD, and come down;  Touch the mountains, and they shall smoke.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 144:6: Psalms 144:6 Flash forth lightning and scatter them; Shoot out Your arrows and destroy them.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 144:7: Psalms 144:7 Stretch out Your hand from above; Rescue me and deliver me out of great waters, From the hand of foreigners,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 144:8: Psalms 144:8 Whose mouth speaks lying words, And whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 144:9: Psalms 144:9 I will sing a new song to You, O God; On a harp of ten strings I will sing praises to You,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 144:10: Psalms 144:10 The One who gives salvation to kings,  Who delivers David His servant From the deadly sword.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 144:11: Psalms 144:11 Rescue me and deliver me from the hand of foreigners, Whose mouth speaks lying words, And whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood"”(NKJV)
verses.psalms 144:12: Psalms 144:12 That our sons may be as plants grown up in their youth; That our daughters may be as pillars, Sculptured in palace style;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 144:13: Psalms 144:13 That our barns may be full, Supplying all kinds of produce; That our sheep may bring forth thousands And ten thousands in our fields;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 144:14: Psalms 144:14 That our oxen may be well laden; That there be no breaking in or going out; That there be no outcry in our streets.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 144:15: Psalms 144:15 Happy are the people who are in such a state; Happy are the people whose God is the LORD!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 145:1: Psalms 145:1 A Praise of David.   I will extol You, my God, O King; And I will bless Your name forever and ever.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 145:2: Psalms 145:2 Every day I will bless You, And I will praise Your name forever and ever.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 145:3: Psalms 145:3 Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised; And His greatness is unsearchable.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 145:4: Psalms 145:4 One generation shall praise Your works to another, And shall declare Your mighty acts.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 145:5: Psalms 145:5 I will meditate on the glorious splendor of Your majesty, And on Your wondrous works.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 145:6: Psalms 145:6 Men shall speak of the might of Your awesome acts, And I will declare Your greatness.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 145:7: Psalms 145:7 They shall utter the memory of Your great goodness, And shall sing of Your righteousness.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 145:8: Psalms 145:8 The LORD is gracious and full of compassion, Slow to anger and great in mercy.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 145:9: Psalms 145:9 The LORD is good to all, And His tender mercies are over all His works.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 145:10: Psalms 145:10 All Your works shall praise You, O LORD, And Your saints shall bless You.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 145:11: Psalms 145:11 They shall speak of the glory of Your kingdom, And talk of Your power,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 145:12: Psalms 145:12 To make known to the sons of men His mighty acts, And the glorious majesty of His kingdom.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 145:13: Psalms 145:13 Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, And Your dominion endures throughout all generations.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 145:14: Psalms 145:14 The LORD upholds all who fall, And raises up all who are bowed down.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 145:15: Psalms 145:15 The eyes of all look expectantly to You, And You give them their food in due season.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 145:16: Psalms 145:16 You open Your hand  And satisfy the desire of every living thing.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 145:17: Psalms 145:17 The LORD is righteous in all His ways, Gracious in all His works.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 145:18: Psalms 145:18 The LORD is near to all who call upon Him, To all who call upon Him in truth.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 145:19: Psalms 145:19 He will fulfill the desire of those who fear Him; He also will hear their cry and save them.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 145:20: Psalms 145:20 The LORD preserves all who love Him, But all the wicked He will destroy.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 145:21: Psalms 145:21 My mouth shall speak the praise of the LORD, And all flesh shall bless His holy name Forever and ever.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 146:1: Psalms 146:1 Praise the LORD!  Praise the LORD, O my soul!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 146:2: Psalms 146:2 While I live I will praise the LORD; I will sing praises to my God while I have my being.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 146:3: Psalms 146:3 Do not put your trust in princes, Nor in a son of man, in whom there is no help.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 146:4: Psalms 146:4 His spirit departs, he returns to his earth; In that very day his plans perish.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 146:5: Psalms 146:5 Happy is he who has the God of Jacob for his help, Whose hope is in the LORD his God,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 146:6: Psalms 146:6 Who made heaven and earth, The sea, and all that is in them; Who keeps truth forever,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 146:7: Psalms 146:7 Who executes justice for the oppressed,  Who gives food to the hungry.  The LORD gives freedom to the prisoners.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 146:8: Psalms 146:8 The LORD opens the eyes of the blind;  The LORD raises those who are bowed down; The LORD loves the righteous.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 146:9: Psalms 146:9 The LORD watches over the strangers; He relieves the fatherless and widow;  But the way of the wicked He turns upside down.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 146:10: Psalms 146:10 The LORD shall reign forever"” Your God, O Zion, to all generations. Praise the LORD!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 147:1: Psalms 147:1 Praise the LORD! For it is good to sing praises to our God;  For it is pleasant, and praise is beautiful.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 147:2: Psalms 147:2 The LORD builds up Jerusalem;  He gathers together the outcasts of Israel.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 147:3: Psalms 147:3 He heals the brokenhearted And binds up their wounds.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 147:4: Psalms 147:4 He counts the number of the stars; He calls them all by name.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 147:5: Psalms 147:5 Great is our Lord, and mighty in power;  His understanding is infinite.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 147:6: Psalms 147:6 The LORD lifts up the humble; He casts the wicked down to the ground.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 147:7: Psalms 147:7 Sing to the LORD with thanksgiving; Sing praises on the harp to our God,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 147:8: Psalms 147:8 Who covers the heavens with clouds, Who prepares rain for the earth, Who makes grass to grow on the mountains.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 147:9: Psalms 147:9 He gives to the beast its food, And to the young ravens that cry.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 147:10: Psalms 147:10 He does not delight in the strength of the horse; He takes no pleasure in the legs of a man.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 147:11: Psalms 147:11 The LORD takes pleasure in those who fear Him, In those who hope in His mercy.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 147:12: Psalms 147:12 Praise the LORD, O Jerusalem! Praise your God, O Zion!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 147:13: Psalms 147:13 For He has strengthened the bars of your gates; He has blessed your children within you.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 147:14: Psalms 147:14 He makes peace in your borders, And fills you with the finest wheat.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 147:15: Psalms 147:15 He sends out His command to the earth; His word runs very swiftly.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 147:16: Psalms 147:16 He gives snow like wool; He scatters the frost like ashes;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 147:17: Psalms 147:17 He casts out His hail like morsels; Who can stand before His cold?(NKJV)
verses.psalms 147:18: Psalms 147:18 He sends out His word and melts them; He causes His wind to blow, and the waters flow.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 147:19: Psalms 147:19 He declares His word to Jacob,  His statutes and His judgments to Israel.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 147:20: Psalms 147:20 He has not dealt thus with any nation; And as for His judgments, they have not known them. Praise the LORD!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 148:1: Psalms 148:1 Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD from the heavens; Praise Him in the heights!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 148:2: Psalms 148:2 Praise Him, all His angels; Praise Him, all His hosts!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 148:3: Psalms 148:3 Praise Him, sun and moon; Praise Him, all you stars of light!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 148:4: Psalms 148:4 Praise Him, you heavens of heavens, And you waters above the heavens!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 148:5: Psalms 148:5 Let them praise the name of the LORD, For He commanded and they were created.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 148:6: Psalms 148:6 He also established them forever and ever; He made a decree which shall not pass away.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 148:7: Psalms 148:7 Praise the LORD from the earth,  You great sea creatures and all the depths;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 148:8: Psalms 148:8 Fire and hail, snow and clouds; Stormy wind, fulfilling His word;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 148:9: Psalms 148:9 Mountains and all hills; Fruitful trees and all cedars;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 148:10: Psalms 148:10 Beasts and all cattle; Creeping things and flying fowl;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 148:11: Psalms 148:11 Kings of the earth and all peoples; Princes and all judges of the earth;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 148:12: Psalms 148:12 Both young men and maidens; Old men and children.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 148:13: Psalms 148:13 Let them praise the name of the LORD, For His name alone is exalted; His glory is above the earth and heaven.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 148:14: Psalms 148:14 And He has exalted the horn of His people, The praise of all His saints"” Of the children of Israel,  A people near to Him. Praise the LORD!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 149:1: Psalms 149:1 Praise the LORD!  Sing to the LORD a new song, And His praise in the assembly of saints.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 149:2: Psalms 149:2 Let Israel rejoice in their Maker; Let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 149:3: Psalms 149:3 Let them praise His name with the dance; Let them sing praises to Him with the timbrel and harp.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 149:4: Psalms 149:4 For the LORD takes pleasure in His people;  He will beautify the humble with salvation.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 149:5: Psalms 149:5 Let the saints be joyful in glory; Let them sing aloud on their beds.(NKJV)
verses.psalms 149:6: Psalms 149:6 Let the high praises of God be in their mouth, And a two-edged sword in their hand,(NKJV)
verses.psalms 149:7: Psalms 149:7 To execute vengeance on the nations, And punishments on the peoples;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 149:8: Psalms 149:8 To bind their kings with chains, And their nobles with fetters of iron;(NKJV)
verses.psalms 149:9: Psalms 149:9 To execute on them the written judgment"”  This honor have all His saints. Praise the LORD!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 150:1: Psalms 150:1 Praise  the LORD! Praise God in His sanctuary; Praise Him in His mighty firmament!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 150:2: Psalms 150:2 Praise Him for His mighty acts; Praise Him according to His excellent greatness!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 150:3: Psalms 150:3 Praise Him with the sound of the trumpet; Praise Him with the lute and harp!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 150:4: Psalms 150:4 Praise Him with the timbrel and dance; Praise Him with stringed instruments and flutes!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 150:5: Psalms 150:5 Praise Him with loud cymbals; Praise Him with clashing cymbals!(NKJV)
verses.psalms 150:6: Psalms 150:6 Let everything that has breath praise the LORD. Praise the LORD!(NKJV)
